Create `snode/owner_audit_plan.go`:

```go
package snode

import (
	"fmt"
	"maps"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// ownerAuditPart is one hg_safe part as the owner audit compares it: its name
// and hash_of_all_files.
type ownerAuditPart struct {
	Name     string
	PhysHash string
}

// ownerAuditReference is a partition's reference inventory: this SNode's last
// acknowledged inventory ("local") or the arbiter's SafeParts ("fsm"), with
// the promotion that acknowledged it (0 for the arbiter's answer that it never
// promoted the partition).
type ownerAuditReference struct {
	Source string
	Seq    uint64
	Parts  []ownerAuditPart
}

// ownerAuditInputs are what the reference is chosen from: this SNode's
// promotion watermark and acknowledged inventory of the partition, and the
// arbiter's state of it (FSMAvailable false: it could not be read; FSM nil:
// the arbiter knows no promotion of the partition).
type ownerAuditInputs struct {
	Watermark    uint64
	Local        *ackedSafeInventory
	FSMAvailable bool
	FSM          *wire.PartitionState
}

// ownerAuditReferenceFor picks the reference (plan S3-A contract §3,
// clarification K3): the newer, by publish seq, of the local inventory and the
// arbiter's SafeParts. The arbiter is "ahead" when its publish seq is past
// this SNode's own promotion watermark, which every journaled acknowledgement
// advances: then this SNode's state is behind, refusal is fsm_ahead and
// nothing may be dropped. Equal seqs with different inventories are
// fsm_disagrees. ok is false with no refusal when there is no reference.
func ownerAuditReferenceFor(in ownerAuditInputs) (ref ownerAuditReference, ok bool, refusal OwnerAuditReason, detail string) {
	var local, fsm *ownerAuditReference
	if in.Local != nil {
		l := ownerAuditReference{Source: "local", Seq: in.Local.PromotionSeq}
		for _, m := range in.Local.Parts {
			l.Parts = append(l.Parts, ownerAuditPart{Name: m.SafePartName, PhysHash: m.PartPhysHash})
		}
		local = &l
	}
	if in.FSMAvailable {
		f := ownerAuditReference{Source: "fsm"}
		if in.FSM != nil {
			if in.FSM.PublishSeq > in.Watermark {
				return ownerAuditReference{}, false, OwnerAuditFSMAhead, fmt.Sprintf(
					"the arbiter recorded applied promotion %d of the partition, past this SNode's promotion watermark %d: its local state is behind",
					in.FSM.PublishSeq, in.Watermark)
			}
			f.Seq = in.FSM.PublishSeq
			for _, e := range in.FSM.SafeParts {
				f.Parts = append(f.Parts, ownerAuditPart{Name: e.PartName, PhysHash: e.PartPhysHash})
			}
		}
		fsm = &f
	}
	switch {
	case local == nil && fsm == nil:
		return ownerAuditReference{}, false, "", ""
	case fsm == nil:
		return *local, true, "", ""
	case local == nil:
		return *fsm, true, "", ""
	case fsm.Seq > local.Seq:
		return *fsm, true, "", ""
	case local.Seq > fsm.Seq:
		return *local, true, "", ""
	case samePartSet(local.Parts, fsm.Parts):
		return *local, true, "", ""
	}
	return ownerAuditReference{}, false, OwnerAuditFSMDisagrees, fmt.Sprintf(
		"this SNode and the arbiter acknowledged different inventories for promotion %d", local.Seq)
}

func samePartSet(a, b []ownerAuditPart) bool {
	if len(a) != len(b) {
		return false
	}
	byNameHash := func(x, y ownerAuditPart) int {
		if c := strings.Compare(x.Name, y.Name); c != 0 {
			return c
		}
		return strings.Compare(x.PhysHash, y.PhysHash)
	}
	return slices.Equal(slices.SortedFunc(slices.Values(a), byNameHash), slices.SortedFunc(slices.Values(b), byNameHash))
}

// ownerAuditPlan is the audit's verdict on one partition: clean (no Reason),
// or unclean with the parts Reason names; Drop lists the resurrected twins
// repair mode drops, set only when dropping exactly them leaves the reference.
type ownerAuditPlan struct {
	Reason OwnerAuditReason
	Parts  []string
	Drop   []string
	Detail string
}

func (p ownerAuditPlan) clean() bool { return p.Reason == "" }

// planOwnerAudit compares one logical partition's active hg_safe parts with
// its reference (clarification K2). Parts are grouped by hash_of_all_files:
// the members whose name and hash the reference carries are kept, and every
// other member of a group with a kept member is a resurrected twin. Twins are
// dropped only when that leaves exactly the reference: a part without an
// acknowledged twin, or a missing acknowledged part, makes the partition
// unclean and drops nothing.
func planOwnerAudit(ref ownerAuditReference, haveRef bool, active []partInfo) ownerAuditPlan {
	if !haveRef {
		if len(active) == 0 {
			return ownerAuditPlan{}
		}
		return ownerAuditPlan{Reason: OwnerAuditNoAcknowledgedInventory, Parts: activePartNames(active),
			Detail: "this SNode has no acknowledged inventory of a partition that holds parts, and the arbiter's could not be read"}
	}
	acked := make(map[ownerAuditPart]bool, len(ref.Parts))
	for _, p := range ref.Parts {
		acked[p] = true
	}
	groups := map[string][]partInfo{}
	present := make(map[ownerAuditPart]bool, len(active))
	for _, p := range active {
		groups[p.PhysHash] = append(groups[p.PhysHash], p)
		present[ownerAuditPart{Name: p.Name, PhysHash: p.PhysHash}] = true
	}
	var unacknowledged, drop, missing []string
	for _, group := range groups {
		kept := slices.ContainsFunc(group, func(p partInfo) bool { return acked[ownerAuditPart{Name: p.Name, PhysHash: p.PhysHash}] })
		for _, p := range group {
			switch {
			case acked[ownerAuditPart{Name: p.Name, PhysHash: p.PhysHash}]:
			case kept:
				drop = append(drop, p.Name)
			default:
				unacknowledged = append(unacknowledged, p.Name)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, p := range ref.Parts {
		if !present[p] {
			missing = append(missing, p.Name)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(unacknowledged)
	slices.Sort(drop)
	slices.Sort(missing)
	switch {
	case len(unacknowledged) > 0:
		return ownerAuditPlan{Reason: OwnerAuditUnacknowledgedPart, Parts: unacknowledged, Detail: fmt.Sprintf(
			"no active part with the same hash_of_all_files carries an acknowledged name; twins %v and missing acknowledged parts %v are left as they are", drop, missing)}
	case len(missing) > 0:
		return ownerAuditPlan{Reason: OwnerAuditAcknowledgedPartMissing, Parts: missing, Detail: fmt.Sprintf(
			"acknowledged parts are not active; twins %v are left as they are", drop)}
	case len(drop) > 0:
		return ownerAuditPlan{Reason: OwnerAuditUnacknowledgedPart, Parts: drop, Drop: drop,
			Detail: "equal hash_of_all_files twins of acknowledged parts: a ClickHouse restart resurrected the parts a REPLACE PARTITION retired"}
	}
	return ownerAuditPlan{}
}

// activePartNames returns the sorted names of parts. (The test-only
// partNames of converge_test.go takes candidate parts; this name keeps the
// two apart in the snode test binary.)
func activePartNames(parts []partInfo) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	for _, p := range parts {
		out = append(out, p.Name)
	}
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}

// ownerAuditState is the audit's in-memory state: which tables are held until
// a full pass audits them, the current findings, and the counters. A restart
// of the SNode starts it afresh: the startup pass decides again.
type ownerAuditState struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	// pendingAll: a full pass is due and has not yet taken its table set, so
	// every table is held (from New, and after each ClickHouse restart).
	pendingAll bool
	// trigger is the trigger of the full pass that is due or running.
	trigger string
	// pending are the tables of the current full pass not yet audited (not
	// reached, or failed on a ClickHouse or schema error).
	pending        map[string]bool
	findings       map[partitionKey]OwnerAuditFinding
	runs           map[string]uint64
	dropped        uint64
	restarts       uint64
	fsmUnavailable uint64
	lastRun        time.Time
	// wake is signalled when a full pass becomes due.
	wake chan struct{}
}

// newOwnerAuditState starts with the startup pass due when the SNode has a
// ClickHouse connection to audit.
func newOwnerAuditState(due bool) *ownerAuditState {
	return &ownerAuditState{
		pendingAll: due,
		trigger:    OwnerAuditTriggerStartup,
		pending:    map[string]bool{},
		findings:   map[partitionKey]OwnerAuditFinding{},
		runs:       map[string]uint64{OwnerAuditTriggerStartup: 0, OwnerAuditTriggerPromotion: 0, OwnerAuditTriggerClickHouseRestart: 0},
		wake:       make(chan struct{}, 1),
	}
}

// blocks reports whether table may not be served yet: a full pass is due that
// has not taken its table set, table is in the current pass and not audited,
// or one of its partitions has a finding.
func (a *ownerAuditState) blocks(table string) bool {
	if a == nil {
		return false
	}
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	if a.pendingAll || a.pending[table] {
		return true
	}
	for k := range a.findings {
		if k.Table == table {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// require makes a full pass with trigger due and wakes the worker.
func (a *ownerAuditState) require(trigger string) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	a.pendingAll, a.trigger = true, trigger
	a.mu.Unlock()
	select {
	case a.wake <- struct{}{}:
	default:
	}
}

// restarted counts a detected ClickHouse restart and makes its pass due.
func (a *ownerAuditState) restarted() {
	a.mu.Lock()
	a.restarts++
	a.mu.Unlock()
	a.require(OwnerAuditTriggerClickHouseRestart)
}

// begin starts a full pass over tables and returns its trigger; each table is
// held until tableDone.
func (a *ownerAuditState) begin(tables []string) string {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.pendingAll = false
	a.pending = make(map[string]bool, len(tables))
	for _, t := range tables {
		a.pending[t] = true
	}
	return a.trigger
}

func (a *ownerAuditState) tableDone(table string) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	delete(a.pending, table)
}

// due reports whether a full pass is due or did not complete.
func (a *ownerAuditState) due() bool {
	if a == nil {
		return false
	}
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	return a.pendingAll || len(a.pending) > 0
}

func (a *ownerAuditState) ran(trigger string, at time.Time) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.runs[trigger]++
	a.lastRun = at
}

// set makes f its partition's finding and reports whether it differs from the
// finding it replaces (none, or another reason, parts or trigger), so an
// unchanged verdict is not logged again on every re-audit.
func (a *ownerAuditState) set(f OwnerAuditFinding) bool {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	k := partitionKey{Table: f.TableID, Partition: f.PartitionID}
	old, ok := a.findings[k]
	a.findings[k] = f
	return !ok || old.Reason != f.Reason || old.Trigger != f.Trigger || !slices.Equal(old.Parts, f.Parts)
}

// finding returns k's current finding.
func (a *ownerAuditState) finding(k partitionKey) (OwnerAuditFinding, bool) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	f, ok := a.findings[k]
	return f, ok
}

// findingTables returns, sorted, the tables with a finding.
func (a *ownerAuditState) findingTables() []string {
	if a == nil {
		return nil
	}
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for k := range a.findings {
		seen[k.Table] = true
	}
	return slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(seen))
}

func (a *ownerAuditState) clear(k partitionKey) {
	if a == nil {
		return
	}
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	delete(a.findings, k)
}

// forgetTable drops a dropped table's findings and its place in the pass.
func (a *ownerAuditState) forgetTable(table string) {
	if a == nil {
		return
	}
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	delete(a.pending, table)
	for k := range a.findings {
		if k.Table == table {
			delete(a.findings, k)
		}
	}
}

// findingPartitions returns, sorted, the partitions of table with a finding.
func (a *ownerAuditState) findingPartitions(table string) []string {
	if a == nil {
		return nil
	}
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	var out []string
	for k := range a.findings {
		if k.Table == table {
			out = append(out, k.Partition)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}

func (a *ownerAuditState) countDropped() {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.dropped++
}

func (a *ownerAuditState) countFSMUnavailable() {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.fsmUnavailable++
}

// stats returns a detached copy for OwnerAuditStats.
func (a *ownerAuditState) stats(mode OwnerAuditMode) OwnerAuditStats {
	if a == nil {
		return OwnerAuditStats{Mode: mode, Runs: map[string]uint64{OwnerAuditTriggerStartup: 0, OwnerAuditTriggerPromotion: 0, OwnerAuditTriggerClickHouseRestart: 0}}
	}
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	out := OwnerAuditStats{Mode: mode, Runs: maps.Clone(a.runs), DroppedTwins: a.dropped, ClickHouseRestarts: a.restarts,
		FSMUnavailable: a.fsmUnavailable, LastRun: a.lastRun}
	for _, f := range a.findings {
		f.Parts = slices.Clone(f.Parts)
		out.Unclean = append(out.Unclean, f)
	}
	slices.SortFunc(out.Unclean, func(x, y OwnerAuditFinding) int {
		if c := strings.Compare(x.TableID, y.TableID); c != 0 {
			return c
		}
		return strings.Compare(x.PartitionID, y.PartitionID)
	})
	return out
}
```

```go
	switch {
	case c.OwnerAuditFSMTimeout < 0:
		errs = append(errs, errors.New("owner audit fsm timeout must not be negative"))
	case c.OwnerAuditFSMTimeout == 0:
		c.OwnerAuditFSMTimeout = DefaultOwnerAuditFSMTimeout
	}
```

```go
package snode

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2/lib/driver"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"
)

// ownerAuditConnS is a ClickHouse for the owner audit's background runs without
// a server: uptime() from a start time the test moves, an empty system.parts
// (failing once after failNextListing), and an Exec that succeeds. Any other
// method is unimplemented (the embedded nil Conn panics).
type ownerAuditConnS struct {
	clickhouse.Conn
	mu       sync.Mutex
	started  time.Time
	partsErr error
	listings int
}

func (c *ownerAuditConnS) QueryRow(_ context.Context, query string, _ ...any) driver.Row {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if query != "SELECT toUInt64(uptime())" {
		return uptimeRowS{err: fmt.Errorf("unexpected query %q", query)}
	}
	return uptimeRowS{uptime: uint64(time.Since(c.started) / time.Second)}
}

func (c *ownerAuditConnS) Query(_ context.Context, query string, _ ...any) (driver.Rows, error) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if !strings.Contains(query, "FROM system.parts") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected query %q", query)
	}
	c.listings++
	if err := c.partsErr; err != nil {
		c.partsErr = nil
		return nil, err
	}
	return emptyRowsS{}, nil
}

func (c *ownerAuditConnS) Exec(context.Context, string, ...any) error { return nil }

func (c *ownerAuditConnS) restart() {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.started = time.Now()
}

func (c *ownerAuditConnS) failNextListing(err error) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.partsErr = err
}

type uptimeRowS struct {
	uptime uint64
	err    error
}

func (r uptimeRowS) Err() error { return r.err }

func (r uptimeRowS) Scan(dest ...any) error {
	if r.err != nil {
		return r.err
	}
	p, ok := dest[0].(*uint64)
	if !ok || len(dest) != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("scan into %v, want one *uint64", dest)
	}
	*p = r.uptime
	return nil
}

func (r uptimeRowS) ScanStruct(any) error { return errors.New("uptimeRowS: ScanStruct is not supported") }

// emptyRowsS is a result without rows.
type emptyRowsS struct{}

func (emptyRowsS) Next() bool                       { return false }
func (emptyRowsS) Scan(...any) error                { return errors.New("emptyRowsS: no row") }
func (emptyRowsS) ScanStruct(any) error             { return errors.New("emptyRowsS: no row") }
func (emptyRowsS) ColumnTypes() []driver.ColumnType { return nil }
func (emptyRowsS) Totals(...any) error              { return nil }
func (emptyRowsS) Columns() []string                { return nil }
func (emptyRowsS) Close() error                     { return nil }
func (emptyRowsS) Err() error                       { return nil }
func (emptyRowsS) HasData() bool                    { return false }

func newOwnerAuditWorkerRoleS(t *testing.T, mode OwnerAuditMode) (*Role, *ownerAuditConnS) {
	t.Helper()
	conn := &ownerAuditConnS{started: time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)}
	cfg := testConfigS(t)
	cfg.OwnerAudit = mode
	cfg.OwnerAuditProbeInterval = MinOwnerAuditProbeInterval
	role, err := New(cfg, Deps{Client: startClaimsFakeS(t, &claimsFakeS{}), Conn: conn})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return role, conn
}

// TestOwnerAuditWorkerReauditsEveryTableAfterAClickHouseRestart: in repair mode
// a table is held from New until the startup audit completed; the watcher then
// sees ClickHouse's start time move, holds every table again and the worker
// re-audits them (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §14). The arbiter here serves no
// GetPartitionStates, which is counted and leaves the local inventory (K3).
func TestOwnerAuditWorkerReauditsEveryTableAfterAClickHouseRestart(t *testing.T) {
	role, conn := newOwnerAuditWorkerRoleS(t, OwnerAuditRepair)
	if role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") {
		t.Fatal("a repair-mode table is clean before its startup audit")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	stop := role.startOwnerAudit(ctx)
	defer stop()
	stats := role.OwnerAuditStats()
	if stats.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerStartup] != 1 || stats.ClickHouseRestarts != 0 || len(stats.Unclean) != 0 || stats.LastRun.IsZero() || stats.FSMUnavailable != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("stats after the startup audit = %+v", stats)
	}
	if !role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") {
		t.Fatal("the table is held after a clean startup audit")
	}
	conn.restart()
	waitForS(t, 10*time.Second, "the re-audit after the ClickHouse restart", func() bool {
		s := role.OwnerAuditStats()
		return s.ClickHouseRestarts == 1 && s.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerClickHouseRestart] == 1
	})
	if !role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") {
		t.Fatal("the table is held after a clean re-audit")
	}
	time.Sleep(2 * MinOwnerAuditProbeInterval)
	if s := role.OwnerAuditStats(); s.ClickHouseRestarts != 1 || s.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerClickHouseRestart] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("a start time that stays put was reported again: %+v", s)
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditWorkerRetriesATableWhoseAuditFailed: a ClickHouse error during
// the startup audit holds the table (repair mode) and never fails the role; the
// worker retries the pass on its next probe interval.
func TestOwnerAuditWorkerRetriesATableWhoseAuditFailed(t *testing.T) {
	role, conn := newOwnerAuditWorkerRoleS(t, OwnerAuditRepair)
	conn.failNextListing(errors.New("read tcp 127.0.0.1:9000: connection reset by peer"))
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	stop := role.startOwnerAudit(ctx)
	defer stop()
	if role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") {
		t.Fatal("a table whose startup audit failed is not held in repair mode")
	}
	// A pass releases its tables before it counts its run, so wait for the
	// count: once the retry is counted, its table is released.
	waitForS(t, 10*time.Second, "the retried startup audit", func() bool {
		return role.OwnerAuditStats().Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerStartup] >= 2
	})
	if s := role.OwnerAuditStats(); s.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerStartup] != 2 || !role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") {
		t.Fatalf("startup runs = %d, clean %v; want the failed run and its clean retry", s.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerStartup], role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t"))
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditPassAsksAFailingArbiterOnce: once the arbiter's partition
// states fail in a full pass, the pass audits its other tables on their own
// inventories without asking again, so an unreachable arbiter costs a pass
// (and the startup that waits for it) one OwnerAuditFSMTimeout rather than one
// per table (clarification K3). Each table still counts FSMUnavailable.
func TestOwnerAuditPassAsksAFailingArbiterOnce(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := testConfigS(t)
	cfg.Tables = append(cfg.Tables, payloadexec.TableSchema{TableID: "db.u", Columns: cfg.Tables[0].Columns})
	cfg.SchemaRoot = payloadexec.SchemaRoot(cfg.NetworkID, cfg.Tables)
	cfg.OwnerAudit = OwnerAuditRepair
	// InvalidArgument is not retried, so each read reaches the fake once.
	fsm := &fsmPartitionsFakeS{err: status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "injected arbiter refusal")}
	role, _ := newOwnerAuditHarnessS(t, &ownerAuditConnS{started: time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)}, cfg, fsm)

	role.runOwnerAuditPass(context.Background())

	s := role.OwnerAuditStats()
	if fsm.readCount() != 1 || s.FSMUnavailable != 2 || len(s.Unclean) != 0 || !role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") || !role.OwnerAuditClean("db.u") {
		t.Fatalf("arbiter reads %d, stats %+v; want one read, two unavailable counts and both tables clean", fsm.readCount(), s)
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditWorkerReleasesARepairedPartition: in repair mode the worker
// re-audits, every probe interval, each partition with a finding, so one that
// is clean again (an operator removed the foreign part; here the fake's
// hg_safe is empty) stops holding its table without a promotion or a restart
// (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §14: Pending only while unclean). The re-audit
// is not a run.
func TestOwnerAuditWorkerReleasesARepairedPartition(t *testing.T) {
	role, _ := newOwnerAuditWorkerRoleS(t, OwnerAuditRepair)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	stop := role.startOwnerAudit(ctx)
	defer stop()
	role.audit.set(OwnerAuditFinding{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "all", Reason: OwnerAuditUnacknowledgedPart,
		Parts: []string{"all_9_9_0"}, Trigger: OwnerAuditTriggerStartup})

	waitForS(t, 10*time.Second, "the re-audit of the repaired partition", func() bool { return role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") })

	if s := role.OwnerAuditStats(); len(s.Unclean) != 0 || s.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerStartup] != 1 || s.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerClickHouseRestart] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stats after the re-audit = %+v, want no finding and only the startup run", s)
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditReportModeNeverHoldsATable: in report mode no state of the
// audit, before it ran, while it fails, or with a finding, holds a table.
func TestOwnerAuditReportModeNeverHoldsATable(t *testing.T) {
	role, conn := newOwnerAuditWorkerRoleS(t, OwnerAuditReport)
	conn.failNextListing(errors.New("read tcp 127.0.0.1:9000: connection reset by peer"))
	if !role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") {
		t.Fatal("report mode held a table before its startup audit")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	stop := role.startOwnerAudit(ctx)
	defer stop()
	if !role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") {
		t.Fatal("report mode held a table whose audit failed")
	}
	role.audit.set(OwnerAuditFinding{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "all", Reason: OwnerAuditUnacknowledgedPart})
	if !role.OwnerAuditClean("db.t") || role.OwnerAuditStats().Mode != OwnerAuditReport {
		t.Fatal("report mode held a table with a finding")
	}
}
```

Create `snode/owner_audit_ch_test.go` (ClickHouse-gated through `requireCH`):

```go
package snode

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"maps"
	"net"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/fspayload"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// auditPartitionS is the logical partition of every fixture statement (p = 'p0').
const auditPartitionS = "p_p0"

// fsmPartitionsFakeS is the arbiter's SafeState as the owner audit reads it:
// GetPartitionStates answers the states set, filtered like the arbiter, or
// refuses every read with err when it is set.
type fsmPartitionsFakeS struct {
	pb.UnimplementedSafeStateServer

	mu     sync.Mutex
	states map[partitionKey]wire.PartitionState
	err    error
	reads  int
}

func (f *fsmPartitionsFakeS) GetPartitionStates(_ context.Context, req *pb.GetPartitionStatesRequest) (*pb.PartitionStates, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.reads++
	if f.err != nil {
		return nil, f.err
	}
	var out wire.PartitionStates
	keys := slices.SortedFunc(maps.Keys(f.states), func(a, b partitionKey) int { return strings.Compare(a.Partition, b.Partition) })
	for _, k := range keys {
		if k.Table == req.GetTableId() && (req.GetPartitionId() == "" || k.Partition == req.GetPartitionId()) {
			out.Partitions = append(out.Partitions, f.states[k])
		}
	}
	return wire.PartitionStatesToPB(out), nil
}

func (f *fsmPartitionsFakeS) set(s wire.PartitionState) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	if f.states == nil {
		f.states = map[partitionKey]wire.PartitionState{}
	}
	f.states[partitionKey{Table: s.TableID, Partition: s.PartitionID}] = s
}

func (f *fsmPartitionsFakeS) readCount() int {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	return f.reads
}

// fsmStateOfAckS is the partition state the arbiter keeps once it applied ack.
func fsmStateOfAckS(ack arbiter.PromotionAck) wire.PartitionState {
	s := wire.PartitionState{TableID: ack.TableID, PartitionID: ack.PartitionID, BasePartitionRoot: ack.PostPartitionCommitment,
		PublishSeq: ack.PromotionSeq, LastAckedPromotionSeq: ack.PromotionSeq}
	for _, m := range ack.SafePartitionParts {
		s.SafeParts = append(s.SafeParts, replay.PartManifestEntry{TableID: ack.TableID, PartitionID: ack.PartitionID,
			PartName: m.SafePartName, PartPhysHash: m.PartPhysHash, PartRowLtHash: m.PartRowLtHash})
	}
	return s
}

// newOwnerAuditHarnessS is newIntakeHarness whose arbiter also serves fsm's
// GetPartitionStates (none when fsm is nil: the read answers Unimplemented).
func newOwnerAuditHarnessS(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, cfg Config, fsm *fsmPartitionsFakeS) (*Role, *sourceClaimsFake) {
	t.Helper()
	claims := &sourceClaimsFake{}
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("listen: %v", err)
	}
	srv := grpc.NewServer()
	pb.RegisterSourceClaimsServer(srv, claims)
	pb.RegisterPromotionGatewayServer(srv, claims)
	if fsm != nil {
		pb.RegisterSafeStateServer(srv, fsm)
	}
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		_ = srv.Serve(ln)
		close(done)
	}()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		srv.Stop()
		<-done
	})
	client, err := dataplane.New(dataplane.Config{Peers: []dataplane.Peer{{ID: "n1", GRPCAddr: ln.Addr().String()}}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("new dataplane client: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(client.Close)
	payloads, err := fspayload.New(t.TempDir())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("payload store: %v", err)
	}
	role, err := New(cfg, Deps{Client: client, Conn: conn, Payloads: payloads})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("new snode: %v", err)
	}
	return role, claims
}

// ownerAuditFixtureS is one SNode over promoteSchema's protocol tables; every
// statement lands in partition p_p0 and is promoted through handlePromote as
// the arbiter would issue it.
type ownerAuditFixtureS struct {
	t      *testing.T
	conn   clickhouse.Conn
	role   *Role
	claims *sourceClaimsFake
	signer commandSigner
	schema payloadexec.TableSchema
}

func newOwnerAuditFixtureS(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, mode OwnerAuditMode, fsm *fsmPartitionsFakeS) *ownerAuditFixtureS {
	t.Helper()
	schema := promoteSchema()
	signer := mustPromoteSigner(t)
	cfg := testConfigS(t)
	cfg.Tables = []payloadexec.TableSchema{schema}
	cfg.SchemaRoot = payloadexec.SchemaRoot(cfg.NetworkID, cfg.Tables)
	cfg.AuthorityAddresses = []string{signer.Address()}
	cfg.OwnerAudit = mode
	cfg.OwnerAuditProbeInterval = MinOwnerAuditProbeInterval
	setUniqueDatabases(t, &cfg)
	role, claims := newOwnerAuditHarnessS(t, conn, cfg, fsm)
	createSNodeTables(t, conn, role.cfg, schema)
	return &ownerAuditFixtureS{t: t, conn: conn, role: role, claims: claims, signer: signer, schema: schema}
}

func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) table() string { return CHTableName(f.schema.TableID) }

func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) safe() string { return f.role.cfg.SafeDatabase + "." + f.table() }

// submit commits statement seq (rows 2*seq-1 and 2*seq) and returns its
// candidate part.
func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) submit(ctx context.Context, seq uint64) arbiter.CandidatePart {
	f.t.Helper()
	payload := nativePayload(f.t, pv{"p0", 2*seq - 1}, pv{"p0", 2 * seq})
	env := intakeEnvelope(payload)
	env.StatementID.ClientSeq = seq
	env.StatementID.ClientNonce = fmt.Sprintf("n%d", seq)
	env.PayloadRef = fmt.Sprintf("payload-%d.native", seq)
	if err := f.role.SubmitLocalStatement(ctx, env, payload); err != nil {
		f.t.Fatalf("SubmitLocalStatement %d: %v", seq, err)
	}
	rcs := f.claims.snapshot()
	if len(rcs) == 0 || len(rcs[len(rcs)-1].CandidateParts) != 1 || rcs[len(rcs)-1].CandidateParts[0].PartitionID != auditPartitionS {
		f.t.Fatalf("result claims after statement %d: %+v", seq, rcs)
	}
	return rcs[len(rcs)-1].CandidateParts[0]
}

// promote promotes part as promotion seq on the partition's current base.
func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) promote(ctx context.Context, seq uint64, part arbiter.CandidatePart) error {
	f.t.Helper()
	base, _ := f.role.state.BaseRoot(partitionKey{Table: f.schema.TableID, Partition: part.PartitionID})
	snapshot := "genesis"
	if seq > 1 {
		snapshot = fmt.Sprintf("safe-%d", seq-1)
	}
	cmd := arbiter.PromoteSafePartition{TableID: f.schema.TableID, PartitionID: part.PartitionID, PromotionSeq: seq,
		BaseSafeSnapshotID: snapshot, BasePartitionRoot: base,
		CandidateParts: []arbiter.PartRef{{TableID: f.schema.TableID, PartitionID: part.PartitionID, PartRowLtHash: part.PartRowLtHash, PartName: part.PartName}}}
	return f.role.handlePromote(ctx, wire.PromoteToPB(cmd), mustSignPromotion(f.t, f.signer, cmd))
}

// cleanup drops part from hg_unsafe as promotion seq's cleanup.
func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) cleanup(ctx context.Context, seq uint64, part arbiter.CandidatePart) {
	f.t.Helper()
	cleanup := arbiter.UnsafeCleanup{TableID: f.schema.TableID, PartitionID: part.PartitionID, PromotionSeq: seq,
		Parts: []arbiter.PartRef{{TableID: f.schema.TableID, PartitionID: part.PartitionID, PartRowLtHash: part.PartRowLtHash, PartName: part.PartName}}}
	if err := f.role.handleCleanup(ctx, wire.CleanupToPB(cleanup), mustSignCleanup(f.t, f.signer, cleanup)); err != nil {
		f.t.Fatalf("cleanup %d: %v", seq, err)
	}
}

// promoteAndClean submits statement seq, promotes it and cleans its unsafe part.
func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) promoteAndClean(ctx context.Context, seq uint64) arbiter.CandidatePart {
	f.t.Helper()
	part := f.submit(ctx, seq)
	if err := f.promote(ctx, seq, part); err != nil {
		f.t.Fatalf("promotion %d: %v", seq, err)
	}
	f.cleanup(ctx, seq, part)
	return part
}

func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) safeParts(ctx context.Context) []partInfo {
	f.t.Helper()
	return partsInLogicalPartition(activePartsMust(f.t, ctx, f.conn, f.role.cfg.SafeDatabase, f.table()), f.schema, auditPartitionS)
}

func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) safeRows(ctx context.Context) uint64 {
	f.t.Helper()
	return rowCount(f.t, ctx, f.conn, f.safe())
}

func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) lastAck() arbiter.PromotionAck {
	f.t.Helper()
	acks := f.claims.promotionAcks()
	if len(acks) == 0 {
		f.t.Fatal("no promotion acknowledgement yet")
	}
	return acks[len(acks)-1]
}

// injectSafeTwins copies the partition's hg_safe parts into hg_safe again
// through hg_promote. ATTACH PARTITION FROM keeps hash_of_all_files (spec
// 2026-10-14 §2, M2), so hg_safe then holds an equal-hash twin of every part
// under a name no acknowledgement carries: the state a restart leaves after it
// resurrected the parts a REPLACE PARTITION retired, without the restart. It
// returns the twins' names, sorted.
func (f *ownerAuditFixtureS) injectSafeTwins(ctx context.Context) []string {
	f.t.Helper()
	partition, err := quotePartition(f.schema, auditPartitionS)
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	promote := f.role.cfg.PromoteDatabase + "." + f.table()
	before := f.safeParts(ctx)
	mustExecIntake(f.t, f.conn, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s ATTACH PARTITION %s FROM %s", promote, partition, f.safe()))
	mustExecIntake(f.t, f.conn, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s ATTACH PARTITION %s FROM %s", f.safe(), partition, promote))
	mustExecIntake(f.t, f.conn, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s DROP PARTITION %s", promote, partition))
	twins := diffParts(before, f.safeParts(ctx))
	if len(twins) != len(before) {
		f.t.Fatalf("twins %+v of %+v: want one per part", twins, before)
	}
	hashes := map[string]bool{}
	for _, p := range before {
		hashes[p.PhysHash] = true
	}
	names := make([]string, 0, len(twins))
	for _, p := range twins {
		if !hashes[p.PhysHash] {
			f.t.Fatalf("twin %s has hash_of_all_files %s that no original part has: ATTACH PARTITION FROM did not keep it (see M2)", p.Name, p.PhysHash)
		}
		names = append(names, p.Name)
	}
	slices.Sort(names)
	return names
}

// unacknowledgedPartsS returns, sorted, the active parts ack's inventory does
// not name.
func unacknowledgedPartsS(parts []partInfo, ack arbiter.PromotionAck) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, p := range parts {
		if !slices.ContainsFunc(ack.SafePartitionParts, func(m arbiter.SafePartMapping) bool { return m.SafePartName == p.Name }) {
			out = append(out, p.Name)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}

// TestOwnerAuditReportModeNeverDropsOrHoldsBack: report mode (the default,
// clarification K1) finds the twins and reports them, but drops nothing, holds
// no table and lets the next promotion run into the shadow closure gate exactly
// as before the audit existed.
func TestOwnerAuditReportModeNeverDropsOrHoldsBack(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	f := newOwnerAuditFixtureS(t, requireCH(t), OwnerAuditReport, nil)
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 1)
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 2)
	twins := f.injectSafeTwins(ctx)
	before := f.safeParts(ctx)

	f.role.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)

	if got := f.safeParts(ctx); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, before) {
		t.Fatalf("report mode changed hg_safe:\n before %+v\n after  %+v", before, got)
	}
	if got := f.safeRows(ctx); got != 8 {
		t.Fatalf("safe rows = %d, want 8 (every row served twice)", got)
	}
	stats := f.role.OwnerAuditStats()
	if stats.Mode != OwnerAuditReport || stats.DroppedTwins != 0 || stats.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerStartup] != 1 || len(stats.Unclean) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("stats = %+v", stats)
	}
	if u := stats.Unclean[0]; u.TableID != f.schema.TableID || u.PartitionID != auditPartitionS || u.Reason != OwnerAuditUnacknowledgedPart ||
		!slices.Equal(u.Parts, twins) || u.Trigger != OwnerAuditTriggerStartup || u.At.IsZero() {
		t.Fatalf("finding = %+v, want unacknowledged_part naming %v", u, twins)
	}
	if !f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) {
		t.Fatal("report mode held the table back")
	}
	third := f.submit(ctx, 3)
	err := f.promote(ctx, 3, third)
	if err == nil || errors.Is(err, ErrSafePartitionUnclean) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "shadow closure mismatch") {
		t.Fatalf("third promotion = %v, want the shadow closure gate's refusal", err)
	}
	if got := f.safeParts(ctx); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, before) {
		t.Fatal("report mode dropped a part before the shadow")
	}
	if s := f.role.OwnerAuditStats(); s.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerPromotion] != 3 || s.DroppedTwins != 0 || s.Unclean[0].Trigger != OwnerAuditTriggerPromotion {
		t.Fatalf("stats after the third promotion = %+v", s)
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditRepairDropsResurrectedTwinsBeforeTheShadow: in repair mode the
// promotion's audit drops every twin of an acknowledged part with DROP PART
// (K2), and the promotion then publishes exactly base and candidate. The
// harness serves no GetPartitionStates, so every audit uses the local
// inventory and counts the failed read (K3).
func TestOwnerAuditRepairDropsResurrectedTwinsBeforeTheShadow(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	f := newOwnerAuditFixtureS(t, requireCH(t), OwnerAuditRepair, nil)
	f.role.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)
	if !f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) {
		t.Fatal("an empty hg_safe is unclean")
	}
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 1)
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 2)
	twins := f.injectSafeTwins(ctx)

	third := f.submit(ctx, 3)
	if err := f.promote(ctx, 3, third); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("third promotion: %v", err)
	}

	if got := f.safeRows(ctx); got != 6 {
		t.Fatalf("safe rows = %d, want 6", got)
	}
	stats := f.role.OwnerAuditStats()
	if stats.DroppedTwins != uint64(len(twins)) || len(stats.Unclean) != 0 || stats.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerPromotion] != 3 || stats.FSMUnavailable < 3 {
		t.Fatalf("stats = %+v, want %d twins dropped, nothing unclean, 3 promotion audits on the local inventory", stats, len(twins))
	}
	ack := f.lastAck()
	if !ack.Applied || ack.PromotionSeq != 3 || len(ack.SafePartitionParts) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("third acknowledgement = %+v", ack)
	}
	assertCompleteSafeInventory(t, ctx, f.role, f.schema, auditPartitionS, ack.SafePartitionParts)
	for _, p := range f.safeParts(ctx) {
		if slices.Contains(twins, p.Name) {
			t.Fatalf("twin %s is still active", p.Name)
		}
	}
	if !f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) {
		t.Fatal("the repaired table is held")
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditRepairHoldsAnUncleanPartitionAndBuildsNoShadow: a part without
// an acknowledged twin (a foreign insert) is never dropped; repair mode refuses
// the promotion with ErrSafePartitionUnclean before the shadow, holds the table,
// and the redelivered promotion goes through once an operator removed the part.
func TestOwnerAuditRepairHoldsAnUncleanPartitionAndBuildsNoShadow(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn := requireCH(t)
	f := newOwnerAuditFixtureS(t, conn, OwnerAuditRepair, nil)
	f.role.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 1)
	mustExecIntake(t, conn, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s (_hg_row_id, p, v) VALUES (unhex('%064x'), 'p0', 99)", f.safe(), 99))
	foreign := unacknowledgedPartsS(f.safeParts(ctx), f.lastAck())
	if len(foreign) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("foreign parts = %v, want one", foreign)
	}
	second := f.submit(ctx, 2)

	err := f.promote(ctx, 2, second)

	if !errors.Is(err, ErrSafePartitionUnclean) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), string(OwnerAuditUnacknowledgedPart)) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), foreign[0]) {
		t.Fatalf("promotion = %v, want ErrSafePartitionUnclean naming %s", err, foreign[0])
	}
	if got := len(f.claims.promotionAcks()); got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("acknowledgements = %d, want only the first", got)
	}
	if got := f.safeRows(ctx); got != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("safe rows = %d, want 3 (unchanged)", got)
	}
	assertNoPromotePartition(t, ctx, f.role, f.schema, auditPartitionS)
	if f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) {
		t.Fatal("repair mode serves an unclean table")
	}
	if s := f.role.OwnerAuditStats(); len(s.Unclean) != 1 || s.Unclean[0].Reason != OwnerAuditUnacknowledgedPart || !slices.Equal(s.Unclean[0].Parts, foreign) ||
		s.Unclean[0].Trigger != OwnerAuditTriggerPromotion || s.DroppedTwins != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stats = %+v", s)
	}
	mustExecIntake(t, conn, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s DROP PART '%s'", f.safe(), foreign[0]))
	if err := f.promote(ctx, 2, second); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("redelivered promotion after the operator's repair: %v", err)
	}
	if got := f.safeRows(ctx); got != 4 || !f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) {
		t.Fatalf("after the repair: %d safe rows, clean %v; want 4 and clean", got, f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID))
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditTableReadyWaitsForTheAuditInRepairMode: TableReady folds the
// audit in (contract §3): in repair mode a ready table is not ready until its
// startup audit completed, and not while it is unclean, so the host answers it
// Pending; report mode leaves TableReady as it was. Without a local inventory
// and with the arbiter unreadable, a partition with parts has no reference
// (K3).
func TestOwnerAuditTableReadyWaitsForTheAuditInRepairMode(t *testing.T) {
	conn := requireCH(t)
	requireKeeperS(t, conn)
	for _, mode := range []OwnerAuditMode{OwnerAuditRepair, OwnerAuditReport} {
		t.Run(string(mode), func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx := context.Background()
			cfg := testConfigS(t)
			setUniqueDatabases(t, &cfg)
			cfg.SchemaSource = ddl.SchemaSourceNetworkState
			cfg.NodeID = "snode-" + strings.TrimPrefix(cfg.UnsafeDatabase, "hg_unsafe_")
			cfg.OwnerAudit = mode
			t.Cleanup(func() {
				for _, db := range []string{cfg.UnsafeDatabase, cfg.SafeDatabase, cfg.PromoteDatabase} {
					_ = conn.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+db+" SYNC")
				}
			})
			role, _ := newIntakeHarness(t, conn, cfg)
			table := cfg.Tables[0].TableID
			if err := role.ensureProtocolTables(ctx); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("ensure protocol tables: %v", err)
			}
			repair := mode == OwnerAuditRepair
			if got := role.TableReady(table); got == repair {
				t.Fatalf("TableReady before the startup audit = %v, want %v", got, !repair)
			}
			role.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)
			if !role.TableReady(table) {
				t.Fatal("TableReady is false after a clean startup audit")
			}
			mustExecIntake(t, conn, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s.%s (_hg_row_id, v) VALUES (unhex('%064x'), 7)", cfg.SafeDatabase, CHTableName(table), 7))
			role.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)
			if got := role.TableReady(table); got == repair {
				t.Fatalf("TableReady with an unclean partition = %v, want %v", got, !repair)
			}
			s := role.OwnerAuditStats()
			if len(s.Unclean) != 1 || s.Unclean[0].Reason != OwnerAuditNoAcknowledgedInventory || s.Unclean[0].PartitionID != "all" || s.FSMUnavailable != 2 {
				t.Fatalf("stats = %+v, want one no_acknowledged_inventory finding of partition all and two failed arbiter reads", s)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditFSMAheadIsUncleanAndDropsNothing: an arbiter that recorded an
// applied promotion past this SNode's watermark means the local state is behind;
// the partition is unclean and its twins are not dropped (contract §3).
func TestOwnerAuditFSMAheadIsUncleanAndDropsNothing(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	fsm := &fsmPartitionsFakeS{}
	f := newOwnerAuditFixtureS(t, requireCH(t), OwnerAuditRepair, fsm)
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 1)
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 2)
	ahead := fsmStateOfAckS(f.lastAck())
	ahead.PublishSeq = 9
	fsm.set(ahead)
	f.injectSafeTwins(ctx)
	before := f.safeParts(ctx)

	f.role.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)

	if got := f.safeParts(ctx); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, before) {
		t.Fatal("twins were dropped although the arbiter is ahead")
	}
	s := f.role.OwnerAuditStats()
	if s.DroppedTwins != 0 || s.FSMUnavailable != 0 || len(s.Unclean) != 1 || s.Unclean[0].Reason != OwnerAuditFSMAhead {
		t.Fatalf("stats = %+v, want one fsm_ahead finding", s)
	}
	if f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) || fsm.readCount() < 3 {
		t.Fatalf("clean %v, arbiter reads %d; want held and one read per promotion and pass", f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID), fsm.readCount())
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditTakesTheArbitersInventoryWhenItIsNewer: a state written before
// acked_safe_inventories whose last acknowledgement was a base CAS refusal has
// no local inventory; the arbiter's SafeParts, at a publish seq the watermark
// covers, are the reference, and the twins are dropped against them.
func TestOwnerAuditTakesTheArbitersInventoryWhenItIsNewer(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	fsm := &fsmPartitionsFakeS{}
	f := newOwnerAuditFixtureS(t, requireCH(t), OwnerAuditRepair, fsm)
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 1)
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 2)
	ack := f.lastAck()
	fsm.set(fsmStateOfAckS(ack))
	k := partitionKey{Table: f.schema.TableID, Partition: auditPartitionS}
	ks := key(k.Table, k.Partition)
	f.role.state.mu.Lock()
	delete(f.role.state.s.AckedSafeInventories, ks)
	f.role.state.s.LastAcks[ks] = arbiter.PromotionAck{NodeID: f.role.cfg.NodeID, PromotionSeq: 3, TableID: k.Table, PartitionID: k.Partition, Detail: "base CAS mismatch"}
	f.role.state.s.Watermarks[ks] = 3
	f.role.state.mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := f.role.state.AckedSafeInventory(k); ok {
		t.Fatal("the fixture still has a local inventory")
	}
	twins := f.injectSafeTwins(ctx)

	f.role.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)

	s := f.role.OwnerAuditStats()
	if s.DroppedTwins != uint64(len(twins)) || len(s.Unclean) != 0 || s.FSMUnavailable != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stats = %+v, want the %d twins dropped against the arbiter's inventory", s, len(twins))
	}
	if got := f.safeRows(ctx); got != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("safe rows = %d, want 4", got)
	}
	assertCompleteSafeInventory(t, ctx, f.role, f.schema, auditPartitionS, ack.SafePartitionParts)
}

// TestOwnerAuditSkipsAPartitionWithAnUnresolvedIntent: a startup pass skips a
// partition whose promotion intent is journaled and not finalized and reports
// unresolved_intent (clarification K4); the redelivered promotion reconciles the
// published partition, which clears the finding.
func TestOwnerAuditSkipsAPartitionWithAnUnresolvedIntent(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	f := newOwnerAuditFixtureS(t, requireCH(t), OwnerAuditRepair, nil)
	f.role.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)
	f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 1)
	second := f.submit(ctx, 2)
	base := f.role.d.Conn
	failing := &failAfterReplaceConn{Conn: base}
	f.role.d.Conn = failing
	if err := f.promote(ctx, 2, second); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "injected post-REPLACE failure") {
		t.Fatalf("promotion = %v, want the injected post-REPLACE failure", err)
	}
	f.role.d.Conn = base
	if _, ok := f.role.state.PendingPromotion(partitionKey{Table: f.schema.TableID, Partition: auditPartitionS}); !ok {
		t.Fatal("the fixture left no unresolved intent")
	}
	before := f.safeParts(ctx)

	f.role.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)

	s := f.role.OwnerAuditStats()
	if len(s.Unclean) != 1 || s.Unclean[0].Reason != OwnerAuditUnresolvedIntent || s.Unclean[0].Trigger != OwnerAuditTriggerStartup || s.DroppedTwins != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stats = %+v, want one unresolved_intent finding", s)
	}
	if got := f.safeParts(ctx); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, before) || f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) {
		t.Fatal("the pass touched a partition with an unresolved intent, or does not hold it")
	}
	if err := f.promote(ctx, 2, second); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("redelivered promotion: %v", err)
	}
	if s := f.role.OwnerAuditStats(); len(s.Unclean) != 0 || !f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) {
		t.Fatalf("after the finalized promotion: %+v", s)
	}
	if ack := f.lastAck(); !ack.Applied || ack.PromotionSeq != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("acknowledgement = %+v, want promotion 2 applied", ack)
	}
}
```

Create `snode/owner_audit_restart_test.go`:

```go
package snode

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/chrestart"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/chtest"
)

// requireRestartableCHS returns a connection to CH_RESTART_ADDR: a ClickHouse
// whose container restarts itself (docker --restart always, fixed host port)
// and that no other test target shares.
func requireRestartableCHS(t *testing.T) clickhouse.Conn {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("ARBITER_CH_RESTART") != "1" {
		t.Skip("set ARBITER_CH_RESTART=1 and CH_RESTART_ADDR (a ClickHouse whose container restarts itself) to run")
	}
	addr := os.Getenv("CH_RESTART_ADDR")
	if addr == "" {
		t.Fatal("ARBITER_CH_RESTART=1 requires CH_RESTART_ADDR")
	}
	return chtest.Open(t, addr)
}

// waitUptimeS waits until the server has been up for at least d, so that a
// restart moves its start time by more than the watcher's skew.
func waitUptimeS(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, d time.Duration) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d + time.Minute)
	for {
		started, err := chrestart.StartedAt(ctx, conn, time.Now())
		if err == nil && time.Since(started) >= d {
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("server not up for %v after a minute (last error %v)", d, err)
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Second)
	}
}

// killClickHouseS aborts the server with SYSTEM KILL, the abrupt restart that
// M3 pins as resurrecting the parts a REPLACE PARTITION retired, and waits until
// it answers again with a later start time.
func killClickHouseS(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) {
	t.Helper()
	before, err := chrestart.StartedAt(ctx, conn, time.Now())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("start time before the kill: %v", err)
	}
	// The server dies while it answers, so the statement's own error is expected.
	_ = conn.Exec(ctx, "SYSTEM KILL")
	deadline := time.Now().Add(2 * time.Minute)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
		probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
		after, err := chrestart.StartedAt(probeCtx, conn, time.Now())
		cancel()
		if err == nil && after.After(before.Add(chrestart.DefaultRestartSkew)) {
			return
		}
	}
	t.Fatal("ClickHouse did not come back with a later start time within 2m: does its container run with --restart always?")
}

// waitWritableS waits until the hg_unsafe replica accepts writes again: after a
// restart a ReplicatedMergeTree is read-only until its Keeper session is back.
func waitWritableS(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, db, table string) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Minute)
	for {
		var readonly uint8
		err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT is_readonly FROM system.replicas WHERE database = ? AND table = ?", db, table).Scan(&readonly)
		if err == nil && readonly == 0 {
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("%s.%s is still read-only a minute after the restart (last error %v)", db, table, err)
		}
		time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// TestOwnerAuditRepairsResurrectedPartsAcrossAClickHouseRestart is the
// restart-resurrection hazard end to end (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §2, §14,
// §17 "the owner audit across a ClickHouse-only restart"): the second promotion's
// REPLACE PARTITION retires the first promotion's part, an abrupt restart inside
// old_parts_lifetime reactivates it beside its equal-hash replacement, the
// watcher sees the start time move and the restart pass audits the table. Repair
// mode drops the twin, the rows are back and the third promotion goes through;
// report mode drops nothing and reports the twin.
func TestOwnerAuditRepairsResurrectedPartsAcrossAClickHouseRestart(t *testing.T) {
	conn := requireRestartableCHS(t)
	for _, mode := range []OwnerAuditMode{OwnerAuditRepair, OwnerAuditReport} {
		t.Run(string(mode), func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			f := newOwnerAuditFixtureS(t, conn, mode, nil)
			f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 1)
			f.promoteAndClean(ctx, 2)
			ack := f.lastAck()
			if got := f.safeRows(ctx); got != 4 {
				t.Fatalf("safe rows after two promotions = %d, want 4", got)
			}
			stop := f.role.startOwnerAudit(ctx)
			defer stop()
			if s := f.role.OwnerAuditStats(); s.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerStartup] != 1 || len(s.Unclean) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("startup audit = %+v, want one clean run", s)
			}

			waitUptimeS(t, ctx, conn, 2*chrestart.DefaultRestartSkew)
			killClickHouseS(t, ctx, conn)
			waitForS(t, 2*time.Minute, "the owner audit after the ClickHouse restart", func() bool {
				s := f.role.OwnerAuditStats()
				return s.ClickHouseRestarts >= 1 && s.Runs[OwnerAuditTriggerClickHouseRestart] >= 1 && !f.role.audit.due()
			})

			stats := f.role.OwnerAuditStats()
			switch mode {
			case OwnerAuditRepair:
				if stats.DroppedTwins != 1 || len(stats.Unclean) != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("stats = %+v, want the one resurrected twin dropped and nothing unclean (no resurrection at all? see M3)", stats)
				}
				if got := f.safeRows(ctx); got != 4 {
					t.Fatalf("safe rows after the repair = %d, want 4", got)
				}
				assertCompleteSafeInventory(t, ctx, f.role, f.schema, auditPartitionS, ack.SafePartitionParts)
				if !f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) {
					t.Fatal("the repaired table is held")
				}
				waitWritableS(t, ctx, conn, f.role.cfg.UnsafeDatabase, f.table())
				third := f.submit(ctx, 3)
				if err := f.promote(ctx, 3, third); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("third promotion after the repair: %v", err)
				}
				if got := f.safeRows(ctx); got != 6 {
					t.Fatalf("safe rows after the third promotion = %d, want 6", got)
				}
			case OwnerAuditReport:
				if stats.DroppedTwins != 0 || len(stats.Unclean) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("stats = %+v, want one finding and no drop (no resurrection at all? see M3)", stats)
				}
				u := stats.Unclean[0]
				if u.Reason != OwnerAuditUnacknowledgedPart || u.Trigger != OwnerAuditTriggerClickHouseRestart || len(u.Parts) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("finding = %+v, want one resurrected part found by the restart pass", u)
				}
				if got := f.safeRows(ctx); got != 6 {
					t.Fatalf("safe rows = %d, want 6: the resurrected part's rows are served twice and report mode leaves them", got)
				}
				var twin partInfo
				for _, p := range f.safeParts(ctx) {
					if p.Name == u.Parts[0] {
						twin = p
					}
				}
				if twin.Name == "" || !slices.ContainsFunc(ack.SafePartitionParts, func(m arbiter.SafePartMapping) bool {
					return m.PartPhysHash == twin.PhysHash && m.SafePartName != twin.Name
				}) {
					t.Fatalf("the resurrected part %+v is not the equal-hash twin of an acknowledged part %+v", twin, ack.SafePartitionParts)
				}
				if !f.role.OwnerAuditClean(f.schema.TableID) {
					t.Fatal("report mode held the table back")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
```

```go
// OwnerAuditStats returns a copy of the owner audit's counters and current
// findings for the host to export.
func (r *Role) OwnerAuditStats() OwnerAuditStats {
	return r.audit.stats(r.ownerAuditMode())
}

// OwnerAuditClean reports whether the owner audit lets tableID be served. It
// is false only in repair mode, while one of the table's hg_safe partitions
// has an unclean finding or while the table's first audit after startup or
// after a ClickHouse restart has not completed. TableReady folds it in.
func (r *Role) OwnerAuditClean(tableID string) bool {
	if r.ownerAuditMode() != OwnerAuditRepair {
		return true
	}
	return !r.audit.blocks(tableID)
}

func (r *Role) ownerAuditMode() OwnerAuditMode {
	if r.cfg.OwnerAudit == OwnerAuditRepair {
		return OwnerAuditRepair
	}
	return OwnerAuditReport
}

// ownerAuditProbeInterval is Config.OwnerAuditProbeInterval, or its default
// for a Role that New did not validate.
func (r *Role) ownerAuditProbeInterval() time.Duration {
	if r.cfg.OwnerAuditProbeInterval > 0 {
		return r.cfg.OwnerAuditProbeInterval
	}
	return DefaultOwnerAuditProbeInterval
}

// ownerAuditFSMTimeout is Config.OwnerAuditFSMTimeout, or its default.
func (r *Role) ownerAuditFSMTimeout() time.Duration {
	if r.cfg.OwnerAuditFSMTimeout > 0 {
		return r.cfg.OwnerAuditFSMTimeout
	}
	return DefaultOwnerAuditFSMTimeout
}

// auditBeforeShadow is the promotion trigger. buildAndReplace runs it under
// promotionLock(k), after handlePromote reconciled any promotion intent and
// passed the base CAS, and before prepareShadow copies hg_safe into the
// shadow. Report mode never refuses: a finding or an audit error is logged
// and counted and the promotion goes on as before. Repair mode refuses an
// unclean partition with ErrSafePartitionUnclean, so no shadow is built and
// the subscription redelivers the command.
func (r *Role) auditBeforeShadow(ctx context.Context, cmd arbiter.PromoteSafePartition, sch payloadexec.TableSchema, table string) error {
	if r.audit == nil {
		return nil
	}
	k := partitionKey{Table: cmd.TableID, Partition: cmd.PartitionID}
	fsm, available := r.ownerAuditFSM(ctx, cmd.TableID, cmd.PartitionID)
	finding, err := r.auditPartitionLocked(ctx, OwnerAuditTriggerPromotion, sch, table, k, fsm, available)
	r.audit.ran(OwnerAuditTriggerPromotion, r.now())
	repair := r.ownerAuditMode() == OwnerAuditRepair
	switch {
	case err != nil && repair:
		return fmt.Errorf("owner audit before promotion %d: %w", cmd.PromotionSeq, err)
	case err != nil:
		r.d.Logger.Error("owner audit before the shadow build failed; report mode lets the promotion continue",
			"promotion_seq", cmd.PromotionSeq, "table", k.Table, "partition", k.Partition, "err", err)
	case finding != nil && repair:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s/%s before promotion %d: %s [%s]", ErrSafePartitionUnclean,
			k.Table, k.Partition, cmd.PromotionSeq, finding.Reason, strings.Join(finding.Parts, ", "))
	}
	return nil
}

// startOwnerAudit runs the startup audit, then watches ClickHouse's start
// time: a restart makes a full pass due, and the worker runs every due pass,
// retrying one whose tables did not all complete each probe interval. The
// start time is read before the startup pass and is the watcher's baseline,
// so a restart during that pass is caught. stop cancels both goroutines and
// waits for them. Without a ClickHouse connection there is nothing to audit.
func (r *Role) startOwnerAudit(ctx context.Context) (stop func()) {
	if r.audit == nil || r.d.Conn == nil {
		return func() {}
	}
	interval := r.ownerAuditProbeInterval()
	probeCtx, cancelProbe := context.WithTimeout(ctx, interval)
	baseline, err := chrestart.StartedAt(probeCtx, r.d.Conn, r.now())
	cancelProbe()
	if err != nil {
		r.d.Logger.Warn("owner audit: the ClickHouse start time is unreadable; the first successful probe becomes the baseline", "err", err)
		baseline = time.Time{}
	}
	r.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	watcher := &chrestart.Watcher{Interval: interval, Skew: chrestart.DefaultRestartSkew, Now: r.now,
		OnRestart: r.ownerAuditRestarted, Baseline: baseline}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(2)
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		watcher.Run(ctx, r.d.Conn)
	}()
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		r.runOwnerAuditWorker(ctx, interval)
	}()
	return func() {
		cancel()
		wg.Wait()
	}
}

// runOwnerAuditWorker runs a full pass whenever one is due: at once after a
// restart (the wake), and every interval while a pass did not complete. In
// repair mode, when no pass is due, it re-audits every interval the partitions
// that hold their tables (reauditFindings).
func (r *Role) runOwnerAuditWorker(ctx context.Context, interval time.Duration) {
	timer := time.NewTimer(interval)
	defer timer.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-r.audit.wake:
		case <-timer.C:
		}
		switch {
		case r.audit.due():
			r.runOwnerAuditPass(ctx)
		case r.ownerAuditMode() == OwnerAuditRepair:
			r.reauditFindings(ctx)
		}
		timer.Reset(interval)
	}
}

// reauditFindings audits again each partition with a finding, under the
// trigger that found it, so that in repair mode a partition an operator
// repaired, or whose reference the arbiter can supply again, stops holding its
// table without waiting for its next promotion or a restart. It takes no table
// set, so it holds no other table, and it is not a run: OwnerAuditStats.Runs
// counts the full passes and the promotion audits only. A finding of a table
// this SNode no longer serves is forgotten (nothing serves that table here).
func (r *Role) reauditFindings(ctx context.Context) {
	tables := r.audit.findingTables()
	if len(tables) == 0 {
		return
	}
	r.auditPassMu.Lock()
	defer r.auditPassMu.Unlock()
	served := r.ownerAuditTables()
	fsmDown := false
	for _, tableID := range tables {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return
		}
		if !slices.Contains(served, tableID) {
			r.audit.forgetTable(tableID)
			continue
		}
		if err := r.reauditTable(ctx, tableID, &fsmDown); err != nil {
			r.d.Logger.Warn("owner audit: re-auditing an unclean table failed; the next probe interval retries it", "table", tableID, "err", err)
		}
	}
}

// reauditTable re-audits the partitions of tableID that have a finding, with
// one arbiter read (auditTable's *fsmDown rule).
func (r *Role) reauditTable(ctx context.Context, tableID string, fsmDown *bool) error {
	sch, err := r.schemaFor(tableID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	table := CHTableName(tableID)
	if err := r.loadSafeTable(ctx, table); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var fsm map[string]wire.PartitionState
	available := false
	if *fsmDown {
		r.audit.countFSMUnavailable()
	} else if fsm, available = r.ownerAuditFSM(ctx, tableID, ""); !available {
		*fsmDown = true
	}
	for _, id := range r.audit.findingPartitions(tableID) {
		k := partitionKey{Table: tableID, Partition: id}
		f, ok := r.audit.finding(k)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if err := r.auditPassPartition(ctx, f.Trigger, sch, table, k, fsm, available); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// ownerAuditRestarted is the watcher's OnRestart: it counts the restart and
// holds every table (in repair mode) until the restart pass audited it.
func (r *Role) ownerAuditRestarted(_ context.Context, previous, current time.Time) {
	r.audit.restarted()
	r.d.Logger.Warn("ClickHouse restarted; the owner audit re-audits every hg_safe partition",
		"previous_start", previous, "current_start", current, "mode", string(r.ownerAuditMode()))
}

// runOwnerAuditPass audits every hg_safe partition of every table this SNode
// serves (stateRootTables): the startup pass, the pass after a ClickHouse
// restart, and their retries. It never fails the role: a table whose audit
// meets a ClickHouse or schema error stays pending, held in repair mode,
// until a later pass completes it. Once one arbiter read of the pass fails,
// the pass audits its remaining tables on their own inventories without
// asking again, so an unreachable arbiter costs the pass (and the startup
// that waits for it) one OwnerAuditFSMTimeout, not one per table
// (clarification K3).
func (r *Role) runOwnerAuditPass(ctx context.Context) {
	if r.audit == nil || r.d.Conn == nil {
		return
	}
	r.auditPassMu.Lock()
	defer r.auditPassMu.Unlock()
	tables := r.ownerAuditTables()
	trigger := r.audit.begin(tables)
	fsmDown := false
	for _, tableID := range tables {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return
		}
		if err := r.auditTable(ctx, trigger, tableID, &fsmDown); err != nil {
			r.d.Logger.Error("owner audit of a table failed; the next pass retries it", "trigger", trigger, "table", tableID, "err", err)
			continue
		}
		r.audit.tableDone(tableID)
	}
	r.audit.ran(trigger, r.now())
}

func (r *Role) ownerAuditTables() []string {
	_, hashes := r.stateRootTables()
	return sortedTableIDs(hashes)
}

// auditTable audits every partition of tableID that has active hg_safe parts,
// an acknowledged inventory, an arbiter state or a finding, with one arbiter
// read for the whole table. *fsmDown is the pass's memory of a failed arbiter
// read: while it is set the table is audited without one (and counted as
// FSMUnavailable), and a failed read sets it.
func (r *Role) auditTable(ctx context.Context, trigger, tableID string, fsmDown *bool) error {
	sch, err := r.schemaFor(tableID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	table := CHTableName(tableID)
	if err := r.loadSafeTable(ctx, table); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var fsm map[string]wire.PartitionState
	available := false
	if *fsmDown {
		r.audit.countFSMUnavailable()
	} else if fsm, available = r.ownerAuditFSM(ctx, tableID, ""); !available {
		*fsmDown = true
	}
	parts, err := activeParts(ctx, r.d.Conn, r.cfg.SafeDatabase, table)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("list hg_safe parts of %s: %w", tableID, err)
	}
	partitions := map[string]bool{}
	for _, p := range parts {
		partitions[logicalPartitionID(sch, p)] = true
	}
	for _, id := range r.state.ackedInventoryPartitions(tableID) {
		partitions[id] = true
	}
	for id, state := range fsm {
		if state.PublishSeq > 0 || len(state.SafeParts) > 0 {
			partitions[id] = true
		}
	}
	for _, id := range r.audit.findingPartitions(tableID) {
		partitions[id] = true
	}
	for _, id := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(partitions)) {
		if err := r.auditPassPartition(ctx, trigger, sch, table, partitionKey{Table: tableID, Partition: id}, fsm, available); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// auditPassPartition audits one partition of a full pass under its promotion
// lock. A partition with an unresolved promotion intent is skipped and
// reported (clarification K4): the intent's redelivery reconciles it.
func (r *Role) auditPassPartition(ctx context.Context, trigger string, sch payloadexec.TableSchema, table string, k partitionKey, fsm map[string]wire.PartitionState, fsmAvailable bool) error {
	mu := r.promotionLock(k)
	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	if intent, ok := r.state.PendingPromotion(k); ok {
		r.recordOwnerAudit(trigger, k, ownerAuditReference{}, ownerAuditPlan{Reason: OwnerAuditUnresolvedIntent, Detail: fmt.Sprintf(
			"promotion %d is journaled before REPLACE PARTITION and not finalized; its redelivery reconciles it, and one it cannot reconcile is a runbook repair",
			intent.PromotionSeq)})
		return nil
	}
	_, err := r.auditPartitionLocked(ctx, trigger, sch, table, k, fsm, fsmAvailable)
	return err
}

// auditPartitionLocked audits partition k of table (its physical name)
// against its reference and, in repair mode, drops resurrected twins. fsm is
// the arbiter's answer for k's table, used only when fsmAvailable. The caller
// holds promotionLock(k). It returns the recorded finding, nil when clean.
func (r *Role) auditPartitionLocked(ctx context.Context, trigger string, sch payloadexec.TableSchema, table string, k partitionKey, fsm map[string]wire.PartitionState, fsmAvailable bool) (*OwnerAuditFinding, error) {
	in := ownerAuditInputs{Watermark: r.state.Watermark(k), FSMAvailable: fsmAvailable}
	if inv, ok := r.state.AckedSafeInventory(k); ok {
		in.Local = &inv
	}
	if state, ok := fsm[k.Partition]; ok {
		in.FSM = &state
	}
	ref, haveRef, refusal, detail := ownerAuditReferenceFor(in)
	if err := r.loadSafeTable(ctx, table); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	active, err := r.safePartitionParts(ctx, sch, table, k.Partition)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list hg_safe parts of %s/%s: %w", k.Table, k.Partition, err)
	}
	plan := ownerAuditPlan{Reason: refusal, Parts: activePartNames(active), Detail: detail}
	if refusal == "" {
		plan = planOwnerAudit(ref, haveRef, active)
	}
	if len(plan.Drop) > 0 && r.ownerAuditMode() == OwnerAuditRepair {
		if plan, err = r.dropResurrectedTwins(ctx, trigger, sch, table, k, ref, plan); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return r.recordOwnerAudit(trigger, k, ref, plan), nil
}

// dropResurrectedTwins drops, in repair mode, the twins plan names with ALTER
// TABLE ... DROP PART (clarification K2: on 26.3 this leaves exactly the
// acknowledged parts active and no empty covering part, and the dropped
// parts stay dropped across a restart; M11 pins the deployed image), then
// audits the partition again against the same reference. Anything but a
// clean result keeps it unclean, and nothing is dropped twice.
func (r *Role) dropResurrectedTwins(ctx context.Context, trigger string, sch payloadexec.TableSchema, table string, k partitionKey, ref ownerAuditReference, plan ownerAuditPlan) (ownerAuditPlan, error) {
	for _, name := range plan.Drop {
		if err := r.exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s.%s DROP PART '%s'", r.cfg.SafeDatabase, table, escapeSQLString(name))); err != nil {
			return ownerAuditPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("drop resurrected hg_safe twin %s of %s/%s: %w", name, k.Table, k.Partition, err)
		}
		r.audit.countDropped()
		r.d.Logger.Warn("owner audit dropped a resurrected hg_safe twin",
			"trigger", trigger, "table", k.Table, "partition", k.Partition, "part", name, "reference", ref.Source, "reference_seq", ref.Seq)
	}
	active, err := r.safePartitionParts(ctx, sch, table, k.Partition)
	if err != nil {
		return ownerAuditPlan{}, fmt.Errorf("list hg_safe parts of %s/%s after the repair: %w", k.Table, k.Partition, err)
	}
	after := planOwnerAudit(ref, true, active)
	if len(after.Drop) > 0 {
		after.Drop = nil
		after.Detail = "twins are still active after DROP PART"
	}
	return after, nil
}

// recordOwnerAudit records plan as k's current verdict: a clean plan clears
// the finding, an unclean one replaces it and, unless it repeats the finding
// it replaces (a re-audit, a redelivered promotion), is logged at error level.
func (r *Role) recordOwnerAudit(trigger string, k partitionKey, ref ownerAuditReference, plan ownerAuditPlan) *OwnerAuditFinding {
	if plan.clean() {
		r.audit.clear(k)
		return nil
	}
	f := OwnerAuditFinding{TableID: k.Table, PartitionID: k.Partition, Reason: plan.Reason, Parts: slices.Clone(plan.Parts), Trigger: trigger, At: r.now()}
	if !r.audit.set(f) {
		return &f
	}
	msg := "owner audit: hg_safe partition is unclean"
	r.d.Logger.Error(msg, "mode", string(r.ownerAuditMode()), "trigger", trigger, "table", k.Table, "partition", k.Partition,
		"reason", string(plan.Reason), "parts", strings.Join(plan.Parts, ","), "twins", strings.Join(plan.Drop, ","),
		"reference", ref.Source, "reference_seq", ref.Seq, "detail", plan.Detail)
	return &f
}

// ownerAuditFSM reads the arbiter's partition states of tableID (one
// partition, or all when partitionID is empty) within OwnerAuditFSMTimeout.
// Any failure, an arbiter without the read included, leaves the audit on this
// SNode's own inventory (clarification K3) and counts FSMUnavailable.
func (r *Role) ownerAuditFSM(ctx context.Context, tableID, partitionID string) (map[string]wire.PartitionState, bool) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, r.ownerAuditFSMTimeout())
	defer cancel()
	states, err := r.d.Client.GetPartitionStates(ctx, wire.PartitionStatesQuery{TableID: tableID, PartitionID: partitionID})
	if err != nil {
		r.audit.countFSMUnavailable()
		level := slog.LevelWarn
		if errors.Is(err, dataplane.ErrStage3ReadsUnavailable) {
			level = slog.LevelDebug
		}
		r.d.Logger.Log(ctx, level, "owner audit: the arbiter's partition states are unavailable; auditing against this SNode's own acknowledged inventory",
			"table", tableID, "partition", partitionID, "err", err)
		return nil, false
	}
	out := make(map[string]wire.PartitionState, len(states.Partitions))
	for _, p := range states.Partitions {
		out[p.PartitionID] = p
	}
	return out, true
}

// loadSafeTable makes sure the table's hg_safe storage is loaded before the
// audit reads system.parts. After a restart ClickHouse may accept queries while
// it still loads tables (async_load_databases), and system.parts lists no part
// of a table it has not loaded, which would read as every acknowledged part
// missing; a query on the table waits for its load. A table or database that
// does not exist yet has no parts.
func (r *Role) loadSafeTable(ctx context.Context, table string) error {
	err := r.d.Conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("SELECT 1 FROM %s.%s LIMIT 0", r.cfg.SafeDatabase, table))
	var exception *clickhouseproto.Exception
	if err == nil || (errors.As(err, &exception) && (exception.Code == int32(chproto.ErrUnknownTable) || exception.Code == int32(chproto.ErrUnknownDatabase))) {
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("load %s.%s: %w", r.cfg.SafeDatabase, table, err)
}

func (r *Role) safePartitionParts(ctx context.Context, sch payloadexec.TableSchema, table, partitionID string) ([]partInfo, error) {
	parts, err := activeParts(ctx, r.d.Conn, r.cfg.SafeDatabase, table)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return partsInLogicalPartition(parts, sch, partitionID), nil
}
```

```markdown
The owner SNode audits its `hg_safe` (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §14): before building each promotion's shadow, at startup and after every ClickHouse restart (`dataplane/chrestart`, from `uptime()`), it compares each partition's active parts, by name and `hash_of_all_files`, with the newer of its own last acknowledged inventory and the arbiter's `SafeParts` (`GetPartitionStates`). The local inventory is `state.json`'s `acked_safe_inventories`, omitted while empty: a v0.14.1 state derives it from `last_acks` and a v0.14.1 binary ignores it (a downgrade to v0.14.1 forgets it at its next state write; after a re-upgrade it is derived again from an applied `last_acks` entry, else the arbiter's inventory is the reference). `Config.OwnerAudit` is `report` (the default) or `repair`. Report mode logs each unclean partition at error level and counts it in `OwnerAuditStats` but never drops a part and never holds a table. Repair mode drops, with `ALTER TABLE ... DROP PART`, each equal-hash twin whose name the reference does not carry when another member of its group carries one and dropping the twins leaves exactly the reference; otherwise it drops nothing and holds the partition: `TableReady` and `OwnerAuditClean` are false for its table (the host answers it Pending) and its promotions fail with `ErrSafePartitionUnclean` before the shadow until an audit finds it clean (repair mode re-audits each unclean partition every `Config.OwnerAuditProbeInterval`); a table is also held until its first audit after startup or a restart completes. An arbiter that does not serve `GetPartitionStates`, or does not answer within `Config.OwnerAuditFSMTimeout` (default 5s), leaves the audit on the local inventory and counts `FSMUnavailable` (after one failed read a full pass asks no more for its other tables); the arbiter past the SNode's own promotion watermark is `fsm_ahead` and drops nothing. A partition with an unresolved promotion intent is skipped and reported `unresolved_intent`. The restart probe runs every `Config.OwnerAuditProbeInterval` (default 5s, at least 1s); the SNode's ClickHouse address must reach a single server.
```
