```go
package chmechanics

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"testing"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
)

// unsafeIntent is p's hg_unsafe ReplicatedMergeTree intent for sch: replica
// p.NodeID at ddl.ZooKeeperPath(p, sch.TableID), with ddl.UnsafeSettings.
func unsafeIntent(t *testing.T, p ddl.Pinned, sch payloadexec.TableSchema) ddl.TableIntent {
	t.Helper()
	unsafe, _, _, err := ddl.Intents(p, sch)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("protocol intents for %s: %v", sch.TableID, err)
	}
	return unsafe
}

// keeperNames lists the children of a Keeper path through system.zookeeper.
func keeperNames(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, path string) []string {
	t.Helper()
	rows, err := conn.Query(context.Background(), "SELECT name FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = ? ORDER BY name", path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("system.zookeeper %s: %v", path, err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var name string
		if err := rows.Scan(&name); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("scan system.zookeeper %s: %v", path, err)
		}
		out = append(out, name)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("system.zookeeper %s: %v", path, err)
	}
	return out
}

// TestMechanics_OptimizeOnANonOwnerReplicaMergesTheOwnersParts (M9) pins the
// merge guard's residual gap (spec §2, §18; housegate CLAUDE.md merge-guard
// note): an OPTIMIZE ... FINAL issued on a peer replica of an hg_unsafe table
// merges the owner's parts on the owner although the table pins merges off
// (ddl.UnsafeSettings); the merge keeps the row content, and both replicas
// end with one byte-identical part.
func TestMechanics_OptimizeOnANonOwnerReplicaMergesTheOwnersParts(t *testing.T) {
	env := requireMechanics(t)
	sch := mechanicsSchema(t)
	owner := mechanicsPinned(t)
	owner.NodeID = "owner-" + suffix(t)
	peer := owner
	peer.NodeID = "peer-" + suffix(t)
	ownerUnsafe := unsafeIntent(t, owner, sch)
	peerUnsafe := unsafeIntent(t, peer, sch)
	if ownerUnsafe.ZooKeeperPath != peerUnsafe.ZooKeeperPath {
		t.Fatalf("replicas on different Keeper paths: %s, %s", ownerUnsafe.ZooKeeperPath, peerUnsafe.ZooKeeperPath)
	}
	createTables(t, env.A, env.AAddr, ownerUnsafe)
	createTables(t, env.B, env.BAddr, peerUnsafe)
	db, table := ownerUnsafe.Database, ownerUnsafe.Table
	replicated := qualified(db, table)
	mustInsert(t, env.A, db, table, "p0", 0, 1, nil)
	mustInsert(t, env.A, db, table, "p0", 1, 2, nil)
	before := activeParts(t, env.A, db, table, "p0")
	if len(before) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("owner holds %d parts, want 2: %v", len(before), names(before))
	}
	beforeHashes := rowHashes(t, env.A, db, table, sch, before)
	want := sumRowHashes(t, beforeHashes[before[0].Name], beforeHashes[before[1].Name])
	mustExec(t, env.B, "SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA "+replicated)
	if got := activeParts(t, env.B, db, table, "p0"); !slices.Equal(names(got), names(before)) {
		t.Fatalf("the peer holds %v, want the owner's parts %v", names(got), names(before))
	}
	mustExec(t, env.B, fmt.Sprintf("OPTIMIZE TABLE %s PARTITION 'p0' FINAL", replicated))
	var merged []mechPart
	eventually(t, settleTimeout, "the owner holding one merged part", func() (bool, string) {
		mustExec(t, env.A, "SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA "+replicated)
		merged = activeParts(t, env.A, db, table, "p0")
		return len(merged) == 1, fmt.Sprintf("owner parts %v", names(merged))
	})
	if merged[0].Rows != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("the merged part holds %d rows, want 3", merged[0].Rows)
	}
	if got := rowHashes(t, env.A, db, table, sch, merged)[merged[0].Name]; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("the merge changed the row content: %s, want %s", abbreviate(got), abbreviate(want))
	}
	mustExec(t, env.B, "SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA "+replicated)
	peerParts := activeParts(t, env.B, db, table, "p0")
	if !slices.Equal(names(peerParts), names(merged)) || !slices.Equal(physHashes(peerParts), physHashes(merged)) {
		t.Fatalf("the peer holds %+v, the owner %+v: replicas must hold byte-identical parts", peerParts, merged)
	}
}

// TestMechanics_DroppingTheLastReplicaRemovesTheKeeperSubtree (M10) pins why
// the purge switch never nests an incarnation-scoped Keeper path under a
// legacy one (spec §8.8): with a table nested at P/scoped/1 below a legacy
// table's path P, dropping one legacy replica keeps P and the nested table's
// metadata, and dropping the last legacy replica removes P and everything
// below it.
func TestMechanics_DroppingTheLastReplicaRemovesTheKeeperSubtree(t *testing.T) {
	env := requireMechanics(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	sch := mechanicsSchema(t)
	a := mechanicsPinned(t)
	a.NodeID = "a-" + suffix(t)
	b := a
	b.NodeID = "b-" + suffix(t)
	legacyA := unsafeIntent(t, a, sch)
	legacyB := unsafeIntent(t, b, sch)
	nested := legacyA
	nested.Table = legacyA.Table + "_nested"
	nested.ZooKeeperPath = legacyA.ZooKeeperPath + "/scoped/1"
	createTables(t, env.A, env.AAddr, legacyA, nested)
	createTables(t, env.B, env.BAddr, legacyB)
	listed := func() []string {
		t.Helper()
		got, err := ddl.KeeperUnsafeTables(ctx, env.A, a)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Keeper tables under /sentio/%d/unsafe: %v", a.KeeperShardID, err)
		}
		return got
	}
	replicas := func() []string {
		t.Helper()
		got, err := ddl.KeeperReplicas(ctx, env.A, a, sch.TableID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Keeper replicas of %s: %v", sch.TableID, err)
		}
		return got
	}
	if got := listed(); !slices.Equal(got, []string{legacyA.Table}) {
		t.Fatalf("Keeper lists %v, want only %s", got, legacyA.Table)
	}
	if got := replicas(); !slices.Equal(got, []string{a.NodeID, b.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("legacy replicas %v, want %s and %s", got, a.NodeID, b.NodeID)
	}
	if got := keeperNames(t, env.A, nested.ZooKeeperPath+"/replicas"); !slices.Equal(got, []string{a.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("the nested table's replicas %v, want %s under the legacy path", got, a.NodeID)
	}
	mustExec(t, env.A, "DROP TABLE "+qualified(legacyA.Database, legacyA.Table)+" SYNC")
	if got := listed(); !slices.Equal(got, []string{legacyA.Table}) {
		t.Fatalf("after dropping one replica Keeper lists %v, want %s", got, legacyA.Table)
	}
	if got := replicas(); !slices.Equal(got, []string{b.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("after dropping one replica: %v, want %s", got, b.NodeID)
	}
	if got := keeperNames(t, env.A, nested.ZooKeeperPath+"/replicas"); !slices.Equal(got, []string{a.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("after dropping one legacy replica the nested table's replicas are %v", got)
	}
	mustExec(t, env.B, "DROP TABLE "+qualified(legacyB.Database, legacyB.Table)+" SYNC")
	if got := listed(); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("Keeper still lists %v under /sentio/%d/unsafe after the last legacy replica was dropped; the nested table's metadata lived below it", got, a.KeeperShardID)
	}
}
```

Insert after the recipe that ends at `:115` and Task 4's credentials paragraph that follows it, before `## Releases` (`:117`):

````markdown
### ClickHouse mechanics

`dataplane/chmechanics` is a test-only suite that pins, on a real ClickHouse pair, the engine behaviour the storage-integrity protocol relies on (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §2): `REPLACE PARTITION` and `ATTACH PARTITION FROM` keep `hash_of_all_files`, and the latter is not throttled by `parts_to_throw_insert`; `old_parts_lifetime` is 480 s, the protocol DDL keeps it, and a restart inside it, abrupt or graceful, resurrects the parts a `REPLACE PARTITION` retired, while `DROP PARTITION` followed by `ATTACH PARTITION FROM` does not; `DROP PART` (or `DETACH PART` and `DROP DETACHED PART`) of each resurrected twin leaves exactly the replacements and stays dropped; partition backups with `base_backup` are incremental and restore every part's `hash_of_all_files`; a pull from `remote()` with the no-split settings writes one part; `READ ON REMOTE` refuses writes; a `NOT OVERRIDABLE` named collection refuses overrides; an `OPTIMIZE` on one replica merges another replica's parts; and dropping a table's last replica removes its whole Keeper subtree. Run it with:

```bash
bash scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics.sh clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3 26.3.37.3
```

The script starts two servers of the image on one Docker network (node A hosts the shared Keeper; node B runs with `--restart always` on a fixed host port, so the suite restarts it with `SYSTEM KILL` and `SYSTEM SHUTDOWN`), mounts `scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics-backups.xml` and `scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics-users.xml`, runs `//dataplane/chmechanics:chmechanics_test` and then, against node B, the SNode's owner-audit restart test (`//snode:snode_test`, `TestOwnerAuditRepairsResurrectedPartsAcrossAClickHouseRestart`), fails if any of these tests is skipped or does not pass, and removes the containers. The second argument is the version prefix every server must report (M0). CI's `clickhouse-mechanics` job and Cut Release run it exactly as above, on the upstream patch image `clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3` with its exact version as the prefix, never on the floating `26.3` tag, so a gate result changes only with a commit; moving to another patch changes the image and the prefix in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/cut-release.yml` and this command together. The suite is opt-in (`ARBITER_CH_MECHANICS=1`); once opted in, a missing `ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1`, `ARBITER_CH_KEEPER=1`, `CH_ADDR`, `CH_REPLICA_ADDR`, `CH_PEER_ADDR`, `ARBITER_CH_EXPECT_VERSION_PREFIX` or `ARBITER_CH_IMAGE` fails it, and the restart tests also need `ARBITER_CH_RESTART=1` and `CH_RESTART_ADDR`. `ARBITER_CH_MECHANICS_FILTER` limits a run to the tests it matches; `ARBITER_CH_PLATFORM` (for example `linux/amd64`) selects the image platform.

The storage-integrity ClickHouses run a private Sentio build of 26.3 (the image the production `charts/storage-integrity` chart deploys). CI cannot pull it, so a maintainer with read access to that registry runs the same script by hand with that image and the prefix `26.3.` (`bash scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics.sh <the chart's image> 26.3.`, with `ARBITER_CH_PLATFORM=linux/amd64` on a host of another architecture), after the release's CI run and before any storage-integrity rollout of the release, and records the date, the version M0 logs and the result with the release. Running it in CI needs a read-only registry secret for this repository.
````

## Task 7: arbiter — pin PROTO_TAG, CORE_TAG and HG_TAG; FSM read views and the stage-3 SafeState reads (S3-A)

Spec §14 (the owner audit compares its `hg_safe` with "the FSM's stored acknowledgement"), §15 (arbiter: "read RPCs (`GetPartitionStates`, `GetPromotionOutcomes`, `GetBlockVerification(block_seq)` returning the replay job, each statement's candidate parts, the verify set and each evidence outcome, for shadow verification)") and the P0 row of §16. Contract §4 fixes the FSM views and the three handlers; clarification K4 takes a partition's unresolved promotion intent from the SNode's own journal, so the partition read lists only partitions an applied acknowledgement committed state for (contract §1, Task 3's field comments), and K7 needs the one-producer invariant of `PromotionSeq` pinned before Task 8 builds the issuance lease on it. Nothing here touches `Apply`, `Restore`, a Raft tag, a snapshot byte or a feature string (contract §0): the FSM gains read views only, the server gains three `SafeState` handlers on the data-plane listener, and `orchestrator.dispatchEvidence` builds its replay job through the same method `GetBlockVerification` serves.

This is the first arbiter task of the plan: it creates the arbiter worktree that Tasks 8–11 reuse. Line anchors are arbiter `fb42260` (`v0.12.0`).

Notes:
- **No consensus change.** Every new FSM function takes `f.mu.RLock` (or is a `…Locked` helper called under it), returns detached copies and never writes; none reads the clock or imports arbiter-proto (CI red lines `.github/workflows/ci.yml:31-42`). `PromotionWork` gains two fields that only the leader's issuance gate reads (Task 8); the WorkSet's decisions are unchanged and no test compares a `PromotionWork` with `reflect.DeepEqual` (`git grep 'PromotionWork{'` finds only `fsm/reads_work.go:283` and `orchestrator/signer_test.go:185`, whose zero value is unaffected).
- **One max-block rule.** `promotionBlockLocked` is the loop at `fsm/reads_work.go:322-327`, now named; the cleanup coverage rule, `PromotionWork.BlockSeq`, `PromotionOutcomeView.BlockSeq` and the drain view's in-flight blocks all call it, so the leader's drain mode compares exactly the block the FSM's own rules use.
- **No recursive read lock.** `BlockVerificationView` holds `f.mu.RLock` and needs the dispatch material, so `BlockDispatchInfo` is split into a locking wrapper and `blockDispatchInfoLocked`; calling the public method from inside a read lock could deadlock behind a waiting `Apply` (Go's `RWMutex` blocks new readers once a writer waits).
- **Byte-identical dispatch.** `orchestrator.dispatchEvidence` builds its job through `BlockDispatchInfo.ReplayJob()`, the same method the server serves, and `GetBlockVerification.scan_parts` is built by `wire.ByteSideScanDispatch` over the same candidate parts, so a P2 shadow verifier replays and scans exactly what the selected verifiers received. `TestDispatchedReplayJobIsTheBlockVerificationJob` pins it from the orchestrator side and `TestBlockVerificationViewMatchesTheDispatchedReplayJob` pins the extraction against today's literal.
- **What a partition read lists (contract §1, K4).** A partition appears exactly when any of `Partitions`, `SafeParts` or `PromotedUnsafe` names it, and only an applied acknowledgement writes those (`fsm/apply.go:879-898`). A partition whose promotions are all unacknowledged or acknowledged with `Applied:false` therefore has no entry, even when `partition_id` names it, and a recorded promotion only fills a listed partition's `unacked_promotion_seq` and `last_acked_promotion_seq`; this is the rule the arbiter-proto comments state (Task 3). The owner audit (Task 5) reads a missing entry as an authoritative empty inventory at seq 0 and takes a partition's unresolved promotion intent from the SNode's own journal (K4), never from `unacked_promotion_seq`. `last_acked_promotion_seq` counts Applied:false acknowledgements too; `publish_seq` is the last applied one (the inventory's version). `TestPartitionStatesListOnlyPartitionsAnAppliedAckReached` pins the rule through an unacknowledged promotion, an Applied:false acknowledgement, a re-issue and the applied acknowledgement that finally lists the partition.
- **Acknowledgement records exist only after the tracks activation, applied or not.** `PendingPromotion.Ack`, `AckJWS` and `AckEpoch` are set by `recordSourceAckLocked` only after it (`fsm/apply.go:915-933`), which runs on the Applied:false path (`:838`) as on the applied one (`:889`), so every post-activation acknowledgement fills `ack`, `ack_jws` and `ack_epoch`, and `acked` is true for both; before the activation `PromotionOutcome.ack` is absent and the owner audit uses its own inventory (contract §3).
- **What a false flag does not say.** `cleanup_pending` is `PendingCleanups[seq] != nil`: true only while a scheduled cleanup awaits its acknowledgement, so it is also false from the promotion's acknowledgement until the cleanup is scheduled after publication. False is not "cleaned up": the promoted parts stay in the partition's `promoted_unsafe_part_row_lthashes` until the cleanup acknowledgement (`fsm/apply.go:1043-1049`), which is what a consumer (the owner audit, Plan S3-B's runbooks, Task 11's scenario) must wait on. `VerifierEvidence.evaluated` is false for evidence the verdict never judged, and `reevaluateBlock` stops once quorum latches (`fsm/threeway.go:43-45`), so evidence recorded after the latch is served with `evaluated` false and no check outcome: a P2 shadow verifier must treat such a row as recorded, not as failed.
- **Reply invariants (Task 4).** arbiter-core's `dataplane.Client` refuses an answer outside its query, and these handlers never give one: `GetPartitionStates` lists only partitions of exactly `table_id` (and `partition_id` when set), each once, ascending; `GetPromotionOutcomes` lists only promotions above `after_promotion_seq` of the selected table and partition, strictly ascending, at most the page limit, each carrying its own command (`promote.promotion_seq` equals `promotion_seq`, `fsm/apply.go:792-794`) and, when present, the acknowledgement of the same table, partition and promotion (Apply looks the promotion up by the acknowledgement's `promotion_seq` and refuses another partition, `:804-806`, `:827-829`). Task 11 reads both through that client over the wire.
- **Cost.** `PendingPromotions` is never pruned, so the promotion and partition reads are O(promotions) under the read lock: devnet2 is at promotion 53. `table_id` is required on `GetPartitionStates` and pages bound `GetPromotionOutcomes` (default 256, at most 1024), because `SafeParts` carry about 4.9 KB per entry (spec §2) and arbiter-admin keeps gRPC's 4 MiB receive limit.
- **Barriers.** Each read appends one `LogBarrier` entry, like every `SafeState` read except `GetClientSeqState`; a follower answers `NotLeader` with the hint and pays none. The owner audit needs the linearizable read for its "FSM ahead" rule (contract §3), so no follower-local variant is added.
- **The pin.** From the pin commit on `SafeState` and `ConsensusAdmin` carry the new methods as `Unimplemented` stubs (every implementer embeds the generated stub: `server/safestate.go:23`, `server/consensus_admin.go:26`, `cmd/arbiter-admin/main_test.go:31`, `client_lanes_test.go:35`, `server/tracks_gate_voters_test.go:29,54,428`). arbiter-core's SNode audits in report mode (the default, K1) and, between the pin and this task's server commit, would see `ErrStage3ReadsUnavailable` and count `fsm_unavailable` (K3); nothing is released in between.
- **Invariant tests.** `TestOnlyRecordPromotionIssuedAdvancesPromotionSeq` and `TestConsensusUpdateSignedBeforeAPromotionIsRefused` pin today's behaviour and pass on the unchanged FSM; they are the guard Task 8's issuance lease rests on (K7).

```go
// appliedAckP0 is s1's Applied acknowledgement of promotion seq over the one
// part hash in db.t/p0 (issuePromotion's partition), landing as all_9_9_0.
func appliedAckP0(seq uint64, hash string) wire.Command {
	return wire.Command{RecordPromotionAck: &wire.RecordPromotionAck{Ack: arbiter.PromotionAck{NodeID: "s1", PromotionSeq: seq,
		TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "p0", PostPartitionCommitment: hash, Applied: true,
		Parts: []arbiter.SafePartMapping{{PartRowLtHash: hash, SafePartName: "all_9_9_0", PartPhysHash: "0x99"}}}}}
}

// TestPartitionStatesReadsCommittedPromotionState: contract §1 and §4. An
// issued, unacknowledged promotion is no partition state: the partition has
// no entry, even when the read names it (the owner audit's unresolved intent
// is its own journal, plan S3-A clarification K4). The applied
// acknowledgement lists it and moves the base, the publish sequence, the safe
// inventory and the promoted unsafe part exactly as Apply stored them, and
// the view is detached.
func TestPartitionStatesReadsCommittedPromotionState(t *testing.T) {
	f, _, partHash, _ := issuePromotion(t)
	tp := arbiter.TablePartition{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "p0"}
	want := PartitionStatesView{PromotionSeq: 1, SafeWatermark: f.st.SafeWatermark}
	for _, partition := range []string{"", "p0"} {
		if got := f.PartitionStates("db.t", partition); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("an issued promotion: PartitionStates(db.t, %q) = %+v, want no entry %+v", partition, got, want)
		}
	}

	mustApply(t, f, appliedAckP0(1, partHash))
	got := f.PartitionStates("db.t", "p0")
	if got.PromotionSeq != 1 || got.SafeWatermark != f.st.SafeWatermark || len(got.Partitions) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("partition states = %+v", got)
	}
	p := got.Partitions[0]
	if p.Partition != tp || p.BaseSafeSnapshotID != "" || p.BasePartitionRoot != partHash || p.PublishSeq != 1 ||
		p.UnackedPromotionSeq != 0 || p.LastAckedPromotionSeq != 1 || p.InventoryUnrefreshed {
		t.Fatalf("acknowledged partition = %+v", p)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(p.SafeParts, f.st.SafeParts[tp]) || len(p.SafeParts) != 1 || p.SafeParts[0].PartName != "all_9_9_0" {
		t.Fatalf("safe parts = %+v, committed %+v", p.SafeParts, f.st.SafeParts[tp])
	}
	if !slices.Equal(p.PromotedUnsafe, []string{partHash}) {
		t.Fatalf("promoted unsafe = %v, want [%s]", p.PromotedUnsafe, partHash)
	}
	p.SafeParts[0].PartName = "rewritten"
	if f.st.SafeParts[tp][0].PartName != "all_9_9_0" {
		t.Fatal("the view aliases the committed SafeParts")
	}
}

// TestPartitionStatesFiltersByTableAndPartition: suspendedWorkFSM holds an
// acknowledged promotion of db2.x/p1 (cleanup scheduled) and an unacknowledged
// one of db2.x/p2. The read lists p1 alone, narrows to it, and lists nothing
// for p2 (no applied acknowledgement reached it), another table, an unknown
// partition or a table-id prefix.
func TestPartitionStatesFiltersByTableAndPartition(t *testing.T) {
	f, _, pA, _ := suspendedWorkFSM(t)
	all := f.PartitionStates("db2.x", "")
	if all.PromotionSeq != 2 || len(all.Partitions) != 1 || all.Partitions[0].Partition.PartitionID != "p1" {
		t.Fatalf("db2.x partitions = %+v, want p1 alone", all)
	}
	p1 := all.Partitions[0]
	if p1.PublishSeq != 1 || p1.LastAckedPromotionSeq != 1 || p1.UnackedPromotionSeq != 0 || !slices.Equal(p1.PromotedUnsafe, []string{pA}) || len(p1.SafeParts) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("p1 = %+v", p1)
	}
	if one := f.PartitionStates("db2.x", "p1"); len(one.Partitions) != 1 || !reflect.DeepEqual(one.Partitions[0], p1) {
		t.Fatalf("db2.x/p1 alone = %+v", one)
	}
	for _, q := range [][2]string{{"db2.x", "p2"}, {"db.t", ""}, {"db2.x", "p9"}, {"db2", ""}} {
		if got := f.PartitionStates(q[0], q[1]); len(got.Partitions) != 0 || got.PromotionSeq != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("PartitionStates(%q, %q) = %+v, want no partitions", q[0], q[1], got)
		}
	}
}

// TestPartitionStatesListOnlyPartitionsAnAppliedAckReached: contract §1's
// partition set. A partition is listed once an applied acknowledgement
// reached it, which gives it a promotion base, a safe inventory and promoted
// unsafe parts; one whose promotions are all unacknowledged or acknowledged
// with Applied:false has no entry, re-issued or not, even when the read names
// it. A listed partition reports its newer unacknowledged promotion and its
// newest acknowledged one.
func TestPartitionStatesListOnlyPartitionsAnAppliedAckReached(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := tracksFSMQ(t)
	key, account := testAccount(t)
	pA, pB, pC := lthashHex("rowA"), lthashHex("rowB"), lthashHex("rowC")
	seqA := admitQ(t, f, key, account, 1, "db2.x")
	seqB := admitQ(t, f, key, account, 2, "db2.x")
	seqC := admitQ(t, f, key, account, 3, "db2.x")
	mustSeal(t, f)
	second := indexerSigner2(t)
	mustApply(t, f, signedRCQ(t, f, second, seqA, partQ("db2.x", "p1", pA)))
	mustApply(t, f, signedRCQ(t, f, second, seqB, partQ("db2.x", "p2", pB)))
	mustApply(t, f, signedRCQ(t, f, second, seqC, partQ("db2.x", "p1", pC)))
	noEntry := func(step string) {
		t.Helper()
		for _, partition := range []string{"", "p2"} {
			for _, p := range f.PartitionStates("db2.x", partition).Partitions {
				if p.Partition.PartitionID == "p2" {
					t.Fatalf("%s: PartitionStates(db2.x, %q) lists p2 as %+v", step, partition, p)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mustApply(t, f, promotionQ(t, f, a, "db2.x", "p2", pB))
	noEntry("promotion 1 unacknowledged")
	mustApply(t, f, sourceAck(t, f, second, arbiter.PromotionAck{NodeID: "s2", PromotionSeq: 1, TableID: "db2.x", PartitionID: "p2", Detail: "base moved"}))
	noEntry("promotion 1 acknowledged with Applied:false")
	mustApply(t, f, promotionQ(t, f, a, "db2.x", "p1", pA))
	mustApply(t, f, sourceAck(t, f, second, appliedAckQ("s2", 2, "db2.x", "p1", pA)))
	mustApply(t, f, promotionQ(t, f, a, "db2.x", "p1", pC))
	mustApply(t, f, promotionQ(t, f, a, "db2.x", "p2", pB))
	noEntry("promotion 4 re-issued and unacknowledged")
	got := f.PartitionStates("db2.x", "")
	if got.PromotionSeq != 4 || len(got.Partitions) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("db2.x partitions = %+v, want p1 alone at promotion seq 4", got)
	}
	if p := got.Partitions[0]; p.Partition.PartitionID != "p1" || p.PublishSeq != 2 || p.LastAckedPromotionSeq != 2 || p.UnackedPromotionSeq != 3 ||
		p.BasePartitionRoot != pA || !slices.Equal(p.PromotedUnsafe, []string{pA}) || len(p.SafeParts) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("p1 = %+v, want its applied promotion 2 and its unacknowledged promotion 3", p)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, sourceAck(t, f, second, appliedAckQ("s2", 4, "db2.x", "p2", pB)))
	one := f.PartitionStates("db2.x", "p2")
	if len(one.Partitions) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("db2.x/p2 after its applied acknowledgement = %+v", one)
	}
	if p := one.Partitions[0]; p.PublishSeq != 4 || p.LastAckedPromotionSeq != 4 || p.UnackedPromotionSeq != 0 || p.BasePartitionRoot != pB ||
		!slices.Equal(p.PromotedUnsafe, []string{pB}) {
		t.Fatalf("p2 = %+v, want its applied promotion 4", p)
	}
}

// TestPromotionOutcomesPageInPromotionOrder: the cursor is exclusive, next is
// the last listed sequence only while more remain, and a zero limit lists
// everything.
func TestPromotionOutcomesPageInPromotionOrder(t *testing.T) {
	f, _, _, _ := suspendedWorkFSM(t)
	page, next, seq := f.PromotionOutcomes("db2.x", "", 0, 1)
	if seq != 2 || next != 1 || len(page) != 1 || page[0].PromotionSeq != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("first page = %+v, next %d, promotion seq %d", page, next, seq)
	}
	page, next, _ = f.PromotionOutcomes("db2.x", "", next, 1)
	if next != 0 || len(page) != 1 || page[0].PromotionSeq != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("second page = %+v, next %d; want promotion 2 and the end", page, next)
	}
	if all, next, _ := f.PromotionOutcomes("", "", 0, 0); next != 0 || len(all) != 2 || all[0].PromotionSeq != 1 || all[1].PromotionSeq != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("every outcome = %+v, next %d", all, next)
	}
	if only, _, _ := f.PromotionOutcomes("db2.x", "p2", 0, 10); len(only) != 1 || only[0].PromotionSeq != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("db2.x/p2 outcomes = %+v", only)
	}
	if none, next, _ := f.PromotionOutcomes("db.t", "", 0, 10); len(none) != 0 || next != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("db.t outcomes = %+v, next %d", none, next)
	}
	if none, _, _ := f.PromotionOutcomes("db2.x", "", 2, 10); len(none) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("after_promotion_seq must be exclusive: %+v", none)
	}
}

// TestPromotionOutcomesCarryTheStoredAckAfterTheTracksActivation: after the
// activation every acknowledgement, Applied:false included, is recorded with
// its SNode signature and epoch (amendment A35), and the outcome serves it
// with the promotion's block, track, source and cleanup state, detached.
func TestPromotionOutcomesCarryTheStoredAckAfterTheTracksActivation(t *testing.T) {
	f, _, _, _ := suspendedWorkFSM(t)
	outcomes, _, _ := f.PromotionOutcomes("db2.x", "", 0, 0)
	if len(outcomes) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("outcomes = %+v", outcomes)
	}
	first, second := outcomes[0], outcomes[1]
	pp1 := f.st.PendingPromotions[1]
	block := f.st.Statements[pp1.StatementSeqs[0]].BlockSeq
	if !first.Acked || first.Ack == nil || first.Ack.NodeID != "s2" || !first.Ack.Applied || first.AckJWS == "" || first.AckJWS != pp1.AckJWS ||
		first.AckEpoch != pp1.AckEpoch || !first.CleanupPending {
		t.Fatalf("acknowledged outcome = %+v, committed %+v", first, pp1)
	}
	if first.Track == nil || first.Track.IndexerID != 2 || first.SourceNode != "s2" || first.BlockSeq != block ||
		first.AuthorityJWS != pp1.AuthorityJWS || first.AuthorityEpoch != pp1.AuthorityEpoch ||
		!slices.Equal(first.StatementSeqs, pp1.StatementSeqs) || !reflect.DeepEqual(first.Promote, pp1.Promote) {
		t.Fatalf("outcome 1 = %+v, committed %+v (block %d)", first, pp1, block)
	}
	if second.Acked || second.Ack != nil || second.AckJWS != "" || second.AckEpoch != 0 || second.CleanupPending ||
		second.Track == nil || second.Track.IndexerID != 2 || second.BlockSeq != block {
		t.Fatalf("unacknowledged outcome = %+v", second)
	}
	first.Ack.Parts[0].SafePartName = "rewritten"
	first.Promote.CandidateParts[0].PartName = "rewritten"
	first.Track.IndexerID = 9
	if pp1.Ack.Parts[0].SafePartName != "all_9_9_0" || pp1.Promote.CandidateParts[0].PartName != "all_1_0" || f.st.Blocks[block-1].Track.IndexerID != 2 {
		t.Fatal("the outcome aliases committed state")
	}

	mustApply(t, f, sourceAck(t, f, indexerSigner2(t), arbiter.PromotionAck{NodeID: "s2", PromotionSeq: 2, TableID: "db2.x", PartitionID: "p2", Detail: "base moved"}))
	outcomes, _, _ = f.PromotionOutcomes("db2.x", "p2", 0, 0)
	pp2 := f.st.PendingPromotions[2]
	if len(outcomes) != 1 || pp2.Ack == nil {
		t.Fatalf("outcomes of db2.x/p2 = %+v, committed %+v", outcomes, pp2)
	}
	if o := outcomes[0]; !o.Acked || o.Ack == nil || o.Ack.Applied || o.Ack.NodeID != "s2" || o.Ack.Detail != "base moved" || o.AckJWS == "" ||
		o.AckJWS != pp2.AckJWS || o.AckEpoch != pp2.AckEpoch || o.CleanupPending {
		t.Fatalf("Applied:false outcome = %+v, committed %+v", o, pp2)
	}
}

// TestPromotionOutcomesBeforeTheTracksActivationCarryNoAckRecord: before the
// activation no acknowledgement is recorded and no block has a track, so the
// outcome has neither; its source is the statements' bound source.
func TestPromotionOutcomesBeforeTheTracksActivationCarryNoAckRecord(t *testing.T) {
	f, _, partHash, _ := issuePromotion(t)
	mustApply(t, f, appliedAckP0(1, partHash))
	outcomes, next, seq := f.PromotionOutcomes("db.t", "p0", 0, 0)
	if seq != 1 || next != 0 || len(outcomes) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("outcomes = %+v, next %d, promotion seq %d", outcomes, next, seq)
	}
	o := outcomes[0]
	if !o.Acked || o.Ack != nil || o.AckJWS != "" || o.AckEpoch != 0 || o.Track != nil || o.BlockSeq != 1 || o.CleanupPending ||
		o.SourceNode == "" || o.SourceNode != f.st.Statements[1].SourceNode || !reflect.DeepEqual(o.Promote, f.st.PendingPromotions[1].Promote) {
		t.Fatalf("pre-activation outcome = %+v", o)
	}
}

// TestBlockVerificationViewMatchesTheDispatchedReplayJob: the view's dispatch
// material is BlockDispatchInfo, and ReplayJob is field for field the literal
// orchestrator.dispatchEvidence built before this task (orchestrator/
// dispatch.go:89-99 at fb42260).
func TestBlockVerificationViewMatchesTheDispatchedReplayJob(t *testing.T) {
	_, params := authorityFixture(t)
	f, _ := quorumVerifiedBlock(t, params)
	view, err := f.BlockVerificationView(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	info, ok := f.BlockDispatchInfo(1)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("block 1 has no dispatch material")
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(view.Dispatch, info) {
		t.Fatalf("view dispatch = %+v, BlockDispatchInfo %+v", view.Dispatch, info)
	}
	want := replay.ReplayJob{
		BlockSeq:           info.Header.L3BlockSeq,
		PrevSafeSnapshotID: info.Header.PrevSafeSnapshotID,
		PrevStateRoot:      info.Header.PrevStateRoot,
		SchemaSnapshotID:   info.Header.SchemaSnapshotID,
		ExecutorProfileID:  info.Header.ExecutorProfileID,
		SourceClaimRoot:    info.SourceClaimRoot,
		Statements:         info.Statements,
		TableSetTransition: info.TableSetTransition,
		TableSchemas:       info.TableSchemas,
	}
	if want.BlockSeq != 1 || len(want.Statements) != 1 || want.SourceClaimRoot == "" {
		t.Fatalf("fixture job = %+v", want)
	}
	if got := view.Dispatch.ReplayJob(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("ReplayJob = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

// TestBlockVerificationViewReportsEachVerifierOutcome: one evidence entry per
// selected verifier in verifier-set order; the two that reached quorum are
// evaluated with all three checks passing, the third is not; evidence that
// arrives after quorum latched is reported but never evaluated; the anchor
// and finality follow; the statement view carries the bound claim; and the
// view is detached.
func TestBlockVerificationViewReportsEachVerifierOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	_, params := authorityFixture(t)
	f, partHash := quorumVerifiedBlock(t, params)
	set := f.st.Verifications[1].VerifierSet
	view, err := f.BlockVerificationView(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !view.VerdictEvaluated || !view.Quorum || view.Anchor != nil || view.Finality || view.LastMergeable ||
		!slices.Equal(view.SourceNodes, f.st.Verifications[1].SourceNodes) || len(view.Evidence) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("view = %+v", view)
	}
	for i, ev := range view.Evidence {
		if ev.ReplicaID != set[i] {
			t.Fatalf("evidence %d is %s, want verifier-set order %v", i, ev.ReplicaID, set)
		}
	}
	for _, ev := range view.Evidence[:2] {
		if !ev.Evaluated || !ev.Verdict.Pass || !ev.Verdict.Check1RootMatch || !ev.Verdict.Check2PartitionMatch || !ev.Verdict.Check3ByteSideMatch ||
			ev.Attestation == nil || ev.Attestation.ReplicaID != ev.ReplicaID || ev.ByteScan == nil || ev.ByteScan.ReplicaID != ev.ReplicaID {
			t.Fatalf("quorum evidence = %+v", ev)
		}
	}
	if third := view.Evidence[2]; third.Evaluated || third.Attestation != nil || third.ByteScan != nil || third.Verdict != (ReplicaVerdict{}) {
		t.Fatalf("the verifier without evidence = %+v", third)
	}
	if len(view.Statements) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("statements = %+v", view.Statements)
	}
	s, ss := view.Statements[0], f.st.Statements[1]
	if s.StatementSeq != 1 || s.StatementID != ss.Env.StatementID.Flat() || s.Status != ss.Status || s.SourceNode != ss.SourceNode || !s.RCBound ||
		s.SourceClaimRoot != ss.RC.SourceClaimRoot || !reflect.DeepEqual(s.CandidateParts, ss.RC.CandidateParts) ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(s.PartitionNewPartSums, ss.RC.PartitionNewPartSums) || !slices.Equal(s.UnpromotedParts, []string{partHash}) {
		t.Fatalf("statement view = %+v, committed %+v", s, ss)
	}

	attest(t, f, set[2], goodReceipt(f, partHash))
	view, err = f.BlockVerificationView(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if third := view.Evidence[2]; third.Evaluated || third.Attestation == nil || third.ByteScan != nil {
		t.Fatalf("evidence after the latched quorum = %+v, want reported and not evaluated", third)
	}

	anchorFinal(t, f, 1)
	view, err = f.BlockVerificationView(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if view.Anchor == nil || view.Anchor.L3BlockHash == "" || !view.Finality || !view.LastMergeable {
		t.Fatalf("anchored view = %+v", view)
	}
	view.Evidence[0].Attestation.ReplicaID = "rewritten"
	view.Evidence[0].ByteScan.Parts[0].LivePartName = "rewritten"
	view.Anchor.StateRoot = "rewritten"
	view.Statements[0].CandidateParts[0].PartName = "rewritten"
	bv := f.st.Verifications[1]
	if bv.Attestations[set[0]].ReplicaID != set[0] || bv.ByteScans[set[0]].Parts[0].LivePartName == "rewritten" ||
		bv.Anchor.StateRoot == "rewritten" || f.st.Statements[1].RC.CandidateParts[0].PartName == "rewritten" {
		t.Fatal("the view aliases committed verification state")
	}
}

// TestBlockVerificationViewRefusesUnknownAndIncompleteBlocks: no block 0 and
// nothing past the sealed tip; a sealed block whose retained statements are
// short is ErrL3BlockIncomplete, never a partial view; a snapshot-query block
// has no INSERT verification and is refused with neither sentinel (the
// handler answers Internal, as GetL3Block does).
func TestBlockVerificationViewRefusesUnknownAndIncompleteBlocks(t *testing.T) {
	f := newTestFSM(t)
	for _, seq := range []uint64{0, 1} {
		if _, err := f.BlockVerificationView(seq); !errors.Is(err, ErrL3BlockNotFound) {
			t.Fatalf("BlockVerificationView(%d) = %v, want ErrL3BlockNotFound", seq, err)
		}
	}
	g := newTestFSM(t)
	evidenceBlockN(t, g, 2)
	delete(g.st.Statements, 2)
	if _, err := g.BlockVerificationView(1); !errors.Is(err, ErrL3BlockIncomplete) {
		t.Fatalf("incomplete block = %v, want ErrL3BlockIncomplete", err)
	}
	q := newTestFSM(t)
	querySeq := seedQueryStatement(t, q, testQueryEnvelope(t, testQueryStatementID(1)), "source-a")
	queryBlock, _, err := q.sealSnapshotQueryBlockLocked(querySeq, "source-a")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := q.BlockVerificationView(queryBlock); err == nil || errors.Is(err, ErrL3BlockNotFound) || errors.Is(err, ErrL3BlockIncomplete) ||
		!strings.Contains(err.Error(), "snapshot-query block") {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot-query block = %v, want the refusal that it has no INSERT verification", err)
	}
}

// TestFSMReadsForStage3NeverMutate: the four reads leave the snapshot
// byte-identical, and under -race they run beside Apply without a data race
// (none of them builds a lazy index under the read lock).
func TestFSMReadsForStage3NeverMutate(t *testing.T) {
	f, a, _, pB := suspendedWorkFSM(t)
	block := f.st.Statements[f.st.PendingPromotions[2].StatementSeqs[0]].BlockSeq
	reads := func() {
		f.PartitionStates("db2.x", "")
		f.PromotionOutcomes("", "", 0, 0)
		if _, err := f.BlockVerificationView(block); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("BlockVerificationView(%d): %v", block, err)
		}
		f.DrainView()
	}
	before := snapshotBytes(t, f)
	reads()
	if !bytes.Equal(before, snapshotBytes(t, f)) {
		t.Fatal("a stage-3 read changed replicated state")
	}
	stop := make(chan struct{})
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		for {
			select {
			case <-stop:
				return
			default:
				reads()
			}
		}
	}()
	mustApply(t, f, sourceAck(t, f, indexerSigner2(t), appliedAckQ("s2", 2, "db2.x", "p2", pB)))
	mustApply(t, f, cleanupQ(t, f, a, 2, "db2.x", "p2", pB))
	close(stop)
	wg.Wait()
}

// TestPromotionWorkCarriesItsBlockAndTrack: contract §4. A promotable row
// names the block promotionBlockLocked gives its statements, and after the
// tracks activation the statements' track; before it, no track.
func TestPromotionWorkCarriesItsBlockAndTrack(t *testing.T) {
	_, params := authorityFixture(t)
	f, _ := quorumVerifiedBlock(t, params)
	anchorFinal(t, f, 1)
	ws, err := f.WorkSet()
	if err != nil || len(ws.PromotablePending) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("pre-activation work = %+v, %v", ws.PromotablePending, err)
	}
	if w := ws.PromotablePending[0]; w.BlockSeq != 1 || w.Track != nil || !slices.Equal(w.StatementSeqs, []uint64{1}) {
		t.Fatalf("pre-activation row = %+v", w)
	}

	g, _ := tracksFSM(t)
	key, account := testAccount(t)
	stmt := admitTrack(t, g, key, account, 1, 0)
	block := mustSeal(t, g).BlockSeq
	bindTrackClaim(t, g, stmt)
	verifyBlock(t, g, block)
	anchorFinal(t, g, block)
	ws, err = g.WorkSet()
	if err != nil || len(ws.PromotablePending) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("post-activation work = %+v, %v", ws.PromotablePending, err)
	}
	if w := ws.PromotablePending[0]; w.BlockSeq != block || w.Track == nil || w.Track.IndexerID != 0 || !slices.Equal(w.StatementSeqs, []uint64{stmt}) {
		t.Fatalf("post-activation row = %+v, want block %d of track 0", w, block)
	}
}
```

```go
// TestDrainViewReportsInFlightBlocksPerTrack: suspendedWorkFSM's indexer-2
// block holds an unacknowledged promotion and a scheduled cleanup, so it is
// track 2's frontier and in flight; track 1 has no block after the cutover,
// so its frontier is its prefix and nothing is in flight.
func TestDrainViewReportsInFlightBlocksPerTrack(t *testing.T) {
	f, _, _, _ := suspendedWorkFSM(t)
	cut := f.st.Tracks.Cutover.BlockSeq
	block := f.st.Statements[f.st.PendingPromotions[2].StatementSeqs[0]].BlockSeq
	if block != cut+1 {
		t.Fatalf("fixture: indexer 2's block is %d, cutover %d", block, cut)
	}
	want := DrainView{PromotionSeq: 2, Refusal: "consensus update requires all promotions to be acknowledged", TracksActive: true,
		GlobalPrefix: cut, GlobalFrontier: block, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{block},
		Tracks: []TrackDrainView{
			{IndexerID: 1, Prefix: cut, Frontier: cut},
			{IndexerID: 2, Prefix: cut, Frontier: block, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{block}},
		}}
	if got := f.DrainView(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("DrainView = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

// TestDrainViewRefusalEqualsTheDrainGate: at every step of draining
// suspendedWorkFSM the view's refusal is exactly the one Apply gives a signed
// consensus update on the same state, and once it is empty the update
// applies.
func TestDrainViewRefusalEqualsTheDrainGate(t *testing.T) {
	f, a, _, pB := suspendedWorkFSM(t)
	second := indexerSigner2(t)
	update := func() wire.Command {
		u := tracksUpdateQ(t, f)
		u.MaxWriters = f.st.Params.MaxWriters + 1
		return signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, u)
	}
	for _, step := range []struct {
		name    string
		apply   func()
		refusal string
	}{
		{"promotion 2 unacknowledged", func() {}, "consensus update requires all promotions to be acknowledged"},
		{"cleanup of promotion 1 unacknowledged", func() {
			mustApply(t, f, sourceAck(t, f, second, appliedAckQ("s2", 2, "db2.x", "p2", pB)))
		}, "consensus update requires all cleanup commands to be acknowledged"},
		{"part of promotion 2 not cleaned", func() {
			mustApply(t, f, sourceCleanupAck(t, f, second, arbiter.CleanupAck{NodeID: "s2", PromotionSeq: 1, TableID: "db2.x", PartitionID: "p1"}))
		}, "consensus update requires all promoted unsafe parts to be cleaned"},
		{"drained", func() {
			mustApply(t, f, cleanupQ(t, f, a, 2, "db2.x", "p2", pB))
			mustApply(t, f, sourceCleanupAck(t, f, second, arbiter.CleanupAck{NodeID: "s2", PromotionSeq: 2, TableID: "db2.x", PartitionID: "p2"}))
		}, ""},
	} {
		step.apply()
		if got := f.DrainView().Refusal; got != step.refusal {
			t.Fatalf("%s: DrainView refusal %q, want %q", step.name, got, step.refusal)
		}
		if step.refusal != "" {
			rejectConsensusUnchanged(t, f, update(), step.refusal)
		}
	}
	mustApply(t, f, update())
}

// TestDrainViewOfAQuarantinedTrack: the drain gate skips a quarantined
// track's work (spec 2026-10-10 §7.4), so the refusal clears while the view
// still reports the track's in-flight block and its quarantine.
func TestDrainViewOfAQuarantinedTrack(t *testing.T) {
	f, a, _, _ := suspendedWorkFSM(t)
	block := f.st.Statements[f.st.PendingPromotions[2].StatementSeqs[0]].BlockSeq
	mustApply(t, f, quarantineQ(t, f, a, 2, 0, "stuck source"))
	got := f.DrainView()
	if got.Refusal != "" || len(got.Tracks) != 2 || got.Tracks[0].Quarantined || !got.Tracks[1].Quarantined ||
		!slices.Equal(got.Tracks[1].InFlightBlocks, []uint64{block}) {
		t.Fatalf("DrainView with track 2 quarantined = %+v", got)
	}
}
```

```go
package fsm

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// promotionSeqCommandName names the command cmd carries: the first non-nil
// pointer field of wire.Command.
func promotionSeqCommandName(cmd wire.Command) string {
	v := reflect.ValueOf(cmd)
	for i := 0; i < v.NumField(); i++ {
		if field := v.Field(i); field.Kind() == reflect.Pointer && !field.IsNil() {
			return v.Type().Field(i).Name
		}
	}
	return "empty command"
}

// applyWatchingPromotionSeq applies cmd, requires the expected verdict, and
// fails unless PromotionSeq moved as plan S3-A clarification K7 states: by
// exactly one across an applied RecordPromotionIssued, not at all across any
// other command or any refusal.
func applyWatchingPromotionSeq(t *testing.T, f *FSM, cmd wire.Command, wantApplied bool) {
	t.Helper()
	before := f.PromotionSeqView()
	res := f.Apply(mkLog(t, cmd))
	_, rejected := res.(Rejected)
	if rejected == wantApplied {
		t.Fatalf("%s = %T %+v, want applied=%v", promotionSeqCommandName(cmd), res, res, wantApplied)
	}
	want := before
	if cmd.RecordPromotionIssued != nil && !rejected {
		want = before + 1
	}
	if got := f.PromotionSeqView(); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("%s (applied=%v) moved PromotionSeq %d -> %d, want %d", promotionSeqCommandName(cmd), !rejected, before, got, want)
	}
}

// TestOnlyRecordPromotionIssuedAdvancesPromotionSeq pins K7's premise: the
// issuance lease of Task 8 freezes PromotionSeq because only an applied
// RecordPromotionIssued moves it. Every other command of a promotion's life
// leaves it alone, refusals included, before and after the tracks
// activation: evidence, anchors, Applied:false and applied acknowledgements,
// publication, cleanups, quarantine and release, and a consensus update.
func TestOnlyRecordPromotionIssuedAdvancesPromotionSeq(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("before the tracks activation", func(t *testing.T) {
		signer, params := authorityFixture(t)
		f, partHash := quorumVerifiedBlock(t, params)
		if f.PromotionSeqView() != 0 {
			t.Fatal("registration, admission, seal, claim and evidence moved PromotionSeq")
		}
		watch := func(cmd wire.Command, applied bool) { t.Helper(); applyWatchingPromotionSeq(t, f, cmd, applied) }
		promote := func(seq uint64) wire.Command {
			t.Helper()
			p := arbiter.PromoteSafePartition{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "p0", PromotionSeq: seq,
				CandidateParts: []arbiter.PartRef{{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "p0", PartRowLtHash: partHash}}}
			token, err := signer.SignPromotionWithContext(p, authorityContextFor(t, f))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			return wire.Command{RecordPromotionIssued: &wire.RecordPromotionIssued{Promote: p, AuthorityJWS: token}}
		}
		watch(wire.Command{RecordAnchorFinality: &wire.RecordAnchorFinality{L3BlockSeq: 1, Anchor: anchorForBlock(t, f, 1),
			FinalityReached: true, LastMergeableReached: true}}, true)
		watch(promote(1), true)
		watch(promote(1), false) // a replayed issuance is refused
		watch(wire.Command{RecordPromotionAck: &wire.RecordPromotionAck{Ack: arbiter.PromotionAck{NodeID: "s1", PromotionSeq: 1,
			TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "p0", Applied: false, Detail: "base moved"}}}, true)
		watch(promote(2), true) // the re-issue after Applied:false
		watch(appliedAckP0(2, partHash), true)
		watch(wire.Command{PublishSafeSnapshot: &wire.PublishSafeSnapshot{Manifest: manifestFromInputs(t, f)}}, true)
		ws, err := f.WorkSet()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var cleanup arbiter.UnsafeCleanup
		for _, cw := range ws.PublishedUncleaned {
			if cw.PromotionSeq == 2 {
				cleanup = cw.Cleanup
			}
		}
		if cleanup.PromotionSeq != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("no cleanup of promotion 2 is due: %+v", ws.PublishedUncleaned)
		}

		}

		watch(wire.Command{RecordCleanupAck: &wire.RecordCleanupAck{Ack: arbiter.CleanupAck{NodeID: "s1", PromotionSeq: 2, TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "p0"}}}, true)
		watch(signedConsensusUpdate(t, signer, consensusUpdate(t, f, []string{signer.Address()}, 2)), true)

		seqA := admitQ(t, f, key, account, 1, "db2.x")
		seqB := admitQ(t, f, key, account, 2, "db2.x")
		mustSeal(t, f)
		if f.PromotionSeqView() != 0 {
			t.Fatal("admission or a seal moved PromotionSeq")
		}
		watch := func(cmd wire.Command, applied bool) { t.Helper(); applyWatchingPromotionSeq(t, f, cmd, applied) }
		second := indexerSigner2(t)
		pA, pB := lthashHex("rowA"), lthashHex("rowB")
		watch(signedRCQ(t, f, second, seqA, partQ("db2.x", "p1", pA)), true)
		watch(signedRCQ(t, f, second, seqB, partQ("db2.x", "p2", pB)), true)
		watch(promotionQ(t, f, a, "db2.x", "p1", pA), true)
		watch(promotionQ(t, f, a, "db2.x", "p2", pB), true)
		watch(sourceAck(t, f, second, appliedAckQ("s2", 1, "db2.x", "p1", pA)), true)
		watch(cleanupQ(t, f, a, 1, "db2.x", "p1", pA), true)
		watch(quarantineQ(t, f, a, 2, 0, "stuck source"), true)
		watch(promotionQ(t, f, a, "db2.x", "p2", pB), false) // a quarantined track issues nothing
		u := tracksUpdateQ(t, f)
		u.MaxWriters = f.st.Params.MaxWriters + 1
		watch(signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, u), true) // the drain gate skips the quarantined track
		watch(releaseQ(t, f, a, 2, 1), true)
		if f.PromotionSeqView() != 2 {

// TestConsensusUpdateSignedBeforeAPromotionIsRefused pins the race the
// issuance hold removes (spec 2026-10-14 §10.1): an update signed at
// promotion sequence N is refused once a promotion moves it to N+1, with
// nothing changed, and the same update re-signed at N+1 passes that check
// and meets the drain gate instead.
func TestConsensusUpdateSignedBeforeAPromotionIsRefused(t *testing.T) {
	signer, params := authorityFixture(t)
	f, partHash := quorumVerifiedBlock(t, params)
	anchorFinal(t, f, 1)
	other, _ := authorityFixture(t)
	target := []string{signer.Address(), other.Address()}
	early := signedConsensusUpdate(t, signer, consensusUpdate(t, f, target, 2))
	if early.UpdateConsensusParams.Update.ExpectedPromotionSeq != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("fixture: update signed at promotion seq %d", early.UpdateConsensusParams.Update.ExpectedPromotionSeq)
	}
	p := arbiter.PromoteSafePartition{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "p0", PromotionSeq: 1,
		CandidateParts: []arbiter.PartRef{{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "p0", PartRowLtHash: partHash}}}
	token, err := signer.SignPromotionWithContext(p, authorityContextFor(t, f))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{RecordPromotionIssued: &wire.RecordPromotionIssued{Promote: p, AuthorityJWS: token}})
	rejectConsensusUnchanged(t, f, early, "consensus update expected_promotion_seq differs from current promotion sequence")
	late := signedConsensusUpdate(t, signer, consensusUpdate(t, f, target, 2))
	rejectConsensusUnchanged(t, f, late, "consensus update requires all promotions to be acknowledged")
}
```

Create `fsm/reads_partitions.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"slices"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// PartitionStateView is one partition's committed promotion state as
// SafeState.GetPartitionStates serves it (pb.PartitionStateEntry; housegate
// spec 2026-10-14 §14: the owner audit's FSM reference).
type PartitionStateView struct {
	Partition arbiter.TablePartition
	// BaseSafeSnapshotID, BasePartitionRoot, PublishSeq and
	// InventoryUnrefreshed are the partition's PartitionState: all zero
	// while no promotion of the partition has applied.
	BaseSafeSnapshotID   string
	BasePartitionRoot    string
	PublishSeq           uint64
	InventoryUnrefreshed bool
	// SafeParts is the partition's acknowledged hg_safe inventory in the
	// order Apply stored it (State.SafeParts); nil when it has none.
	SafeParts []replay.PartManifestEntry
	// PromotedUnsafe lists, ascending, the part_row_lthash of every promoted
	// part whose hg_unsafe copy is not cleaned yet (State.PromotedUnsafe).
	PromotedUnsafe []string
	// UnackedPromotionSeq is the newest issued promotion of the listed
	// partition that has no acknowledgement yet, 0 for none. It is
	// diagnostic: the owner audit takes a partition's unresolved promotion
	// intent from the SNode's own journal (plan S3-A clarification K4), since
	// a partition whose first promotion is in flight has no entry here.
	UnackedPromotionSeq uint64
	// LastAckedPromotionSeq is the newest acknowledged promotion of the
	// listed partition, applied or not, 0 for none.
	LastAckedPromotionSeq uint64
}

// PartitionStatesView answers GetPartitionStates (pb.PartitionStates).
type PartitionStatesView struct {
	PromotionSeq  uint64
	SafeWatermark SafeWatermark
	// Partitions are sorted by partition id.
	Partitions []PartitionStateView
}

// PartitionStates reads table tableID's partitions, or only partitionID when
// it is not empty, under the read lock. A partition is listed when any of
// Partitions, SafeParts or PromotedUnsafe names it, which only an applied
// acknowledgement does (apply.go applyRecordPromotionAck): a partition whose
// promotions are all unacknowledged or acknowledged with Applied:false has
// no entry, even when partitionID names it (plan S3-A contract §1). The
// recorded promotions only fill a listed partition's UnackedPromotionSeq and
// LastAckedPromotionSeq. The view is detached and the read never writes.
func (f *FSM) PartitionStates(tableID, partitionID string) PartitionStatesView {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()

	wanted := func(tp arbiter.TablePartition) bool {
		return tp.TableID == tableID && (partitionID == "" || tp.PartitionID == partitionID)
	}
	listed := map[arbiter.TablePartition]bool{}
	for tp := range f.st.Partitions {
		if wanted(tp) {
			listed[tp] = true
		}
	}
	for tp := range f.st.SafeParts {
		if wanted(tp) {
			listed[tp] = true
		}
	}
	for tp := range f.st.PromotedUnsafe {
		if wanted(tp) {
			listed[tp] = true
		}
	}
	unacked := map[arbiter.TablePartition]uint64{}
	lastAcked := map[arbiter.TablePartition]uint64{}
	for seq, pp := range f.st.PendingPromotions {
		if pp == nil {
			continue
		}
		tp := arbiter.TablePartition{TableID: pp.Promote.TableID, PartitionID: pp.Promote.PartitionID}
		if !listed[tp] {
			continue
		}
		if pp.Acked {
			lastAcked[tp] = max(lastAcked[tp], seq)
		} else {
			unacked[tp] = max(unacked[tp], seq)
		}
	}
	partitions := make([]arbiter.TablePartition, 0, len(listed))
	for tp := range listed {
		partitions = append(partitions, tp)
	}
	sortPartitions(partitions)
	view := PartitionStatesView{PromotionSeq: f.st.PromotionSeq, SafeWatermark: f.st.SafeWatermark}
	for _, tp := range partitions {
		p := PartitionStateView{Partition: tp, UnackedPromotionSeq: unacked[tp], LastAckedPromotionSeq: lastAcked[tp],
			PromotedUnsafe: sortedPresent(f.st.PromotedUnsafe[tp])}
		if ps := f.st.Partitions[tp]; ps != nil {
			p.BaseSafeSnapshotID, p.BasePartitionRoot = ps.BaseSafeSnapshotID, ps.BasePartitionRoot
			p.PublishSeq, p.InventoryUnrefreshed = ps.PublishSeq, ps.InventoryUnrefreshed
		}
		if parts := f.st.SafeParts[tp]; len(parts) > 0 {
			p.SafeParts = clonePartManifestEntries(parts)
		}
		view.Partitions = append(view.Partitions, p)
	}
	return view
}

// sortedPresent lists, ascending, the keys set to true; nil when none is.
func sortedPresent(set map[string]bool) []string {
	var out []string
	for key, present := range set {
		if present {
			out = append(out, key)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}
```

Create `fsm/reads_promotions.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"slices"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// PromotionOutcomeView is one recorded promotion as GetPromotionOutcomes
// serves it (pb.PromotionOutcome).
type PromotionOutcomeView struct {
	PromotionSeq  uint64
	Promote       arbiter.PromoteSafePartition
	StatementSeqs []uint64
	// BlockSeq is the promotion's block (promotionBlockLocked).
	BlockSeq uint64
	// Track is the covered statements' shared track: nil before the tracks
	// activation and whenever they do not resolve to one track.
	Track *L3BlockTrack
	// SourceNode is the covered statements' shared bound source, empty when
	// it does not resolve.
	SourceNode     string
	AuthorityJWS   string
	AuthorityEpoch uint64
	Acked          bool
	// Ack, AckJWS and AckEpoch are the source acknowledgement record
	// (amendment A35): set for every acknowledgement recorded after the
	// tracks activation, Applied:false included (recordSourceAckLocked runs
	// on both paths), so nil, empty and 0 only for a promotion that is
	// unacknowledged or was acknowledged before the activation.
	Ack      *arbiter.PromotionAck
	AckJWS   string
	AckEpoch uint64
	// CleanupPending reports a scheduled cleanup of the promotion that its
	// source has not acknowledged yet (PendingCleanups[seq] != nil). False
	// does not mean cleaned up: it is also false from the acknowledgement
	// until the cleanup is scheduled after publication, while the promoted
	// parts are still in PromotedUnsafe, which only the cleanup
	// acknowledgement empties.
	CleanupPending bool
}

// PromotionOutcomes lists the recorded promotions above after, ascending,
// whose partition matches tableID and partitionID (an empty filter matches
// every value), at most limit of them (limit <= 0: no limit), under the read
// lock. next is the last listed sequence while more remain and 0 when the
// list is complete; promotionSeq is the current PromotionSeq. The views are
// detached and the read never writes.
func (f *FSM) PromotionOutcomes(tableID, partitionID string, after uint64, limit int) (outcomes []PromotionOutcomeView, next, promotionSeq uint64) {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()

	var seqs []uint64
	for seq, pp := range f.st.PendingPromotions {
		if pp == nil || seq <= after {
			continue
		}
		if (tableID != "" && pp.Promote.TableID != tableID) || (partitionID != "" && pp.Promote.PartitionID != partitionID) {
			continue
		}
		seqs = append(seqs, seq)
	}
	slices.Sort(seqs)
	if limit > 0 && len(seqs) > limit {
		seqs = seqs[:limit]
		next = seqs[limit-1]
	}
	for _, seq := range seqs {
		outcomes = append(outcomes, f.promotionOutcomeLocked(seq, f.st.PendingPromotions[seq]))
	}
	return outcomes, next, f.st.PromotionSeq
}

// promotionOutcomeLocked is the detached view of recorded promotion seq.
func (f *FSM) promotionOutcomeLocked(seq uint64, pp *PendingPromotion) PromotionOutcomeView {
	v := PromotionOutcomeView{
		PromotionSeq:   seq,
		Promote:        pp.Promote,
		StatementSeqs:  slices.Clone(pp.StatementSeqs),
		BlockSeq:       f.promotionBlockLocked(pp),
		AuthorityJWS:   pp.AuthorityJWS,
		AuthorityEpoch: pp.AuthorityEpoch,
		Acked:          pp.Acked,
		AckJWS:         pp.AckJWS,
		AckEpoch:       pp.AckEpoch,
		CleanupPending: f.st.PendingCleanups[seq] != nil,
	}
	v.Promote.CandidateParts = clonePartRefs(pp.Promote.CandidateParts)
	if track, ok := f.promotionTrackLocked(seq); ok {
		v.Track = &L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: track}
	}
	v.SourceNode, _ = f.sharedSourceLocked(seq, pp.StatementSeqs)
	if pp.Ack != nil {
		ack := *pp.Ack
		ack.Parts = slices.Clone(pp.Ack.Parts)
		ack.SafePartitionParts = slices.Clone(pp.Ack.SafePartitionParts)
		v.Ack = &ack
	}
	return v
}

// promotionBlockLocked is the block of a promotion: the newest block among
// the statements it covers, 0 when none is known. It is the one max-block
// rule: cleanup coverage (WorkSet), PromotionWork.BlockSeq, promotion
// outcomes and the drain view all use it.
func (f *FSM) promotionBlockLocked(pp *PendingPromotion) uint64 {
	var block uint64
	for _, statementSeq := range pp.StatementSeqs {
		if ss := f.st.Statements[statementSeq]; ss != nil && ss.BlockSeq > block {
			block = ss.BlockSeq
		}
	}
	return block
}
```

Create `fsm/reads_verification.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"fmt"
	"slices"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// StatementCandidatesView is one statement of a block as GetBlockVerification
// serves it (pb.StatementCandidates): what its source claimed, which of its
// candidate parts still await a promotion, and its lifecycle status.
type StatementCandidatesView struct {
	StatementSeq uint64
	StatementID  string
	Status       Status
	SourceNode   string
	// RCBound reports a bound result claim; the claim fields below are empty
	// without one.
	RCBound              bool
	SourceClaimRoot      string
	CandidateParts       []arbiter.CandidatePart
	PartitionNewPartSums []arbiter.PartitionLtHashSum
	// UnpromotedParts lists, ascending, the part_row_lthash of every
	// candidate part no applied promotion covers yet.
	UnpromotedParts []string
}

// VerifierEvidenceView is one selected verifier's evidence for a block
// (pb.VerifierEvidence). Evaluated reports that the block's three-way
// verdict judged this verifier: its evidence was complete when the FSM last
// evaluated the block, which it stops doing once quorum latches.
type VerifierEvidenceView struct {
	ReplicaID   string
	Attestation *replay.ReplayAttestation
	ByteScan    *arbiter.ByteSideScanMsg
	Evaluated   bool
	Verdict     ReplicaVerdict
}

// BlockVerificationView is one sealed block's verification material
// (pb.BlockVerification; housegate spec 2026-10-14 §15, P2 shadow
// verification). Dispatch is the material the leader dispatches from
// (BlockDispatchInfo), so Dispatch.ReplayJob() is the job every selected
// verifier receives and Dispatch.CandidateParts the parts it scans.
type BlockVerificationView struct {
	Dispatch         BlockDispatchInfo
	Statements       []StatementCandidatesView
	SourceNodes      []string
	Evidence         []VerifierEvidenceView
	VerdictEvaluated bool
	Quorum           bool
	Anchor           *arbiter.AnchorRef
	Finality         bool
	LastMergeable    bool
}

// BlockVerificationView reads block blockSeq's verification under the read
// lock. It wraps ErrL3BlockNotFound for a block that is not sealed and
// ErrL3BlockIncomplete for a sealed block whose retained statements or
// replay material are incomplete on this node (BlockDispatchInfo would
// answer ok=false), and refuses a snapshot-query block, which has no INSERT
// verification. The view is detached and the read never writes.
func (f *FSM) BlockVerificationView(blockSeq uint64) (BlockVerificationView, error) {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()

	if blockSeq == 0 || blockSeq > uint64(len(f.st.Blocks)) {
		return BlockVerificationView{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %d", ErrL3BlockNotFound, blockSeq)
	}
	header := &f.st.Blocks[blockSeq-1]
	if header.QueryStatementRoot != "" {
		return BlockVerificationView{}, fmt.Errorf("l3 block %d is a snapshot-query block and has no INSERT verification", blockSeq)
	}
	stmts, complete := f.blockStatementsComplete(blockSeq)
	if !complete {
		return BlockVerificationView{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: l3 block %d header declares %d statements and this node does not retain them all",
			ErrL3BlockIncomplete, blockSeq, header.StatementCount)
	}
	info, ok := f.blockDispatchInfoLocked(blockSeq)
	if !ok {
		return BlockVerificationView{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: l3 block %d has no complete replay material on this node (chain hash, table-set transition or registry schemas)",
			ErrL3BlockIncomplete, blockSeq)
	}
	view := BlockVerificationView{Dispatch: info}
	for _, ss := range stmts {
		view.Statements = append(view.Statements, statementCandidates(ss))
	}
	bv := f.st.Verifications[blockSeq]
	if bv == nil {
		return view, nil
	}
	view.SourceNodes = cloneStrings(bv.SourceNodes)
	view.VerdictEvaluated = bv.Verdict != nil
	view.Quorum = bv.Verdict != nil && bv.Verdict.Quorum
	view.Anchor = cloneAnchorRef(bv.Anchor)
	view.Finality, view.LastMergeable = bv.Finality, bv.LastMergeable
	for _, rid := range bv.VerifierSet {
		ev := VerifierEvidenceView{ReplicaID: rid, Attestation: cloneAttestation(bv.Attestations[rid]), ByteScan: cloneByteSideScan(bv.ByteScans[rid])}
		if bv.Verdict != nil {
			ev.Verdict, ev.Evaluated = bv.Verdict.Replicas[rid]
		}
		view.Evidence = append(view.Evidence, ev)
	}
	return view, nil
}

// ReplayJob is the replay job the leader dispatches to every selected
// verifier of the block (orchestrator dispatchEvidence) and
// SafeState.GetBlockVerification serves, so a shadow verifier replays
// exactly what the selected verifiers replayed.
func (info BlockDispatchInfo) ReplayJob() replay.ReplayJob {
	return replay.ReplayJob{
		BlockSeq:           info.Header.L3BlockSeq,
		PrevSafeSnapshotID: info.Header.PrevSafeSnapshotID,
		PrevStateRoot:      info.Header.PrevStateRoot,
		SchemaSnapshotID:   info.Header.SchemaSnapshotID,
		ExecutorProfileID:  info.Header.ExecutorProfileID,
		SourceClaimRoot:    info.SourceClaimRoot,
		Statements:         info.Statements,
		TableSetTransition: info.TableSetTransition,
		TableSchemas:       info.TableSchemas,
	}
}

// statementCandidates is the detached view of one retained statement.
func statementCandidates(ss *StatementState) StatementCandidatesView {
	v := StatementCandidatesView{StatementSeq: ss.Seq, StatementID: ss.Env.StatementID.Flat(), Status: ss.Status,
		SourceNode: ss.SourceNode, RCBound: ss.RC != nil, UnpromotedParts: sortedPresent(ss.UnpromotedParts)}
	if ss.RC != nil {
		v.SourceClaimRoot = ss.RC.SourceClaimRoot
		v.CandidateParts = slices.Clone(ss.RC.CandidateParts)
		v.PartitionNewPartSums = slices.Clone(ss.RC.PartitionNewPartSums)
	}
	return v
}

// cloneAttestation is a detached copy of a stored attestation, or nil.
func cloneAttestation(in *replay.ReplayAttestation) *replay.ReplayAttestation {
	if in == nil {
		return nil
	}
	c := *in
	c.Receipt.PartitionCommitmentsAfter = slices.Clone(in.Receipt.PartitionCommitmentsAfter)
	if in.Receipt.AffectedParts != nil {
		c.Receipt.AffectedParts = clonePartManifestEntries(in.Receipt.AffectedParts)
	}
	return &c
}

// cloneByteSideScan is a detached copy of a stored byte-side scan, or nil.
func cloneByteSideScan(in *arbiter.ByteSideScanMsg) *arbiter.ByteSideScanMsg {
	if in == nil {
		return nil
	}
	c := *in
	c.Parts = slices.Clone(in.Parts)
	return &c
}
```

```go
package fsm

import (
	"slices"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// DrainView is the consensus-update drain state the leader's consensus holds
// read (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §10.1-§10.2, plan S3-A contract §4). It
// decides nothing: Apply's drain gate stays the authority, and Refusal is
// that gate's answer on the same state.
type DrainView struct {
	PromotionSeq uint64
	// Refusal is drainGateRefusalLocked: the reason Apply would refuse a
	// consensus update for drain, "" when the gate passes.
	Refusal      string
	TracksActive bool
	// GlobalPrefix is the global safe prefix. GlobalFrontier is the last
	// block a promotion may cover before the tracks activation: the first
	// block above the prefix, or the prefix while no later block is sealed.
	GlobalPrefix   uint64
	GlobalFrontier uint64
	// InFlightBlocks lists, ascending, every block whose promotion work
	// holds the drain gate (an unacknowledged promotion, a scheduled
	// cleanup, a promoted unsafe part, a rejected-part cleanup), whatever
	// its track, plus GlobalFrontier while it is above GlobalPrefix.
	InFlightBlocks []uint64
	// Tracks has one entry per enrolled indexer, sorted by id, after the
	// tracks activation; nil before it.
	Tracks []TrackDrainView
}

// TrackDrainView is one enrolled track's drain state: its safe prefix, its
// promotion frontier (trackPromotionFrontierLocked) and, ascending, its
// blocks whose promotion work holds the drain gate plus the frontier while
// it is above the prefix.
type TrackDrainView struct {
	IndexerID      uint64
	Quarantined    bool
	Prefix         uint64
	Frontier       uint64
	InFlightBlocks []uint64
}

// DrainView reads the drain state under the read lock. The view is detached
// and the read never writes.
func (f *FSM) DrainView() DrainView {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()

	prefix := safePrefixLocked(f)
	v := DrainView{
		PromotionSeq:   f.st.PromotionSeq,
		Refusal:        f.drainGateRefusalLocked(),
		TracksActive:   f.tracksActiveLocked(),
		GlobalPrefix:   prefix,
		GlobalFrontier: f.globalPromotionFrontierLocked(prefix),
	}
	all, byTrack := f.drainWorkBlocksLocked()
	if v.GlobalFrontier > prefix {
		all[v.GlobalFrontier] = true
	}
	v.InFlightBlocks = sortedBlocks(all)
	for _, tr := range f.trackIndexersLocked() {
		trackPrefix := f.trackPrefixLocked(tr.IndexerID)
		frontier := f.trackPromotionFrontierLocked(tr.IndexerID)
		blocks := byTrack[tr.IndexerID]
		if blocks == nil {
			blocks = map[uint64]bool{}
		}
		if frontier > trackPrefix {
			blocks[frontier] = true
		}
		v.Tracks = append(v.Tracks, TrackDrainView{IndexerID: tr.IndexerID, Quarantined: tr.Quarantined,
			Prefix: trackPrefix, Frontier: frontier, InFlightBlocks: sortedBlocks(blocks)})
	}
	return v
}

// globalPromotionFrontierLocked is the pre-activation promotion frontier
// (WorkSet's safePrefix+1) bounded by the sealed tip.
func (f *FSM) globalPromotionFrontierLocked(prefix uint64) uint64 {
	if prefix < uint64(len(f.st.Blocks)) {
		return prefix + 1
	}
	return prefix
}

// drainWorkBlocksLocked collects the blocks whose promotion work holds the
// drain gate: every block, and per track for work whose track resolves.
func (f *FSM) drainWorkBlocksLocked() (all map[uint64]bool, byTrack map[uint64]map[uint64]bool) {
	all, byTrack = map[uint64]bool{}, map[uint64]map[uint64]bool{}
	add := func(block, track uint64, tracked bool) {
		if block == 0 {
			return
		}
		all[block] = true
		if !tracked {
			return
		}
		if byTrack[track] == nil {
			byTrack[track] = map[uint64]bool{}
		}
		byTrack[track][block] = true
	}
	for seq, pp := range f.st.PendingPromotions {
		if pp == nil || !f.promotionHoldsDrainLocked(seq, pp) {
			continue
		}
		track, ok := f.promotionTrackLocked(seq)
		add(f.promotionBlockLocked(pp), track, ok)
	}
	if f.st.Tracks != nil {
		for _, rp := range f.st.Tracks.RejectedParts {
			track, ok := f.blockTrackLocked(rp.BlockSeq)
			add(rp.BlockSeq, track, ok)
		}
	}
	return all, byTrack
}

// promotionHoldsDrainLocked reports whether promotion seq is work the drain
// gate counts: unacknowledged, with a scheduled cleanup, or with a promoted
// part still in PromotedUnsafe.
func (f *FSM) promotionHoldsDrainLocked(seq uint64, pp *PendingPromotion) bool {
	if !pp.Acked || f.st.PendingCleanups[seq] != nil {
		return true
	}
	reg := f.st.PromotedUnsafe[arbiter.TablePartition{TableID: pp.Promote.TableID, PartitionID: pp.Promote.PartitionID}]
	for _, part := range pp.Promote.CandidateParts {
		if reg[part.PartRowLtHash] {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// sortedBlocks lists set's blocks ascending; nil when it is empty.
func sortedBlocks(set map[uint64]bool) []uint64 {
	var out []uint64
	for block := range set {
		out = append(out, block)
	}
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}
```

```go
package orchestrator

import (
	"testing"

	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// TestDispatchedReplayJobIsTheBlockVerificationJob: the job the leader
// dispatches to every selected verifier is BlockDispatchInfo.ReplayJob,
// which SafeState.GetBlockVerification serves (housegate spec 2026-10-14
// §15, P2 shadow verification), so a shadow verifier replays exactly it.
func TestDispatchedReplayJobIsTheBlockVerificationJob(t *testing.T) {
	f, node, fv, _, _, o, _ := newHarness(t, testParamsO())
	seedGenesisWriterAndVerifiers(t, node)
	submitViaNode(t, node, statementFixture{account: testAccountO(t), seq: 1})
	sealViaNode(t, node)
	registerRCViaNode(t, node, f, 1)
	markReplayingViaNode(t, node, 1)
	ws, err := f.WorkSet()
	if err != nil || len(ws.EvidenceIncomplete) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("work set = %+v, %v", ws.EvidenceIncomplete, err)
	}
	if err := o.dispatchEvidence(t.Context(), ws.EvidenceIncomplete[0]); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	view, err := f.BlockVerificationView(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := wire.ReplayJobToPB(view.Dispatch.ReplayJob())
	jobs := 0
	for _, d := range fv.drain() {
		job := d.msg.GetReplayJob()
		if job == nil {
			continue
		}
		jobs++
		if !proto.Equal(job, want) {
			t.Fatalf("job sent to %s = %v, want %v", d.to, job, want)
		}
	}
	if jobs != fsm.VerifierSelectN {
		t.Fatalf("sent %d replay jobs, want one per selected verifier (%d)", jobs, fsm.VerifierSelectN)
	}
}
```

```go
// requireEveryField fails unless every field of m is set, so a converter test
// whose literal sets them all also catches a field a converter drops and a
// field a later arbiter-proto release adds.
func requireEveryField(t *testing.T, m proto.Message) {
	t.Helper()
	msg := m.ProtoReflect()
	fields := msg.Descriptor().Fields()
	for i := 0; i < fields.Len(); i++ {
		if fd := fields.Get(i); !msg.Has(fd) {
			t.Fatalf("%s.%s is not set by the test literal", msg.Descriptor().Name(), fd.Name())
		}
	}
}

	requireEveryField(t, want)
	requireEveryField(t, want.GetPartitions()[0])
	if got := partitionStatesToPB(stage3PartitionStatesView()); !proto.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("partitionStatesToPB = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
}

// TestPromotionOutcomesToPBCarriesTheStoredAck: the canonical converters
// carry the promotion and the acknowledgement; a pre-activation outcome has
// no track and no ack.
func TestPromotionOutcomesToPBCarriesTheStoredAck(t *testing.T) {
	outcomes := stage3PromotionOutcomes()
	want := &pb.PromotionOutcomes{PromotionSeq: 12, NextAfterPromotionSeq: 4, Outcomes: []*pb.PromotionOutcome{
		{PromotionSeq: 3, Promote: wire.PromoteToPB(outcomes[0].Promote), StatementSeqs: []uint64{5, 6}, BlockSeq: 4,
			Track: &pb.L3BlockTrack{IndexerId: 2}, SourceNode: "s2", AuthorityJws: "authority.jws", AuthorityEpoch: 6, Acked: true,
			Ack: wire.PromotionAckToPB(*outcomes[0].Ack), AckJws: "ack.jws", AckEpoch: 6, CleanupPending: true},
		{PromotionSeq: 4, Promote: wire.PromoteToPB(outcomes[1].Promote), StatementSeqs: []uint64{7}, BlockSeq: 5, SourceNode: "s2",
			AuthorityJws: "authority2.jws", AuthorityEpoch: 6},
	}}
	requireEveryField(t, want)
	requireEveryField(t, want.GetOutcomes()[0])
	if got := promotionOutcomesToPB(outcomes, 4, 12); !proto.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("promotionOutcomesToPB = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
}

// TestBlockVerificationToPBCarriesEveryField: the header, the replay job,
// the attestation, the scan and the anchor go through the converters the
// rest of the system uses; scan_parts is exactly the leader's
// ByteSideScanRequest.parts; the candidate parts and partition sums equal
// arbiter-core's RC conversion.
func TestBlockVerificationToPBCarriesEveryField(t *testing.T) {
	view := stage3BlockVerificationView()
	want := &pb.BlockVerification{
		Header:    l3HeaderToPB(view.Dispatch.Header),
		ChainHash: "0xchain",
		ReplayJob: wire.ReplayJobToPB(view.Dispatch.ReplayJob()),
		Statements: []*pb.StatementCandidates{{StatementSeq: 9, StatementId: "0xabc:1:n1", Status: "QuorumVerified", SourceNode: "s2", RcBound: true,
			SourceClaimRoot: "0xclaim",
			CandidateParts: []*pb.CandidatePart{{TableId: "db.t", PartitionId: "p0", PartName: "all_1_1_0", PartRowLthash: "0xrow",
				PartPhysHash: "0xphys", RowCount: 3, Bytes: 96}},
			PartitionNewPartSums:      []*pb.PartitionLtHashSum{{TableId: "db.t", PartitionId: "p0", NewPartsLthashSum: "0xrow"}},
			UnpromotedPartRowLthashes: []string{"0xrow"}}},
		ScanParts:   []*pb.PartRef{{TableId: "db.t", PartitionId: "p0", PartRowLthash: "0xrow", PartName: "all_1_1_0"}},
		SourceNodes: []string{"s2"},
		VerifierSet: []string{"v1", "v2"},
		Evidence: []*pb.VerifierEvidence{
			{ReplicaId: "v1", Attestation: wire.AttestationToPB(*view.Evidence[0].Attestation), ByteSideScan: wire.ScanToPB(*view.Evidence[0].ByteScan),
				Evaluated: true, Check1RootMatch: true, Check2PartitionMatch: true, Check3ByteSideMatch: true, Pass: true},
			{ReplicaId: "v2"},
		},
		VerdictEvaluated: true, Quorum: true, Anchor: wire.AnchorRefToPB(*view.Anchor), Finality: true, LastMergeable: true,
	}
	requireEveryField(t, want)
	requireEveryField(t, want.GetStatements()[0])
	requireEveryField(t, want.GetEvidence()[0])
	got := blockVerificationToPB(view)
	if !proto.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("blockVerificationToPB = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	if parts := wire.ByteSideScanDispatch(5, view.Dispatch.CandidateParts).GetByteSideScan().GetParts(); len(parts) != len(got.GetScanParts()) || !proto.Equal(parts[0], got.GetScanParts()[0]) {
		t.Fatalf("scan parts = %v, the leader's scan request carries %v", got.GetScanParts(), parts)
	}
	rc := wire.RCToPB(arbiter.RCRecord{CandidateParts: view.Statements[0].CandidateParts, PartitionNewPartSums: view.Statements[0].PartitionNewPartSums})
	if !proto.Equal(rc.GetCandidateParts()[0], got.GetStatements()[0].GetCandidateParts()[0]) ||
		!proto.Equal(rc.GetPartitionNewPartSums()[0], got.GetStatements()[0].GetPartitionNewPartSums()[0]) {
		t.Fatal("the candidate conversion disagrees with arbiter-core's RC conversion")
	}
}

// TestStage3ReadsRoundTripThroughArbiterCoreWire: what the server sends is
// what arbiter-core's dataplane client decodes (contract §3), the watermark
// included: arbiter-core's canonical SafeWatermark is a plain conversion of
// fsm.SafeWatermark (same fields, order, types and tags).
func TestStage3ReadsRoundTripThroughArbiterCoreWire(t *testing.T) {
	view := stage3PartitionStatesView()
	states := wire.PartitionStatesFromPB(partitionStatesToPB(view))
	wantPartitions := []wire.PartitionState{{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: "p0", BaseSafeSnapshotID: "snap-3", BasePartitionRoot: "0xbase", PublishSeq: 7,
		SafeParts: view.Partitions[0].SafeParts, PromotedUnsafePartRowLtHashes: []string{"0xa", "0xb"},
		UnackedPromotionSeq: 9, LastAckedPromotionSeq: 7, InventoryUnrefreshed: true}}
	if states.PromotionSeq != 9 || states.SafeWatermark != arbiter.SafeWatermark(view.SafeWatermark) || !reflect.DeepEqual(states.Partitions, wantPartitions) {
		t.Fatalf("decoded partition states = %+v, want watermark %+v and %+v", states, view.SafeWatermark, wantPartitions)
	}
	outcomes := stage3PromotionOutcomes()
	two := uint64(2)
	decoded := wire.PromotionOutcomesFromPB(promotionOutcomesToPB(outcomes, 4, 12))
	want := wire.PromotionOutcomes{PromotionSeq: 12, NextAfterPromotionSeq: 4, Outcomes: []wire.PromotionOutcome{
		{PromotionSeq: 3, Promote: outcomes[0].Promote, StatementSeqs: []uint64{5, 6}, BlockSeq: 4, TrackIndexerID: &two, SourceNode: "s2",
			AuthorityJWS: "authority.jws", AuthorityEpoch: 6, Acked: true, Ack: outcomes[0].Ack, AckJWS: "ack.jws", AckEpoch: 6, CleanupPending: true},
		{PromotionSeq: 4, Promote: outcomes[1].Promote, StatementSeqs: []uint64{7}, BlockSeq: 5, SourceNode: "s2",
			AuthorityJWS: "authority2.jws", AuthorityEpoch: 6},
	}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(decoded, want) {
		t.Fatalf("decoded outcomes = %+v, want %+v", decoded, want)
	}
}

// TestStage3ShapeRefusalsNameTheField: the verbatim refusals of contract §4.
func TestStage3ShapeRefusalsNameTheField(t *testing.T) {

// TestGetBlockVerificationServesTheSealedBlock: the handler serves the FSM
// view of a sealed block with the header and chain hash GetL3Block serves.
func TestGetBlockVerificationServesTheSealedBlock(t *testing.T) {
	h := newSafeStateTestHarness(t)
	got, err := h.svc.GetBlockVerification(h.ctx, &pb.L3BlockRef{L3BlockSeq: 1})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	view, err := h.state.BlockVerificationView(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !proto.Equal(got, blockVerificationToPB(view)) {
		t.Fatalf("GetBlockVerification = %v, want the FSM view", got)
	}
	hdr, chainHash, _, err := h.state.L3BlockView(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !proto.Equal(got.GetHeader(), l3HeaderToPB(hdr)) || got.GetChainHash() != chainHash || got.GetReplayJob().GetBlockSeq() != 1 ||
		len(got.GetReplayJob().GetStatements()) != 2 || len(got.GetStatements()) != 2 || got.GetStatements()[0].GetRcBound() ||
		len(got.GetEvidence()) != 0 || got.GetVerdictEvaluated() {
		t.Fatalf("an unmarked two-statement block = %v", got)
	}
	info, ok := h.state.StatementStatusView(got.GetStatements()[0].GetStatementId())
	if !ok || got.GetStatements()[0].GetStatus() != info.Status.String() {
		t.Fatalf("statement status = %q, FSM %+v", got.GetStatements()[0].GetStatus(), info)
	}
}

// TestGetBlockVerificationNotFoundAndDataLoss: GetL3Block's mapping (an
// unknown block is NotFound, a block with missing statements is DataLoss
// naming it).
func TestGetBlockVerificationNotFoundAndDataLoss(t *testing.T) {
	h := newSafeStateTestHarness(t)
	if _, err := h.svc.GetBlockVerification(h.ctx, &pb.L3BlockRef{L3BlockSeq: 42}); status.Code(err) != codes.NotFound ||
		status.Convert(err).Message() != "no sealed block at that seq" {
		t.Fatalf("unknown block = %v, want NotFound", err)
	}
	corrupt := snapshotWithoutStatement(t, h.state, "1")
	state := newServerTestFSM(t)
	if err := state.Restore(io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(corrupt))); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("restore synthetic incomplete block: %v", err)
	}
	svc := &safeStateService{s: New(Deps{Node: &fakeNode{f: state, leader: true}, FSM: state})}
	_, err := svc.GetBlockVerification(t.Context(), &pb.L3BlockRef{L3BlockSeq: 1})
	if status.Code(err) != codes.DataLoss || !strings.HasPrefix(status.Convert(err).Message(), "l3 block 1 is incomplete on this node: ") {
		t.Fatalf("incomplete block = %v, want DataLoss naming block 1", err)
	}
}
```
