```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"slices"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// Page sizes of GetPromotionOutcomes (plan S3-A contract §4): a request with
// limit 0 gets the default page, and a limit above the cap is refused rather
// than clamped, so a caller never mistakes a short page for the end.
const (
	defaultPromotionOutcomesLimit = 256
	maxPromotionOutcomesLimit     = 1024
)

// GetPartitionStates serves one table's partition states (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §14: the owner audit's FSM reference). Like every SafeState
// read but GetClientSeqState it crosses one leader barrier, after the shape
// refusal, so the audit's "FSM ahead" comparison reads committed state.
func (svc *safeStateService) GetPartitionStates(ctx context.Context, req *pb.GetPartitionStatesRequest) (*pb.PartitionStates, error) {
	if req.GetTableId() == "" {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "partition states table_id is required")
	}
	if err := svc.s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return partitionStatesToPB(svc.s.d.FSM.PartitionStates(req.GetTableId(), req.GetPartitionId())), nil
}

// GetPromotionOutcomes serves one page of recorded promotions, ascending,
// above after_promotion_seq; next_after_promotion_seq is the cursor of the
// next page and 0 at the end.
func (svc *safeStateService) GetPromotionOutcomes(ctx context.Context, req *pb.GetPromotionOutcomesRequest) (*pb.PromotionOutcomes, error) {
	if req.GetPartitionId() != "" && req.GetTableId() == "" {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "promotion outcomes partition_id needs table_id")
	}
	limit, err := promotionOutcomesLimit(req.GetLimit())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := svc.s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	outcomes, next, seq := svc.s.d.FSM.PromotionOutcomes(req.GetTableId(), req.GetPartitionId(), req.GetAfterPromotionSeq(), limit)
	return promotionOutcomesToPB(outcomes, next, seq), nil
}

// promotionOutcomesLimit is the page size a request asks for.
func promotionOutcomesLimit(requested uint32) (int, error) {
	switch {
	case requested == 0:
		return defaultPromotionOutcomesLimit, nil
	case requested > maxPromotionOutcomesLimit:
		return 0, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "promotion outcomes limit must be at most %d", maxPromotionOutcomesLimit)
	}
	return int(requested), nil
}

// GetBlockVerification serves a sealed block's verification material: the
// replay job and scan parts the leader dispatches, each statement's claim,
// and each selected verifier's evidence and outcome (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §15, P2 shadow verification). Errors map as GetL3Block's do.
func (svc *safeStateService) GetBlockVerification(ctx context.Context, ref *pb.L3BlockRef) (*pb.BlockVerification, error) {
	if ref.GetL3BlockSeq() == 0 {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "block verification l3_block_seq is required")
	}
	if err := svc.s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	view, err := svc.s.d.FSM.BlockVerificationView(ref.GetL3BlockSeq())
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, fsm.ErrL3BlockNotFound):
		return nil, status.Error(codes.NotFound, "no sealed block at that seq")
	case errors.Is(err, fsm.ErrL3BlockIncomplete):
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.DataLoss, "l3 block %d is incomplete on this node: %v", ref.GetL3BlockSeq(), err)
	case err != nil:
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "l3 block %d: %v", ref.GetL3BlockSeq(), err)
	}
	return blockVerificationToPB(view), nil
}

func partitionStatesToPB(v fsm.PartitionStatesView) *pb.PartitionStates {
	out := &pb.PartitionStates{PromotionSeq: v.PromotionSeq, SafeWatermark: &pb.SafeWatermark{
		SnapshotId: v.SafeWatermark.SnapshotID, SafeBlockSeq: v.SafeWatermark.SafeBlockSeq, ManifestRoot: v.SafeWatermark.ManifestRoot}}
	for _, p := range v.Partitions {
		entry := &pb.PartitionStateEntry{
			TableId: p.Partition.TableID, PartitionId: p.Partition.PartitionID,
			BaseSafeSnapshotId: p.BaseSafeSnapshotID, BasePartitionRoot: p.BasePartitionRoot, PublishSeq: p.PublishSeq,
			PromotedUnsafePartRowLthashes: slices.Clone(p.PromotedUnsafe),
			UnackedPromotionSeq:           p.UnackedPromotionSeq, LastAckedPromotionSeq: p.LastAckedPromotionSeq,
			InventoryUnrefreshed: p.InventoryUnrefreshed,
		}
		for _, part := range p.SafeParts {
			entry.SafeParts = append(entry.SafeParts, wire.PartManifestEntryToPB(part))
		}
		out.Partitions = append(out.Partitions, entry)
	}
	return out
}

func promotionOutcomesToPB(outcomes []fsm.PromotionOutcomeView, next, promotionSeq uint64) *pb.PromotionOutcomes {
	out := &pb.PromotionOutcomes{PromotionSeq: promotionSeq, NextAfterPromotionSeq: next}
	for _, o := range outcomes {
		out.Outcomes = append(out.Outcomes, promotionOutcomeToPB(o))
	}
	return out
}

func promotionOutcomeToPB(o fsm.PromotionOutcomeView) *pb.PromotionOutcome {
	out := &pb.PromotionOutcome{
		PromotionSeq: o.PromotionSeq, Promote: wire.PromoteToPB(o.Promote), StatementSeqs: slices.Clone(o.StatementSeqs),
		BlockSeq: o.BlockSeq, SourceNode: o.SourceNode, AuthorityJws: o.AuthorityJWS, AuthorityEpoch: o.AuthorityEpoch,
		Acked: o.Acked, AckJws: o.AckJWS, AckEpoch: o.AckEpoch, CleanupPending: o.CleanupPending,
	}
	// Message presence keeps indexer 0 distinct from "no track".
	if o.Track != nil {
		out.Track = &pb.L3BlockTrack{IndexerId: o.Track.IndexerID}
	}
	if o.Ack != nil {
		out.Ack = wire.PromotionAckToPB(*o.Ack)
	}
	return out
}

func blockVerificationToPB(v fsm.BlockVerificationView) *pb.BlockVerification {
	out := &pb.BlockVerification{
		Header:    l3HeaderToPB(v.Dispatch.Header),
		ChainHash: v.Dispatch.ChainHash,
		ReplayJob: wire.ReplayJobToPB(v.Dispatch.ReplayJob()),
		// Exactly the parts of the ByteSideScanRequest the leader dispatches.
		ScanParts:        wire.ByteSideScanDispatch(v.Dispatch.Header.L3BlockSeq, v.Dispatch.CandidateParts).GetByteSideScan().GetParts(),
		SourceNodes:      slices.Clone(v.SourceNodes),
		VerifierSet:      slices.Clone(v.Dispatch.VerifierSet),
		VerdictEvaluated: v.VerdictEvaluated,
		Quorum:           v.Quorum,
		Finality:         v.Finality,
		LastMergeable:    v.LastMergeable,
	}
	if v.Anchor != nil {
		out.Anchor = wire.AnchorRefToPB(*v.Anchor)
	}
	for _, s := range v.Statements {
		out.Statements = append(out.Statements, statementCandidatesToPB(s))
	}
	for _, e := range v.Evidence {
		out.Evidence = append(out.Evidence, verifierEvidenceToPB(e))
	}
	return out
}

func statementCandidatesToPB(s fsm.StatementCandidatesView) *pb.StatementCandidates {
	out := &pb.StatementCandidates{
		StatementSeq: s.StatementSeq, StatementId: s.StatementID, Status: s.Status.String(), SourceNode: s.SourceNode,
		RcBound: s.RCBound, SourceClaimRoot: s.SourceClaimRoot, UnpromotedPartRowLthashes: slices.Clone(s.UnpromotedParts),
	}
	for _, cp := range s.CandidateParts {
		out.CandidateParts = append(out.CandidateParts, candidatePartToPB(cp))
	}
	for _, sum := range s.PartitionNewPartSums {
		out.PartitionNewPartSums = append(out.PartitionNewPartSums, partitionLtHashSumToPB(sum))
	}
	return out
}

func verifierEvidenceToPB(e fsm.VerifierEvidenceView) *pb.VerifierEvidence {
	out := &pb.VerifierEvidence{
		ReplicaId: e.ReplicaID, Evaluated: e.Evaluated,
		Check1RootMatch: e.Verdict.Check1RootMatch, Check2PartitionMatch: e.Verdict.Check2PartitionMatch,
		Check3ByteSideMatch: e.Verdict.Check3ByteSideMatch, Pass: e.Verdict.Pass,
	}
	if e.Attestation != nil {
		out.Attestation = wire.AttestationToPB(*e.Attestation)
	}
	if e.ByteScan != nil {
		out.ByteSideScan = wire.ScanToPB(*e.ByteScan)
	}
	return out
}

// candidatePartToPB and partitionLtHashSumToPB mirror arbiter-core's
// unexported candidatePartToPB and partitionSumToPB (wire/convert.go:80,89
// at v0.14.1), which RCToPB uses;
// TestBlockVerificationToPBCarriesEveryField pins that they agree.
func candidatePartToPB(v arbiter.CandidatePart) *pb.CandidatePart {
	return &pb.CandidatePart{TableId: v.TableID, PartitionId: v.PartitionID, PartName: v.PartName,
		PartRowLthash: v.PartRowLtHash, PartPhysHash: v.PartPhysHash, RowCount: v.RowCount, Bytes: v.Bytes}
}

func partitionLtHashSumToPB(v arbiter.PartitionLtHashSum) *pb.PartitionLtHashSum {
	return &pb.PartitionLtHashSum{TableId: v.TableID, PartitionId: v.PartitionID, NewPartsLthashSum: v.NewPartsLtHashSum}
}
```

In `README.md`, insert before `## Artifact disposition admission` (`:382`):

```markdown
## Stage-3 reads and consensus holds

Plan S3-A of housegate spec 2026-10-14 (stage 3, phase P0) changes no consensus format: no Raft command, field, snapshot byte or feature string moves, so every voter, verifier and SNode built from it replays today's log to the same state and can be rolled back. It adds three leader-barriered `SafeState` reads that later stage-3 phases build on and leader-local consensus holds (below).

**Reads.** All three are served on `grpc_listen` beside the other `SafeState` reads, cross one leader read barrier each (one replicated `LogBarrier` entry; a follower answers `NotLeader` with the leader hint and pays none), and refuse a malformed request before the barrier. `GetPartitionStates{table_id, partition_id}` lists one table's partitions (`table_id` is required: `partition states table_id is required`; an empty `partition_id` lists them all), each with its committed promotion base (`base_safe_snapshot_id`, `base_partition_root`, `publish_seq`), its acknowledged `safe_parts` inventory, the promoted parts whose `hg_unsafe` copy is not cleaned yet, the newest unacknowledged promotion (`unacked_promotion_seq`, a promotion intent) and the newest acknowledged one, plus the current `promotion_seq` and safe watermark. A partition is listed once an applied acknowledgement reached it; one whose promotions are all unacknowledged or acknowledged with `applied=false` has no entry, even when `partition_id` names it. The SNode's owner audit compares its `hg_safe` with it. `GetPromotionOutcomes{table_id, partition_id, after_promotion_seq, limit}` pages through the recorded promotions in promotion order (`limit` 0 means 256, at most 1024: `promotion outcomes limit must be at most 1024`; `partition_id` needs `table_id`: `promotion outcomes partition_id needs table_id`), each with its block, track, source, authority token, acknowledgement state and pending cleanup; after the tracks activation an acknowledged promotion also carries the source's signed acknowledgement (`ack`, `ack_jws`, `ack_epoch`), applied or not, before it none is recorded. `cleanup_pending` is true only while a scheduled cleanup awaits its acknowledgement, so it is also false between the acknowledgement and the cleanup's scheduling: false does not mean cleaned up (the partition's `promoted_unsafe_part_row_lthashes` empties only on the cleanup acknowledgement). `next_after_promotion_seq` is the next page's cursor and 0 at the end. `GetBlockVerification{l3_block_seq}` (`block verification l3_block_seq is required`) serves a sealed block's verification material for shadow verification: the header and chain hash `GetL3Block` serves, the replay job and the scan parts exactly as the leader dispatches them to each selected verifier, each statement's status, claim, candidate parts and still unpromoted parts, the verifier set, each selected verifier's attestation and byte-side scan with its three check outcomes (`evaluated` is false for evidence the verdict never judged, including evidence that arrived after quorum latched, which a shadow verifier must read as recorded, not failed), the verdict, the anchor, finality and last-mergeable. An unknown block is `NotFound` (`no sealed block at that seq`) and a block whose statements or replay material this node does not retain completely is `DataLoss` (`l3 block N is incomplete on this node: ...`), as `GetL3Block` answers. The promotion and partition reads walk every recorded promotion (promotions are never pruned), which is why `table_id` is required and outcomes are paged.
```

Notes:
- **The lease makes the frozen sequence exact (K7).** `RecordPromotionIssued` has one producer, `orchestrator/promotion.go:152`, and Task 7's `TestOnlyRecordPromotionIssuedAdvancesPromotionSeq` pins that nothing else moves `PromotionSeq`. `issuePromotion` takes the shared lease (`sync.RWMutex.RLock`) inside `BeginPromotionIssuance`, before it reads `PromotionSeqView()+1`, and releases it when the proposal has returned (applied, refused or abandoned with the term). `PrepareConsensusUpdate` takes the lease exclusively, so it waits for an issuance already past its read, then crosses a read barrier and reads the sequence: no issuance that began before the hold can commit after that read, and none can begin after it, because every later `BeginPromotionIssuance` sees the hold. `Lock` is taken on a helper goroutine so a client's deadline still cancels the wait; a writer waiting on `Lock` holds back new readers, so a hold is never starved by a stream of issuances.
- **Authorisation is the update's own (K5).** `PrepareConsensusUpdate` refuses, in order and before anything reaches the log: updates disabled (`consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage`), the mode, the draft, then `authorizeConsensusParamsUpdate` on the draft (token shape, leader check without a barrier, epoch/digest/promotion-sequence preconditions against this leader's applied view, the authority validator with `max_token_age`), then an already active hold. Only then does it take the lease and the one barrier. No new signing purpose exists; the draft is never proposed. The hold id is 16 random bytes in hex, returned only to the caller; `GetConsensusHold` and `ReleaseConsensusHold` need only it (compared in constant time).
- **Readiness.** DRAIN is `ready` once the FSM's drain gate passes (`DrainView.Refusal == ""`, exactly Apply's refusal, Task 7's `TestDrainViewRefusalEqualsTheDrainGate`) and every track that was not quarantined when the hold was taken has a prefix at or above its recorded frontier, skipping one quarantined since; before the tracks activation, the global prefix against the recorded global frontier. Once ready no promotion can be issued under the hold: passed blocks have no promotable statement and later blocks are refused, so `promotion_seq` is stable and the CLI signs the final update with it. An ISSUANCE hold refuses every issuance and is `ready` once the drain gate passes, so the CLI submits the draft it was taken with and no acknowledgement or cleanup is still owed; it can wait until it expires on a half-promoted multi-partition block, whose cleanup waits for a publication the hold prevents (K6), which is why `drain` is the default.
- **What a hold reports (the `ConsensusHold` and `TrackDrain` comments of Task 3's `consensus.proto`).** Every hold reports its id, mode, Raft term, expiry, `ready` and the drain gate's refusal verbatim (`drain_refusal`, empty once it passes). An ISSUANCE hold reports the `promotion_seq` it froze (the draft's `expected_promotion_seq`) and no drain state: `global_prefix_block_seq`, `global_frontier_block_seq`, `in_flight_blocks` and `tracks` stay empty, because it records no frontier (`TestIssuanceHoldReportsNoDrainState`). A DRAIN hold reports the current `promotion_seq`; taken before the tracks activation it fills the `global_*` fields (the global prefix and the frontier recorded at hold start) and `in_flight_blocks` (only blocks at or below that frontier), taken after it one `TrackDrain` per enrolled indexer, ascending, and nothing global. A track's `frontier_block_seq` is the one recorded at hold start, 0 for a track quarantined then, which therefore lists no in-flight block. `GetConsensusHold` is leader-only behind one read barrier (an empty id is refused before it) and answers NotFound `unknown consensus hold` for any id this leader does not hold, including one that ended; `ReleaseConsensusHold` is leader-only (a leader check, no barrier) and answers `Ack` for such an id.
- **What drain mode admits.** A promotion row is admitted when its `BlockSeq` (Task 7's `PromotionWork.BlockSeq`, the newest block of its statements) is at or below its track's recorded frontier: every partition of the frontier block, and a re-issue after an `Applied:false` acknowledgement, which comes back as an ordinary `PromotablePending` row. A row of a later block, of a track without a recorded frontier (quarantined when the hold was taken, or enrolled since) or without a track after the activation is held. The reason is logged at debug level and counted in `arbiter_consensus_hold_held_promotions_total` (one per refused attempt; the orchestrator retries every pass).
- **How a hold ends.** `UpdateConsensusParams` carrying `arbiter-consensus-hold` must name this leader's live hold (else `NotFound unknown consensus hold`, before anything else). Its definite outcome settles the hold: success is `committed`; an `fsm.Rejected` (InvalidArgument after submission) or any error before submission (`proposal.submitted` false: a shape, authorization, precondition or gate refusal, but also a failed leader check, barrier or voter probe, Unavailable, or a context that ended first, because an update never handed to Raft cannot commit) is `refused`, so the operator's re-run is not refused `a consensus hold is already active on this leader` for up to `max_drain_mode`. An unknown outcome (submitted, then Canceled, DeadlineExceeded or Unavailable) leaves the hold to expire, because the update may still commit; a NotLeader answer leaves it to `OnLeadershipLost`. `ReleaseConsensusHold` is `released` and idempotent. Expiry is checked on every access and by a timer, so the gauge drops on time. `OnLeadershipLost` clears the hold (`leadership_lost`), and a hold whose recorded Raft term differs from the current one is void and ends the same way on its next access. A node that does not report a term (test fakes) records term 0 throughout.
- **Limits.** `timeout_ms` 0 means the mode's cap; anything above it is capped: `consensus_admin.max_issuance_hold` (default `2m`, at most `10m`) and `consensus_admin.max_drain_mode` (default `10m`, at most `1h`; the spec asks for at least the measured p99 of promotion → acknowledgement → publication → cleanup acknowledgement). A `server.Config` built without them (every construction site but `cmd/arbiter`) gets the defaults. An issuance hold submits a draft signed before the wait, so keep `max_issuance_hold` below `max_token_age`; drain mode signs its final token after the wait.
- **Rollout.** The hold RPCs exist only on a leader running this release. During the voter rollout (followers first, leader last, Plan S3-B) an older leader answers `Unimplemented`; the CLI refuses with the message below and names `--hold none`. If leadership moves to an older binary mid-hold, the hold is gone with it and the update meets today's preconditions.
- **The Unimplemented message.** Contract §4 fixes it verbatim: `leader does not support consensus holds (arbiter older than this arbiter-admin); upgrade the leader or pass --hold none` (`consensusHoldsUnsupportedMessage`, also the answer of `hold-status` and `hold-release` against such a leader). It names no release on purpose: `ARBITER_TAG` is cut from main after this code merges and is recorded, never predicted (contract §6), so neither this binary nor this task's README can name it. The tag that introduces holds is first named by Task 11 Step 12, which records it in the release ledger once the cut has run, and Plan S3-B's runbook carries it from there.
- **The CLI flow.** `--hold drain` (default): sign the draft at the read `promotion_seq`, `PrepareConsensusUpdate(DRAIN)`, poll `GetConsensusHold` every second (progress on stderr) until ready, re-read `GetConsensusParams` and require the same epoch and digest and the hold's `promotion_seq`, sign the final update with it, run the existing gate re-checks, submit under the metadata. `--hold issuance`: the same, but the draft is submitted. A draft that a promotion overtook between the CLI's read and the leader's check (`… does not match the current promotion sequence …`, or the issuance re-check `… while the hold was taken …`) is re-signed at the new sequence, at most `holdPrepareAttempts` times. Every exit before the submit releases the hold (5 s, detached from the expired operation context). `--hold-timeout` is requested as `timeout_ms` and extends the whole-operation deadline (`--timeout` + `--hold-timeout`). The hold id is printed on stderr so an operator can `hold-status` or `hold-release` it by hand.
- **Existing CLI tests keep today's flow.** The update-arg helpers (`updateArgs`, `laneUpdateArgs`, `tracksUpdateArgs`, and through them `activationArgs`, `claimsUpdateArgs`, `tracksActivationArgs`) and the four inline update argument lists append `--hold none`, because their fakes (and the real-server tests' expected barrier and apply counts) predate holds; the follower case at `consensus_integration_test.go:282` fails at `GetConsensusParams` before any hold and stays unchanged. The hold tests override with a later `--hold` (the flag package keeps the last value).
- **Leader-local, no fsm change.** Hold state lives in `server` beside the feature book; `server` does not import `orchestrator`, which reaches the gate through `IssuanceGate`, wired in `cmd/arbiter/services.go` next to `Verifiers: srv.VerifierDirectory()`. Of `integration/`, this task edits only the two hand-built `config.Config` literals (`integration/cluster_test.go:140`, `integration/chpipeline/cluster_test.go:158`), which `Validate` now needs to carry both caps (Step 9). It does not touch `integration/cluster_node_test.go`: that harness and `integration/chpipeline` keep building their `server.Config` without the caps (zero means the defaults) and their `orchestrator.Deps` without `Issuance` (nil never holds). Task 11 Step 4 is the one place that forwards `ConsensusMaxIssuanceHold`/`ConsensusMaxDrainMode` from the node's config and wires `Issuance: srv.ConsensusHolds()` in `cluster_node_test.go`, where it proves the holds end to end; do not add either here.
- **Shared hunks with Task 9.** Task 9 edits `metrics/metrics.go` `New` and `cmd/arbiter/app.go` `run` after this task. This task's hunks are anchored on the base: in `New` the hold collectors, the two zeroed `arbiter_consensus_hold_active` series and a second `m.registry.MustRegister(m.holdActive, m.holdsEnded, m.heldPromotions)` go after the existing `MustRegister` call (`:86`), so Task 9 can replace that first call alone; in `app.go` only `var holdMetrics`, the six-way assignment and the `holdMetrics:` field of the `serviceRuntime` literal change, inside the block Task 9 later rewrites when it moves `metrics.New` before `openRaftRuntime` (Task 9 Step 12 carries these lines over unchanged).

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"maps"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

const (
	issuanceMode = pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_ISSUANCE
	drainMode    = pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_DRAIN
)

// manualClock is a hold's injected clock.
type manualClock struct {
	mu  sync.Mutex
	now time.Time
}

func (c *manualClock) Now() time.Time {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return c.now
}

func (c *manualClock) Advance(d time.Duration) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.now = c.now.Add(d)
}

// manualHoldTimer and manualHoldTimers record the expiry timers a hold
// schedules; fireLast runs the newest one unless it was stopped.
type manualHoldTimer struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	stopped bool
}

func (m *manualHoldTimer) Stop() bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	was := !m.stopped
	m.stopped = true
	return was
}

type manualHoldTimers struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	durations []time.Duration
	fns       []func()
	timers    []*manualHoldTimer
}

func (m *manualHoldTimers) after(d time.Duration, f func()) holdTimer {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	timer := &manualHoldTimer{}
	m.durations, m.fns, m.timers = append(m.durations, d), append(m.fns, f), append(m.timers, timer)
	return timer
}

func (m *manualHoldTimers) fireLast(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	m.mu.Lock()
	if len(m.fns) == 0 {
		m.mu.Unlock()
		t.Fatal("no hold timer was scheduled")
	}
	f, timer := m.fns[len(m.fns)-1], m.timers[len(m.timers)-1]
	m.mu.Unlock()
	timer.mu.Lock()
	stopped := timer.stopped
	timer.mu.Unlock()
	if !stopped {
		f()
	}
}

// recordingHoldMetrics is a ConsensusHoldMetrics that keeps what it is told.
type recordingHoldMetrics struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	active map[string]bool
	ended  []string
	held   int
}

func (m *recordingHoldMetrics) ConsensusHoldActive(mode string, active bool) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if m.active == nil {
		m.active = map[string]bool{}
	}
	m.active[mode] = active
}

func (m *recordingHoldMetrics) ConsensusHoldEnded(mode, outcome string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.ended = append(m.ended, mode+"/"+outcome)
}

func (m *recordingHoldMetrics) PromotionIssuanceHeld() {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.held++
}

func (m *recordingHoldMetrics) snapshot() (map[string]bool, []string, int) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return maps.Clone(m.active), slices.Clone(m.ended), m.held
}

// holdFixture is a leader over a published genesis whose node reports Raft
// term 1 (voterNode), with consensus updates enabled, a counted barrier, an
// injected clock and expiry timers, and recording hold metrics.
type holdFixture struct {
	s        *Server
	svc      *consensusAdminService
	node     voterNode
	barriers *atomic.Int32
	clock    *manualClock
	timers   *manualHoldTimers
	metrics  *recordingHoldMetrics
}

func newHoldFixture(t *testing.T, edit func(*Config)) holdFixture {
	t.Helper()
	vn := newVoterNode(t, "arb-0")
	barriers := new(atomic.Int32)
	vn.fakeNode.barrier = func(time.Duration) error { barriers.Add(1); return nil }
	cfg := Config{NodeID: "arb-0", ApplyTimeout: time.Second, MaxStatementAge: time.Hour, ConsensusUpdatesEnabled: true, ConsensusAdminMaxTokenAge: 5 * time.Minute}
	if edit != nil {
		edit(&cfg)
	}
	metrics := &recordingHoldMetrics{}
	s := New(Deps{Node: vn, FSM: vn.f, LeaderAddr: func() string { return "leader-addr:7001" }, Cfg: cfg, HoldMetrics: metrics})
	clock := &manualClock{now: time.Unix(1_800_000_000, 0)}
	timers := &manualHoldTimers{}
	s.holds.now, s.holds.afterFunc = clock.Now, timers.after
	return holdFixture{s: s, svc: &consensusAdminService{s: s}, node: vn, barriers: barriers, clock: clock, timers: timers, metrics: metrics}
}

// draft is the next update with max_writers set, signed now by the network
// authority (serverUpdateRequest).
func (fx holdFixture) draft(t *testing.T, maxWriters uint64) *pb.UpdateConsensusParamsCmd {
	t.Helper()
	return serverUpdateRequest(t, fx.node.fakeNode, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.MaxWriters = maxWriters })
}

func (fx holdFixture) prepare(ctx context.Context, mode pb.ConsensusHoldMode, draft *pb.UpdateConsensusParamsCmd, timeoutMs uint64) (*pb.ConsensusHold, error) {
	return fx.svc.PrepareConsensusUpdate(ctx, &pb.PrepareConsensusUpdateRequest{Mode: mode, Draft: draft, TimeoutMs: timeoutMs})
}

// begin asks the gate about work and releases the issuance lease at once, so
// a later hold can take it.
func (fx holdFixture) begin(work fsm.PromotionWork) (bool, string) {
	release, held, reason := fx.s.holds.BeginPromotionIssuance(work)
	release()
	return held, reason
}

func heldContext(ctx context.Context, id string) context.Context {
	return metadata.NewIncomingContext(ctx, metadata.Pairs(ConsensusHoldMetadataKey, id))
}

func holdWork(block uint64, track *fsm.L3BlockTrack, partition string) fsm.PromotionWork {
	return fsm.PromotionWork{Partition: arbiter.TablePartition{TableID: "db.t", PartitionID: partition}, BlockSeq: block, Track: track}
}

func TestPrepareConsensusUpdateRefusesWhenUpdatesAreDisabled(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, func(c *Config) { c.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled = false })
	applied := fx.node.appliedCount()
	_, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0)
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage {
		t.Fatalf("PrepareConsensusUpdate = %v, want the disabled refusal", err)
	}
	if fx.barriers.Load() != 0 || fx.node.appliedCount() != applied || fx.s.holds.busy() {
		t.Fatal("a refused hold reached Raft or installed a hold")
	}
}

// TestPrepareConsensusUpdateRefusesItsShapeBeforeRaft: contract §4.
func TestPrepareConsensusUpdateRefusesItsShapeBeforeRaft(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	var verifies atomic.Int32
	fx.node.fakeNode.verify = func() error { verifies.Add(1); return nil }
	draft := fx.draft(t, 2)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name string
		req  *pb.PrepareConsensusUpdateRequest
		want string
	}{
		{"no mode", &pb.PrepareConsensusUpdateRequest{Draft: draft}, "consensus hold mode is required"},
		{"unknown mode", &pb.PrepareConsensusUpdateRequest{Mode: pb.ConsensusHoldMode(7), Draft: draft}, "consensus hold mode is required"},
		{"no draft", &pb.PrepareConsensusUpdateRequest{Mode: drainMode}, "consensus hold draft is required"},
		{"a draft without its update", &pb.PrepareConsensusUpdateRequest{Mode: issuanceMode, Draft: &pb.UpdateConsensusParamsCmd{AuthorityJws: draft.GetAuthorityJws()}},
			"consensus hold draft is required"},
	} {
		_, err := fx.svc.PrepareConsensusUpdate(t.Context(), tc.req)
		if status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument || status.Convert(err).Message() != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v, want InvalidArgument %q", tc.name, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	if verifies.Load() != 0 || fx.barriers.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("shape refusals made %d leader checks and %d barriers", verifies.Load(), fx.barriers.Load())
	}
}

// TestPrepareConsensusUpdateRefusesAnUnauthorizedDraftBeforeRaft: the draft
// is checked exactly like UpdateConsensusParams (clarification K5), with no
// log write: a signer outside the authority set and a stale epoch.
func TestPrepareConsensusUpdateRefusesAnUnauthorizedDraftBeforeRaft(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	applied := fx.node.appliedCount()
	draft := fx.draft(t, 2)
	stranger := authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.StrangerKeyHex)
	token, err := stranger.SignConsensusParamsUpdate(wire.ConsensusParamsUpdateFromPB(draft.GetUpdate()))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	forged := &pb.UpdateConsensusParamsCmd{Update: draft.GetUpdate(), AuthorityJws: token}
	if _, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, forged, 0); status.Code(err) != codes.PermissionDenied || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "consensus parameter update authority") {
		t.Fatalf("a stranger's draft = %v, want PermissionDenied", err)
	}
	stale := serverUpdateRequest(t, fx.node.fakeNode, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.MaxWriters = 2; u.ExpectedEpoch = 3 })
	if _, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, stale, 0); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "does not match the current epoch") {
		t.Fatalf("a stale draft = %v, want the epoch precondition", err)
	}
	if fx.barriers.Load() != 0 || fx.node.appliedCount() != applied || fx.s.holds.busy() {
		t.Fatal("an unauthorized draft reached Raft or installed a hold")
	}
	if _, ended, _ := fx.metrics.snapshot(); len(ended) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("hold outcomes = %v, want none", ended)
	}
}

// TestIssuanceHoldFreezesThePromotionSeqTheDraftIsSignedWith: spec §10.1. The
// hold reports the draft's sequence, refuses every issuance, and the commit
// of its draft under the metadata ends it.
func TestIssuanceHoldFreezesThePromotionSeqTheDraftIsSignedWith(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	draft := fx.draft(t, 2)
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, draft, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(hold.GetHoldId()) != 32 || hold.GetMode() != issuanceMode || hold.GetRaftTerm() != 1 || hold.GetPromotionSeq() != draft.GetUpdate().GetExpectedPromotionSeq() ||
		!hold.GetReady() || hold.GetDrainRefusal() != "" || hold.GetExpiresUnixMs() != uint64(fx.clock.Now().Add(2*time.Minute).UnixMilli()) || fx.barriers.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("issuance hold = %v (barriers %d)", hold, fx.barriers.Load())
	}
	for _, work := range []fsm.PromotionWork{holdWork(1, nil, "p0"), holdWork(1, &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1}, "p1")} {
		if held, reason := fx.begin(work); !held || reason == "" {
			t.Fatalf("an issuance hold admitted %+v", work)
		}
	}
	if _, err := fx.svc.UpdateConsensusParams(heldContext(t.Context(), hold.GetHoldId()), draft); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	view, err := fx.node.f.ConsensusParamsView()
	if err != nil || view.Epoch != 1 || view.Current.MaxWriters != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("committed view = %+v, %v", view, err)
	}
	if _, err := fx.svc.GetConsensusHold(t.Context(), &pb.ConsensusHoldRef{HoldId: hold.GetHoldId()}); status.Code(err) != codes.NotFound {
		t.Fatalf("the hold survived its commit: %v", err)
	}
	if held, _ := fx.begin(holdWork(1, nil, "p0")); held {
		t.Fatal("issuance is still held after the commit")
	}
	active, ended, held := fx.metrics.snapshot()
	if active["issuance"] || !slices.Equal(ended, []string{"issuance/committed"}) || held != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("metrics active %v, ended %v, held %d", active, ended, held)
	}
}

// TestIssuanceHoldWaitsForAnInFlightIssuance: clarification K7. An issuance
// holding the shared lease keeps the hold from reading state until it ends.
func TestIssuanceHoldWaitsForAnInFlightIssuance(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	release, held, _ := fx.s.holds.BeginPromotionIssuance(holdWork(1, nil, "p0"))
	if held {
		t.Fatal("no hold exists yet")
	}
	draft := fx.draft(t, 2)
	type result struct {
		hold *pb.ConsensusHold
		err  error
	}
	done := make(chan result, 1)
	go func() {
		hold, err := fx.prepare(context.Background(), issuanceMode, draft, 0)
		done <- result{hold, err}
	}()
	time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	select {
	case r := <-done:
		t.Fatalf("the hold was taken during an in-flight issuance: %v, %v", r.hold, r.err)
	default:
	}
	if fx.barriers.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("the hold read state before the in-flight issuance ended")
	}
	release()
	select {
	case r := <-done:
		if r.err != nil || !r.hold.GetReady() || fx.barriers.Load() != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("hold after the issuance = %v, %v", r.hold, r.err)
		}
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("the hold never took the lease")
	}
}

// TestIssuanceHoldRefusesWhenPromotionSeqMovedDuringTheLease: an issuance
// that committed while the hold waited for the lease leaves the draft stale;
// a drain hold expects the sequence to move and reports the current one.
func TestIssuanceHoldRefusesWhenPromotionSeqMovedDuringTheLease(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	fx.s.holdView = func() fsm.DrainView {
		v := fx.node.f.DrainView()
		v.PromotionSeq++
		return v
	}
	_, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0)
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != "promotion_seq moved to 1 while the hold was taken; sign the update again" {
		t.Fatalf("PrepareConsensusUpdate = %v, want the moved-sequence refusal", err)
	}
	if fx.s.holds.busy() || fx.barriers.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("a refused issuance hold was installed")
	}
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0)
	if err != nil || hold.GetPromotionSeq() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("drain hold = %v, %v", hold, err)
	}
}

func TestConsensusHoldRefusesASecondHold(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	if _, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	barriers := fx.barriers.Load()
	_, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, fx.draft(t, 3), 0)
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != consensusHoldActiveMessage {
		t.Fatalf("second hold = %v, want %q", err, consensusHoldActiveMessage)
	}
	if fx.barriers.Load() != barriers {
		t.Fatal("a refused second hold cost a barrier")
	}
}

// TestHoldLiftsWhenTheHeldUpdateIsRefused: before Raft (the leader's
// precondition, after another update moved the epoch, and a failed leader
// check: an update never handed to Raft cannot commit) and by Apply (an
// update that changes nothing), the hold ends refused.
func TestHoldLiftsWhenTheHeldUpdateIsRefused(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("before Raft", func(t *testing.T) {
		fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
		draft := fx.draft(t, 2)
		hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, draft, 0)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := fx.svc.UpdateConsensusParams(t.Context(), fx.draft(t, 3)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		applied := fx.node.appliedCount()
		_, err = fx.svc.UpdateConsensusParams(heldContext(t.Context(), hold.GetHoldId()), draft)
		if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "expected_epoch 0 does not match the current epoch 1") || fx.node.appliedCount() != applied {
			t.Fatalf("stale held update = %v", err)
		}
		if _, ok := fx.s.holds.lookup(hold.GetHoldId()); ok {
			t.Fatal("the hold survived its refused update")
		}
		if _, ended, _ := fx.metrics.snapshot(); !slices.Equal(ended, []string{"drain/refused"}) {
			t.Fatalf("outcomes = %v", ended)
		}
	})
	t.Run("unavailable before Raft", func(t *testing.T) {
		fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
		draft := fx.draft(t, 2)
		hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, draft, 0)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		applied := fx.node.appliedCount()
		fx.node.fakeNode.verify = func() error { return errors.New("quorum heartbeat round failed") }
		_, err = fx.svc.UpdateConsensusParams(heldContext(t.Context(), hold.GetHoldId()), draft)
		fx.node.fakeNode.verify = nil
		if status.Code(err) != codes.Unavailable || fx.node.appliedCount() != applied {
			t.Fatalf("held update with a failed leader check = %v", err)
		}
		if _, ok := fx.s.holds.lookup(hold.GetHoldId()); ok {
			t.Fatal("the hold survived an update that never reached Raft")
		}
		if _, ended, _ := fx.metrics.snapshot(); !slices.Equal(ended, []string{"issuance/refused"}) {
			t.Fatalf("outcomes = %v", ended)
		}
	})
	t.Run("by Apply", func(t *testing.T) {
		fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
		unchanged := fx.draft(t, 1) // the committed parameters: Apply refuses an update that changes nothing
		hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, unchanged, 0)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		applied := fx.node.appliedCount()
		_, err = fx.svc.UpdateConsensusParams(heldContext(t.Context(), hold.GetHoldId()), unchanged)
		if status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "does not change") || fx.node.appliedCount() != applied+1 {
			t.Fatalf("unchanged held update = %v", err)
		}
		if _, ok := fx.s.holds.lookup(hold.GetHoldId()); ok {
			t.Fatal("the hold survived the FSM's refusal")
		}
		if _, ended, _ := fx.metrics.snapshot(); !slices.Equal(ended, []string{"issuance/refused"}) {
			t.Fatalf("outcomes = %v", ended)
		}
	})
}

// TestHoldSurvivesAnUnknownUpdateOutcome: a submitted update whose outcome is
// unknown may still commit, so its hold stays until it expires.
func TestHoldSurvivesAnUnknownUpdateOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	draft := fx.draft(t, 2)
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, draft, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fx.node.fakeNode.future = fakeFuture{err: errors.New("raft transport stopped")}
	_, err = fx.svc.UpdateConsensusParams(heldContext(t.Context(), hold.GetHoldId()), draft)
	fx.node.fakeNode.future = nil
	if status.Code(err) != codes.Unavailable {
		t.Fatalf("UpdateConsensusParams = %v, want Unavailable", err)
	}
	if _, ok := fx.s.holds.lookup(hold.GetHoldId()); !ok {
		t.Fatal("an unknown outcome ended the hold")
	}
	if held, _ := fx.begin(holdWork(1, nil, "p0")); !held {
		t.Fatal("the surviving hold stopped holding issuance")
	}
}

func TestUpdateUnderAnUnknownHoldIsRefused(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)

	_, err := fx.svc.UpdateConsensusParams(heldContext(t.Context(), "00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff"), fx.draft(t, 2))
	if status.Code(err) != codes.NotFound || status.Convert(err).Message() != unknownConsensusHoldMessage || fx.node.appliedCount() != applied {
		t.Fatalf("update under an unknown hold = %v", err)

}

// TestHoldExpiresAfterItsTimeout: the defaults (2m issuance, 10m drain),
// expiry on access, and the timer that expires a hold nobody touches.
func TestHoldExpiresAfterItsTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if hold.GetExpiresUnixMs() != uint64(fx.clock.Now().Add(10*time.Minute).UnixMilli()) {
		t.Fatalf("drain hold expires at %d", hold.GetExpiresUnixMs())
	}
	fx.clock.Advance(10 * time.Minute)
	if held, _ := fx.begin(holdWork(5, nil, "p0")); held {
		t.Fatal("an expired hold still held")
	}
	if _, err := fx.svc.GetConsensusHold(t.Context(), &pb.ConsensusHoldRef{HoldId: hold.GetHoldId()}); status.Code(err) != codes.NotFound {
		t.Fatalf("expired hold = %v", err)
	}
	second, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fx.timers.fireLast(t)
	if _, ok := fx.s.holds.lookup(second.GetHoldId()); ok {
		t.Fatal("the expiry timer left the hold active")
	}
	active, ended, _ := fx.metrics.snapshot()
	if active["issuance"] || active["drain"] || !slices.Equal(ended, []string{"drain/expired", "issuance/expired"}) {
		t.Fatalf("metrics active %v, ended %v", active, ended)
	}
	if !slices.Equal(fx.timers.durations, []time.Duration{10 * time.Minute, 2 * time.Minute}) {
		t.Fatalf("timers = %v", fx.timers.durations)
	}
}

func TestHoldTimeoutIsCappedByTheConfiguredMaximum(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, func(c *Config) {
		c.ConsensusMaxIssuanceHold = 30 * time.Second
		c.ConsensusMaxDrainMode = 5 * time.Minute
	})
	start := fx.clock.Now()
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		mode        pb.ConsensusHoldMode
		requestedMs uint64
		want        time.Duration
	}{
		{issuanceMode, 600_000, 30 * time.Second},
		{issuanceMode, 0, 30 * time.Second},
		{issuanceMode, 1_500, 1500 * time.Millisecond},
		{drainMode, 3_600_000, 5 * time.Minute},
		{drainMode, 60_000, time.Minute},
	} {
		hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), tc.mode, fx.draft(t, 2), tc.requestedMs)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if got := hold.GetExpiresUnixMs(); got != uint64(start.Add(tc.want).UnixMilli()) {
			t.Fatalf("%v for %d ms expires at %d, want %v later", tc.mode, tc.requestedMs, got, tc.want)
		}
		if _, err := fx.svc.ReleaseConsensusHold(t.Context(), &pb.ConsensusHoldRef{HoldId: hold.GetHoldId()}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

// TestDrainModeRecordsEachTrackFrontier: spec §10.2 over the real FSM. After
// the tracks activation indexer 2 holds one unpassed transition block, its
// frontier and in flight; indexer 1 has no block, so its frontier is its
// prefix. A hold taken after the activation reports its tracks and nothing
// global (consensus.proto: the global_* fields and in_flight_blocks are a
// pre-activation drain hold's). The hold admits every promotion of indexer
// 2's frontier block and nothing later, nothing of a track whose frontier it
// passed, nothing without a track and nothing of an unrecorded track.
func TestDrainModeRecordsEachTrackFrontier(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	activateServerTracks(t, fx.node.fakeNode)
	addServerTableOfIndexer2(t, fx.node.fakeNode)
	tip := fx.node.f.SealedBlockSeqView()
	view := fx.node.f.DrainView()
	draft := serverUpdateRequest(t, fx.node.fakeNode, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.MaxWriters = 3 })
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, draft, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cut := view.Tracks[0].Prefix
	want := &pb.ConsensusHold{HoldId: hold.GetHoldId(), Mode: drainMode, RaftTerm: 1, PromotionSeq: 0, ExpiresUnixMs: hold.GetExpiresUnixMs(),
		Tracks: []*pb.TrackDrain{
			{IndexerId: 1, PrefixBlockSeq: cut, FrontierBlockSeq: cut},
			{IndexerId: 2, PrefixBlockSeq: cut, FrontierBlockSeq: tip, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{tip}},
		}}
	if !proto.Equal(hold, want) {
		t.Fatalf("drain hold = %v, want %v", hold, want)
	}
	one, two := &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1}, &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 2}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		work fsm.PromotionWork
		held bool
	}{
		{holdWork(tip, two, "p0"), false},
		{holdWork(tip, two, "p1"), false},
		{holdWork(tip+1, two, "p0"), true},
		{holdWork(tip, one, "p0"), true},
		{holdWork(tip, nil, "p0"), true},
		{holdWork(tip, &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 3}, "p0"), true},
	} {
		if held, reason := fx.begin(tc.work); held != tc.held || (held && reason == "") {
			t.Fatalf("%+v: held=%v (%q), want %v", tc.work, held, reason, tc.held)
		}
	}
}

// TestDrainModeAdmitsEveryPromotionAtOrBelowTheFrontier: before the tracks
// activation the recorded frontier is global. Every partition of the frontier
// block and an earlier block's re-issue pass; a later block is held, also
// after the drain is ready.
func TestDrainModeAdmitsEveryPromotionAtOrBelowTheFrontier(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	view := fsm.DrainView{GlobalPrefix: 4, GlobalFrontier: 5, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{5}}
	fx.s.holdView = func() fsm.DrainView { return view }
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0)
	if err != nil || hold.GetReady() || hold.GetGlobalFrontierBlockSeq() != 5 || !slices.Equal(hold.GetInFlightBlocks(), []uint64{5}) {
		t.Fatalf("drain hold = %v, %v", hold, err)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		work fsm.PromotionWork
		held bool
	}{
		{holdWork(5, nil, "p0"), false},
		{holdWork(5, nil, "p1"), false},
		{holdWork(4, nil, "p0"), false},
		{holdWork(6, nil, "p0"), true},
	} {
		if held, _ := fx.begin(tc.work); held != tc.held {
			t.Fatalf("%+v: held=%v, want %v", tc.work, held, tc.held)
		}
	}
	view = fsm.DrainView{GlobalPrefix: 5, GlobalFrontier: 6, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{6}}
	got, err := fx.svc.GetConsensusHold(t.Context(), &pb.ConsensusHoldRef{HoldId: hold.GetHoldId()})
	if err != nil || !got.GetReady() || got.GetGlobalFrontierBlockSeq() != 5 || len(got.GetInFlightBlocks()) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("drained hold = %v, %v", got, err)
	}
	if held, _ := fx.begin(holdWork(6, nil, "p0")); !held {
		t.Fatal("a later block was admitted once the drain was ready")
	}
}

// TestDrainModeReadyOnlyWhenEveryTrackPassedItsFrontier: ready needs the
// drain gate and every recorded frontier; the reported frontier stays the
// recorded one, in-flight blocks past it are not reported, and a hold taken
// after the tracks activation reports no global prefix, frontier or
// in-flight block although the FSM's view has them.
func TestDrainModeReadyOnlyWhenEveryTrackPassedItsFrontier(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	view := fsm.DrainView{PromotionSeq: 7, Refusal: "consensus update requires all promotions to be acknowledged", TracksActive: true,
		GlobalPrefix: 3, GlobalFrontier: 4, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{4, 5},
		Tracks: []fsm.TrackDrainView{{IndexerID: 1, Prefix: 3, Frontier: 5, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{5}}, {IndexerID: 2, Prefix: 7, Frontier: 7}}}
	fx.s.holdView = func() fsm.DrainView { return view }
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0)
	if err != nil || hold.GetReady() || hold.GetDrainRefusal() != view.Refusal || hold.GetPromotionSeq() != 7 || len(hold.GetTracks()) != 2 ||
		hold.GetTracks()[0].GetFrontierBlockSeq() != 5 || !slices.Equal(hold.GetTracks()[0].GetInFlightBlocks(), []uint64{5}) ||
		hold.GetTracks()[1].GetFrontierBlockSeq() != 7 || len(hold.GetInFlightBlocks()) != 0 ||
		hold.GetGlobalPrefixBlockSeq() != 0 || hold.GetGlobalFrontierBlockSeq() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("drain hold = %v, %v", hold, err)
	}
	get := func() *pb.ConsensusHold {
		t.Helper()
		got, err := fx.svc.GetConsensusHold(t.Context(), &pb.ConsensusHoldRef{HoldId: hold.GetHoldId()})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return got
	}
	view.Refusal = "consensus update requires all cleanup commands to be acknowledged"
	view.Tracks[0] = fsm.TrackDrainView{IndexerID: 1, Prefix: 5, Frontier: 9, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{5, 9}}
	if got := get(); got.GetReady() || got.GetTracks()[0].GetFrontierBlockSeq() != 5 || !slices.Equal(got.GetTracks()[0].GetInFlightBlocks(), []uint64{5}) {
		t.Fatalf("hold with a cleanup outstanding = %v", got)
	}
	view.Refusal, view.PromotionSeq = "", 8
	view.Tracks[0].InFlightBlocks = []uint64{9}
	if got := get(); !got.GetReady() || got.GetPromotionSeq() != 8 || len(got.GetTracks()[0].GetInFlightBlocks()) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("drained hold = %v", got)
	}
}

// TestDrainModeSkipsQuarantinedTracks: a track quarantined when the hold is
// taken records no frontier, so its promotions are held, its prefix never
// blocks readiness and it reports frontier 0 with nothing in flight
// (consensus.proto TrackDrain); a track quarantined later stops counting too.
func TestDrainModeSkipsQuarantinedTracks(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	view := fsm.DrainView{TracksActive: true, Tracks: []fsm.TrackDrainView{
		{IndexerID: 1, Prefix: 3, Frontier: 5, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{5}},
		{IndexerID: 2, Quarantined: true, Prefix: 4, Frontier: 6, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{6}},
	}}
	fx.s.holdView = func() fsm.DrainView { return view }
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), drainMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0)
	if err != nil || hold.GetReady() {
		t.Fatalf("drain hold = %v, %v; want not ready while track 1 is below its frontier", hold, err)
	}
	if tr := hold.GetTracks()[1]; !tr.GetQuarantined() || tr.GetPrefixBlockSeq() != 4 || tr.GetFrontierBlockSeq() != 0 || len(tr.GetInFlightBlocks()) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("track quarantined at hold start = %v, want frontier 0 and nothing in flight", tr)
	}
	if held, _ := fx.begin(holdWork(6, &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 2}, "p0")); !held {
		t.Fatal("a promotion of a track without a recorded frontier was admitted")
	}
	if held, _ := fx.begin(holdWork(5, &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1}, "p0")); held {
		t.Fatal("a promotion of track 1's frontier block was held")
	}
	view.Tracks[0].Quarantined = true
	got, err := fx.svc.GetConsensusHold(t.Context(), &pb.ConsensusHoldRef{HoldId: hold.GetHoldId()})
	if err != nil || !got.GetReady() || got.GetTracks()[1].GetFrontierBlockSeq() != 0 || !got.GetTracks()[1].GetQuarantined() ||
		got.GetTracks()[0].GetFrontierBlockSeq() != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("hold with both tracks quarantined = %v, %v", got, err)
	}
}

// TestIssuanceHoldReportsNoDrainState: clarification K10 and consensus.proto.
// An issuance hold records no frontier, so it reports the drain gate's
// refusal and readiness and leaves the global_* fields, in_flight_blocks and
// tracks empty, however much drain state the FSM has; it is ready only once
// the drain gate passes, and promotion_seq stays the draft's throughout.
func TestIssuanceHoldReportsNoDrainState(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	view := fsm.DrainView{Refusal: "consensus update requires all cleanup commands to be acknowledged", TracksActive: true,
		GlobalPrefix: 3, GlobalFrontier: 4, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{4},
		Tracks: []fsm.TrackDrainView{{IndexerID: 1, Prefix: 3, Frontier: 4, InFlightBlocks: []uint64{4}}}}
	fx.s.holdView = func() fsm.DrainView { return view }
	draft := fx.draft(t, 2)
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, draft, 0)
	if err != nil || hold.GetReady() || hold.GetDrainRefusal() != view.Refusal || hold.GetPromotionSeq() != draft.GetUpdate().GetExpectedPromotionSeq() ||
		hold.GetGlobalPrefixBlockSeq() != 0 || hold.GetGlobalFrontierBlockSeq() != 0 || len(hold.GetInFlightBlocks()) != 0 || len(hold.GetTracks()) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("issuance hold with a cleanup outstanding = %v, %v; want not ready, the refusal and no drain state", hold, err)
	}
	view.Refusal = ""
	got, err := fx.svc.GetConsensusHold(t.Context(), &pb.ConsensusHoldRef{HoldId: hold.GetHoldId()})
	if err != nil || !got.GetReady() || got.GetDrainRefusal() != "" || got.GetPromotionSeq() != draft.GetUpdate().GetExpectedPromotionSeq() || len(got.GetTracks()) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("issuance hold once the drain gate passes = %v, %v", got, err)
	}
}

func TestGetConsensusHoldNeedsTheHoldID(t *testing.T) {
	fx := newHoldFixture(t, nil)
	hold, err := fx.prepare(t.Context(), issuanceMode, fx.draft(t, 2), 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	barriers := fx.barriers.Load()
	for _, id := range []string{"", hold.GetHoldId()[:31], "ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff"} {
		if _, err := fx.svc.GetConsensusHold(t.Context(), &pb.ConsensusHoldRef{HoldId: id}); status.Code(err) != codes.NotFound ||
			status.Convert(err).Message() != unknownConsensusHoldMessage {
			t.Fatalf("GetConsensusHold(%q) = %v, want NotFound", id, err)
		}
	}
	if fx.barriers.Load() != barriers+2 {
		t.Fatalf("barriers = %d, want an empty id refused before the barrier and one barrier per other read", fx.barriers.Load()-barriers)
	}
	got, err := fx.svc.GetConsensusHold(t.Context(), &pb.ConsensusHoldRef{HoldId: hold.GetHoldId()})
	if err != nil || !proto.Equal(got, hold) {
		t.Fatalf("GetConsensusHold = %v, %v; want %v", got, err, hold)
	}
}
```

Create `server/consensus_hold.go`:

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"maps"
	"sync"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// ConsensusHoldMetadataKey is the gRPC metadata key under which an
// UpdateConsensusParams call names the consensus hold it is submitted under
// (plan S3-A clarification K5). The hold id never enters the command:
// UpdateConsensusParamsCmd is also the Raft command, and arbiter-core's strict
// decoder would refuse an unknown field on every older voter.
const ConsensusHoldMetadataKey = "arbiter-consensus-hold"

// The caps a hold gets when Config leaves them zero; consensus_admin.
// max_issuance_hold and max_drain_mode default to the same values.
const (
	defaultConsensusMaxIssuanceHold = 2 * time.Minute
	defaultConsensusMaxDrainMode    = 10 * time.Minute
)

// Hold refusals (plan S3-A contract §4, verbatim).
const (
	consensusHoldModeRequiredMessage  = "consensus hold mode is required"
	consensusHoldDraftRequiredMessage = "consensus hold draft is required"
	consensusHoldActiveMessage        = "a consensus hold is already active on this leader"
	unknownConsensusHoldMessage       = "unknown consensus hold"
)

// How a hold ends: the outcome label of arbiter_consensus_holds_total.
const (
	consensusHoldCommitted      = "committed"
	consensusHoldRefused        = "refused"
	consensusHoldReleased       = "released"
	consensusHoldExpired        = "expired"
	consensusHoldLeadershipLost = "leadership_lost"
)

// ConsensusHoldMetrics records consensus holds: ConsensusHoldActive when a
// hold of mode (issuance, drain) starts and ends, ConsensusHoldEnded with
// its outcome, and PromotionIssuanceHeld for every issuance a hold refuses.
// Process-local, never replicated; nil disables it.
type ConsensusHoldMetrics interface {
	ConsensusHoldActive(mode string, active bool)
	ConsensusHoldEnded(mode, outcome string)
	PromotionIssuanceHeld()
}

// holdTimer is the part of *time.Timer a hold keeps: its expiry.
type holdTimer interface {
	Stop() bool
}

// ConsensusHolds is this leader's consensus hold (housegate spec 2026-10-14
// §10.1-§10.2, plan S3-A clarifications K5-K7): at most one, leader-local,
// never replicated. An issuance hold refuses every new promotion; a drain
// hold refuses a promotion of a block beyond its track's frontier as
// recorded when the hold was taken. Acknowledgements, publications,
// cleanups and resends never consult it. A hold ends on its update's commit
// or refusal, on release, at its deadline, and on leadership loss; one whose
// Raft term is not the current term is void.
type ConsensusHolds struct {
	// lease is the issuance lease (clarification K7): BeginPromotionIssuance
	// takes it shared from before the orchestrator reads PromotionSeq until
	// its proposal returned, and PrepareConsensusUpdate takes it exclusively
	// before it reads the sequence a hold freezes or starts from.
	lease sync.RWMutex

	mu     sync.Mutex
	active *consensusHold

	term      func() uint64
	now       func() time.Time
	afterFunc func(time.Duration, func()) holdTimer
	newID     func() (string, error)
	metrics   ConsensusHoldMetrics
}

// consensusHold is one granted hold. A drain hold taken after the tracks
// activation records each non-quarantined track's promotion frontier; one
// taken before it, the global frontier.
type consensusHold struct {
	id             string
	mode           pb.ConsensusHoldMode
	term           uint64
	promotionSeq   uint64
	deadline       time.Time
	tracks         bool
	globalFrontier uint64
	frontiers      map[uint64]uint64
	timer          holdTimer
}

func newConsensusHolds(term func() uint64, metrics ConsensusHoldMetrics) *ConsensusHolds {
	return &ConsensusHolds{
		term:      term,
		now:       time.Now,
		afterFunc: func(d time.Duration, f func()) holdTimer { return time.AfterFunc(d, f) },
		newID:     newConsensusHoldID,
		metrics:   metrics,
	}
}

// newConsensusHoldID is a random 128-bit bearer capability in hex.
func newConsensusHoldID() (string, error) {
	var b [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(b[:]); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(b[:]), nil
}

func consensusHoldModeLabel(mode pb.ConsensusHoldMode) string {
	if mode == pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_ISSUANCE {
		return "issuance"
	}
	return "drain"
}

// BeginPromotionIssuance is the orchestrator's issuance gate
// (orchestrator.IssuanceGate). It takes the shared issuance lease and
// reports whether the live hold refuses work. held means nothing may be
// signed or proposed for work now; otherwise release ends the lease and
// must be called once the RecordPromotionIssued proposal has returned.
func (h *ConsensusHolds) BeginPromotionIssuance(work fsm.PromotionWork) (release func(), held bool, reason string) {
	h.lease.RLock()
	h.mu.Lock()
	if hold := h.liveLocked(); hold != nil {
		reason = hold.refusal(work)
	}
	h.mu.Unlock()
	if reason != "" {
		h.lease.RUnlock()
		if h.metrics != nil {
			h.metrics.PromotionIssuanceHeld()
		}
		return func() {}, true, reason
	}
	var once sync.Once
	return func() { once.Do(h.lease.RUnlock) }, false, ""
}

// refusal is why the hold refuses work, "" when it admits it.
func (hold *consensusHold) refusal(work fsm.PromotionWork) string {
	if hold.mode == pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_ISSUANCE {
		return "an issuance hold refuses every new promotion until its consensus update settles"
	}
	if !hold.tracks {
		if work.BlockSeq > hold.globalFrontier {
			return fmt.Sprintf("drain mode refuses promotions of block %d beyond the recorded frontier block %d", work.BlockSeq, hold.globalFrontier)
		}
		return ""
	}
	if work.Track == nil {
		return fmt.Sprintf("drain mode refuses a promotion of block %d without a track", work.BlockSeq)
	}
	frontier, recorded := hold.frontiers[work.Track.IndexerID]
	switch {
	case !recorded:
		return fmt.Sprintf("drain mode refuses promotions of indexer %d, which had no recorded frontier when the hold was taken", work.Track.IndexerID)
	case work.BlockSeq > frontier:
		return fmt.Sprintf("drain mode refuses promotions of block %d beyond indexer %d's recorded frontier block %d", work.BlockSeq, work.Track.IndexerID, frontier)
	}
	return ""
}

// lockExclusive takes the issuance lease exclusively, waiting for every
// issuance in flight. The wait runs on a helper goroutine so ctx still
// cancels it; a lock acquired after ctx ended is released at once.
func (h *ConsensusHolds) lockExclusive(ctx context.Context) error {
	acquired := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		h.lease.Lock()
		close(acquired)
	}()
	select {
	case <-acquired:
		return nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		go func() {
			<-acquired
			h.lease.Unlock()
		}()
		return status.FromContextError(ctx.Err()).Err()
	}
}

func (h *ConsensusHolds) unlockExclusive() { h.lease.Unlock() }

// start installs a hold of mode in term for timeout, taken over view. The
// caller holds the lease exclusively and read view after a barrier.
func (h *ConsensusHolds) start(mode pb.ConsensusHoldMode, term uint64, timeout time.Duration, view fsm.DrainView) (consensusHold, error) {
	id, err := h.newID()
	if err != nil {
		return consensusHold{}, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "consensus hold id: %v", err)
	}
	hold := &consensusHold{id: id, mode: mode, term: term, promotionSeq: view.PromotionSeq, deadline: h.now().Add(timeout), tracks: view.TracksActive}
	if mode == pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_DRAIN {
		if view.TracksActive {
			hold.frontiers = make(map[uint64]uint64, len(view.Tracks))
			for _, tr := range view.Tracks {
				if !tr.Quarantined {
					hold.frontiers[tr.IndexerID] = tr.Frontier
				}
			}
		} else {
			hold.globalFrontier = view.GlobalFrontier
		}
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.liveLocked() != nil {
		return consensusHold{}, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusHoldActiveMessage)
	}
	h.active = hold
	hold.timer = h.afterFunc(timeout, func() { h.expire(id) })
	if h.metrics != nil {
		h.metrics.ConsensusHoldActive(consensusHoldModeLabel(mode), true)
	}
	return hold.snapshot(), nil
}

// lookup is the live hold id names, detached.
func (h *ConsensusHolds) lookup(id string) (consensusHold, bool) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	hold := h.liveLocked()
	if hold == nil || !sameConsensusHoldID(hold.id, id) {
		return consensusHold{}, false
	}
	return hold.snapshot(), true
}

// busy reports a live hold.
func (h *ConsensusHolds) busy() bool {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return h.liveLocked() != nil
}

// settle ends the live hold id names with outcome; any other id is a no-op.
func (h *ConsensusHolds) settle(id, outcome string) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if hold := h.liveLocked(); hold != nil && sameConsensusHoldID(hold.id, id) {
		h.endLocked(outcome)
	}
}

// clear ends any hold with outcome (OnLeadershipLost).
func (h *ConsensusHolds) clear(outcome string) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	h.endLocked(outcome)
}

// expire is a hold's timer: it ends the hold id names if it is still active.
func (h *ConsensusHolds) expire(id string) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.active != nil && h.active.id == id {
		h.endLocked(consensusHoldExpired)
	}
}

// liveLocked is the active hold, ending it first when its term is not the
// current one or its deadline has passed.
func (h *ConsensusHolds) liveLocked() *consensusHold {
	hold := h.active
	switch {
	case hold == nil:
		return nil
	case hold.term != h.currentTerm():
		h.endLocked(consensusHoldLeadershipLost)
		return nil
	case !h.now().Before(hold.deadline):
		h.endLocked(consensusHoldExpired)
		return nil
	}
	return hold
}

func (h *ConsensusHolds) endLocked(outcome string) {
	hold := h.active
	if hold == nil {
		return
	}
	h.active = nil
	if hold.timer != nil {
		hold.timer.Stop()
	}
	if h.metrics != nil {
		mode := consensusHoldModeLabel(hold.mode)
		h.metrics.ConsensusHoldActive(mode, false)
		h.metrics.ConsensusHoldEnded(mode, outcome)
	}
}

func (h *ConsensusHolds) currentTerm() uint64 {
	if h.term == nil {
		return 0
	}
	return h.term()
}

// snapshot is a detached copy without the timer.
func (hold *consensusHold) snapshot() consensusHold {
	c := *hold
	c.frontiers = maps.Clone(hold.frontiers)
	c.timer = nil
	return c
}

// sameConsensusHoldID compares a bearer hold id in constant time.
func sameConsensusHoldID(a, b string) bool {
	return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(a), []byte(b)) == 1
}
```

Create `server/consensus_hold_rpc.go`:

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// PrepareConsensusUpdate takes a consensus hold on this leader (housegate
// spec 2026-10-14 §10.1-§10.2, plan S3-A contract §4). The draft authorizes
// it exactly as UpdateConsensusParams authorizes an update and is never
// proposed (clarification K5); in issuance mode it is the update the caller
// submits under the hold. Every refusal comes before anything reaches the
// log; the hold then waits for in-flight issuances (the exclusive lease,
// clarification K7) and crosses one read barrier before it reads the drain
// state it records.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) PrepareConsensusUpdate(ctx context.Context, req *pb.PrepareConsensusUpdateRequest) (*pb.ConsensusHold, error) {
	s := svc.s
	if !s.d.Cfg.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage)
	}
	mode := req.GetMode()
	if mode != pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_ISSUANCE && mode != pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_DRAIN {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, consensusHoldModeRequiredMessage)
	}
	if req.GetDraft().GetUpdate() == nil {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, consensusHoldDraftRequiredMessage)
	}
	draft := wire.ConsensusParamsUpdateFromPB(req.GetDraft().GetUpdate())
	if err := s.authorizeConsensusParamsUpdate(ctx, draft, req.GetDraft().GetAuthorityJws()); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// Refused before the lease, so a second hold never waits for issuances.
	if s.holds.busy() {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusHoldActiveMessage)
	}
	if err := s.holds.lockExclusive(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer s.holds.unlockExclusive()
	if err := s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	view := s.drainView()
	if mode == pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_ISSUANCE && view.PromotionSeq != draft.ExpectedPromotionSeq {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "promotion_seq moved to %d while the hold was taken; sign the update again", view.PromotionSeq)
	}
	hold, err := s.holds.start(mode, s.raftTerm(), s.consensusHoldTimeout(mode, req.GetTimeoutMs()), view)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return consensusHoldToPB(hold, view), nil
}

// GetConsensusHold reports the live hold the id names, read after a leader
// barrier; any other id is NotFound, an empty one before the barrier.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) GetConsensusHold(ctx context.Context, ref *pb.ConsensusHoldRef) (*pb.ConsensusHold, error) {
	if ref.GetHoldId() == "" {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.NotFound, unknownConsensusHoldMessage)
	}
	if err := svc.s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	hold, ok := svc.s.holds.lookup(ref.GetHoldId())
	if !ok {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.NotFound, unknownConsensusHoldMessage)
	}
	return consensusHoldToPB(hold, svc.s.drainView()), nil
}

// ReleaseConsensusHold ends the hold the id names. It is idempotent: an id
// that names no live hold is acknowledged too.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) ReleaseConsensusHold(ctx context.Context, ref *pb.ConsensusHoldRef) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	if err := svc.s.consensusLeaderCheck(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	svc.s.holds.settle(ref.GetHoldId(), consensusHoldReleased)
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

// ConsensusHolds is this leader's consensus hold, the orchestrator's
// issuance gate (cmd/arbiter wires it).
func (s *Server) ConsensusHolds() *ConsensusHolds { return s.holds }

// consensusHoldTimeout is a hold's lifetime: the request's, capped by the
// mode's configured maximum, which a zero request gets.
func (s *Server) consensusHoldTimeout(mode pb.ConsensusHoldMode, requestedMs uint64) time.Duration {
	limit, fallback := s.d.Cfg.ConsensusMaxDrainMode, defaultConsensusMaxDrainMode
	if mode == pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_ISSUANCE {
		limit, fallback = s.d.Cfg.ConsensusMaxIssuanceHold, defaultConsensusMaxIssuanceHold
	}
	if limit <= 0 {
		limit = fallback
	}
	if requestedMs == 0 || requestedMs >= uint64(limit/time.Millisecond) {
		return limit
	}
	return time.Duration(requestedMs) * time.Millisecond
}

func (s *Server) drainView() fsm.DrainView {
	if s.holdView != nil {
		return s.holdView()
	}
	return s.d.FSM.DrainView()
}

// consensusHoldToPB reports hold over the current drain state, as the
// ConsensusHold and TrackDrain comments of consensus.proto (Task 3) define
// it. An issuance hold records no frontier: it reports the sequence it froze,
// the drain gate's refusal and readiness only (the global_* fields,
// in_flight_blocks and tracks stay empty), and is ready once the drain gate
// passes (clarification K10). A drain hold reports the current sequence and
// its recorded frontiers with only the in-flight blocks at or below them:
// before the tracks activation in the global_* fields and in_flight_blocks,
// after it as one TrackDrain per enrolled indexer and nothing global (a
// track without a recorded frontier, quarantined when the hold was taken,
// reports frontier 0 and no in-flight block). It is ready once the drain
// gate passes and every recorded, non-quarantined track reached its frontier
// (before the tracks activation: the global prefix the global frontier).
func consensusHoldToPB(hold consensusHold, view fsm.DrainView) *pb.ConsensusHold {
	out := &pb.ConsensusHold{
		HoldId: hold.id, Mode: hold.mode, RaftTerm: hold.term, ExpiresUnixMs: uint64(hold.deadline.UnixMilli()),
		DrainRefusal: view.Refusal,
	}
	ready := view.Refusal == ""
	if hold.mode == pb.ConsensusHoldMode_CONSENSUS_HOLD_MODE_ISSUANCE {
		out.PromotionSeq = hold.promotionSeq
		out.Ready = ready
		return out
	}
	out.PromotionSeq = view.PromotionSeq
	if !hold.tracks {
		out.GlobalPrefixBlockSeq, out.GlobalFrontierBlockSeq = view.GlobalPrefix, hold.globalFrontier
		out.InFlightBlocks = blocksThrough(view.InFlightBlocks, hold.globalFrontier)
		out.Ready = ready && view.GlobalPrefix >= hold.globalFrontier
		return out
	}
	for _, tr := range view.Tracks {
		frontier, recorded := hold.frontiers[tr.IndexerID]
		out.Tracks = append(out.Tracks, &pb.TrackDrain{IndexerId: tr.IndexerID, Quarantined: tr.Quarantined, PrefixBlockSeq: tr.Prefix,
			FrontierBlockSeq: frontier, InFlightBlocks: blocksThrough(tr.InFlightBlocks, frontier)})
		if recorded && !tr.Quarantined && tr.Prefix < frontier {
			ready = false
		}
	}
	out.Ready = ready
	return out
}

// blocksThrough keeps the blocks at or below frontier; nil when none is.
func blocksThrough(blocks []uint64, frontier uint64) []uint64 {
	var out []uint64
	for _, block := range blocks {
		if block <= frontier {
			out = append(out, block)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// consensusHoldIDFromContext reads ConsensusHoldMetadataKey. held is true
// whenever the key is present; several values name no one hold and are
// returned as "", which no hold matches.
func consensusHoldIDFromContext(ctx context.Context) (id string, held bool) {
	md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx)
	if !ok {
		return "", false
	}
	values := md.Get(ConsensusHoldMetadataKey)
	switch len(values) {
	case 0:
		return "", false
	case 1:
		return strings.TrimSpace(values[0]), true
	}
	return "", true
}

// heldUpdateOutcome is the definite outcome of a held update, if it has one:
// committed; refused when nothing reached the log (shape, authorization,
// preconditions, gates, a failed leader check or barrier, a context that
// ended first: an update never handed to Raft cannot commit); or refused by
// Apply (fsm.Rejected is the only InvalidArgument after submission). An
// unknown outcome after submission may still commit, and a NotLeader answer
// is settled by OnLeadershipLost, so neither settles.
func heldUpdateOutcome(p proposal, err error) (string, bool) {
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		return consensusHoldCommitted, true
	case carriesNotLeader(err):
		return "", false
	case !p.submitted:
		return consensusHoldRefused, true
	case status.Code(err) == codes.InvalidArgument:
		return consensusHoldRefused, true
	}
	return "", false
}

// carriesNotLeader reports a notLeaderErr answer.
func carriesNotLeader(err error) bool {
	for _, detail := range status.Convert(err).Details() {
		if _, ok := detail.(*pb.NotLeader); ok {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
```

```go
// UpdateConsensusParams proposes an authority-signed parameter update. An
// update taken under a consensus hold names it in ConsensusHoldMetadataKey
// (plan S3-A clarification K5): the hold must still be this leader's, and
// the update's definite outcome ends it (heldUpdateOutcome).
func (svc *consensusAdminService) UpdateConsensusParams(ctx context.Context, req *pb.UpdateConsensusParamsCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	if !svc.s.d.Cfg.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage)
	}
	holdID, held := consensusHoldIDFromContext(ctx)
	if held {
		if _, ok := svc.s.holds.lookup(holdID); !ok {
			return nil, status.Error(codes.NotFound, unknownConsensusHoldMessage)
		}
	}
	p, err := svc.updateConsensusParams(ctx, req)
	if held {
		if outcome, definite := heldUpdateOutcome(p, err); definite {
			svc.s.holds.settle(holdID, outcome)
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

// updateConsensusParams is UpdateConsensusParams after the enable check; it
// reports how far its proposal got, so a held update can tell a refusal from
// an unknown outcome.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) updateConsensusParams(ctx context.Context, req *pb.UpdateConsensusParamsCmd) (proposal, error) {
	if req.GetUpdate() == nil {
		return proposal{}, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "consensus parameter update is required")
	}
	update := wire.ConsensusParamsUpdateFromPB(req.GetUpdate())
	if err := svc.s.authorizeConsensusParamsUpdate(ctx, update, req.GetAuthorityJws()); err != nil {
		return proposal{}, err
	}
	// The signed-claims activation decides its evictions and feature check
	// from applied membership, so no membership proposal may be ordered
	// between that decision and its own proposal (fix wave 2, P1-b): it takes
	// membershipMu exclusively until its proposal ends, waiting for every
	// RegisterNode and MarkActive in flight, and reads after a barrier, so
	// applied state includes every membership command ordered before it. The
	// tracks activation decides its feature check the same way (contract
	// §3.8): a registration is either reflected in the gate's read or ordered
	// after the activation, where RegisterNode refuses a stage-1 binary.
	if (len(update.SIIndexers) > 0 && !svc.s.d.FSM.SignedClaimsActive()) || (update.TracksEnabled && !svc.s.d.FSM.TracksActive()) {
		svc.s.membershipMu.Lock()
		defer svc.s.membershipMu.Unlock()
		if err := svc.s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
			return proposal{}, err
		}
	}
	if err := svc.s.signedClaimsGate(ctx, update); err != nil {
		return proposal{}, err
	}
	if err := svc.s.tracksGate(ctx, update); err != nil {
		return proposal{}, err
	}
	_, p, err := svc.s.proposeTracked(ctx, wire.Command{UpdateConsensusParams: &wire.UpdateConsensusParams{
		Update:       update,
		AuthorityJWS: req.GetAuthorityJws(),
	}})
	return p, err
}
```

```go
func (s *Server) OnLeadershipLost() {

	// A consensus hold is this leader's alone (plan S3-A contract §4).

	// Held submissions were never proposed: answer them as a follower would.
```
